title.zh: 卷八十八 志第六十四 河渠六
title.raw: 卷八十八 志第六十四 河渠六 Volume 88 Treatises 64: Rivers and Canals 6

sentences.zh: 直省水利

translations.literal: Water conservancy in the directly administered provinces
translations.idiomatic: Water Conservancy in the Direct Provinces

sentences.zh: 三代疆理水土之制甚詳。

translations.literal: The institutions of the Three Dynasties for demarcating territory and managing water and soil were very detailed.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Dynasties maintained elaborate systems for surveying land and regulating water and soil.

sentences.zh: 自井田廢，溝遂堙，水常不得其治，於是穿鑿渠塘井陂，以資灌溉。

translations.literal: Since the well-field system was abolished, ditches and channels were filled in, and water often could not be properly managed; therefore canals, ponds, wells, and embankments were dug and bored to supply irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: Once the well-field system fell away and ditches and drains silted up, water could rarely be controlled effectively, so people excavated canals, ponds, wells, and dikes to provide irrigation.

sentences.zh: 明初，太祖詔所在有司，民以水利條上者，即陳奏。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Ming, the Taizu Emperor decreed that wherever local officials were stationed, when the people submitted items concerning water conservancy, they should immediately report them to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Ming, the Hongwu Emperor ordered local authorities that whenever commoners petitioned on waterworks, they were to report these at once to the court.

sentences.zh: 越二十七年，特諭工部，陂塘湖堰可蓄泄以備旱潦者，皆因其地勢修治之。

translations.literal: Twenty-seven years later, he specially instructed the Ministry of Works that all ponds, lakes, and weirs that could store and release water to guard against drought and flood should all be repaired according to local terrain.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-seven years on, he specifically directed the Ministry of Works to repair every reservoir, lake, and dam capable of storing or releasing water against drought or flood, each according to local topography.

sentences.zh: 乃分遣國子生及人材，遍詣天下，督修水利。

translations.literal: Thereupon he dispatched students of the Imperial Academy and men of talent throughout the empire to supervise water conservancy repairs.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent Imperial Academy students and talented men across the realm to oversee hydraulic works.

sentences.zh: 明年冬，郡邑交奏。

translations.literal: The next winter, prefectures and counties submitted reports in succession.
translations.idiomatic: The following winter, reports poured in from prefectures and counties across the land.

sentences.zh: 凡開塘堰四萬九百八十七處，其恤民者至矣。

translations.literal: In all, 40,987 ponds and weirs were opened—his care for the people reached this extent.
translations.idiomatic: In all, 40,987 ponds and weirs were opened—a measure of his solicitude for the people that could scarcely be exceeded.

sentences.zh: 嗣後有所興築，或役本境，或資鄰封，或支官料，或採山場，或農隙鳩工，或隨時集事，或遣大臣董成。

translations.literal: Afterward, whenever construction was undertaken, sometimes labor was levied within the local jurisdiction, sometimes resources were drawn from neighboring districts, sometimes official materials were disbursed, sometimes materials were taken from mountain worksites, sometimes labor was mustered in agricultural slack seasons, sometimes projects were assembled as occasion required, and sometimes grand ministers were dispatched to supervise completion.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, new works might draw labor from the local district or aid from neighboring jurisdictions, official supplies or materials from mountain quarries; crews might be assembled in farming slack seasons or on short notice, and high ministers were sometimes sent to oversee completion.

sentences.zh: 終明世水政屢修，可具列云。

translations.literal: Throughout the Ming dynasty water administration was repeatedly repaired; the particulars may be listed in full as follows.
translations.idiomatic: Water administration was repaired again and again through the Ming; the main undertakings may be set forth as follows.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年修和州銅城堰閘，週迴二百餘里。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu, the Tongcheng Weir and sluice in He Prefecture were repaired, encompassing more than two hundred li in circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 1 (1368), the Tongcheng Weir and sluice in He Prefecture were repaired, enclosing more than two hundred li of irrigation.

sentences.zh: 四年修興安靈渠，為陡渠者三十六。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the Ling Canal at Xing'an was repaired, with thirty-six steep channels constructed.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 4 (1371), the Ling Canal at Xing'an was restored, with thirty-six stepped channels built along it.

sentences.zh: 渠水發海陽山，秦時鑿，溉田萬頃。

translations.literal: The canal's water issues from Haiyang Mountain; it was dug in Qin times and irrigates ten thousand qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: Its waters rise on Haiyang Mountain; excavated in Qin times, the canal irrigates ten thousand qing of farmland.

sentences.zh: 馬援葺之，後圮。

translations.literal: Ma Yuan repaired it, but later it collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Yuan had restored it in Han times, but it later fell into ruin.

sentences.zh: 至是始復。

translations.literal: Only at this time was it restored.
translations.idiomatic: It was only now brought back into service.

sentences.zh: 六年發松江、嘉興民夫二萬開上海胡家港，自海口至漕涇千二百餘丈，以通海船，且浚海鹽澉浦。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, twenty thousand laborers from Songjiang and Jiaxing were mobilized to open the Hujia Harbor at Shanghai—more than 1,200 zhang from the estuary to Caojing—to admit seagoing vessels, and the saltworks channel at Cangpu in Haiyan was also dredged.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 6 (1373), twenty thousand laborers from Songjiang and Jiaxing opened Shanghai's Hujia Harbor, dredging more than 1,200 zhang from the estuary to Caojing to admit seagoing craft, and also cleared the saltworks channel at Cangpu in Haiyan.

sentences.zh: 八年開登州蓬萊閣河。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the Penglai Pavilion River in Deng Prefecture was opened.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 8 (1375), the river at Penglai Pavilion in Deng Prefecture was opened.

sentences.zh: 命耿炳文浚涇陽洪渠堰，溉涇陽、三原、醴泉、高陵、臨潼田二百餘里。

translations.literal: Geng Bingwen was ordered to dredge the Hongqu Weir in Jingyang, irrigating more than two hundred li of fields in Jingyang, Sanyuan, Liquan, Gaoling, and Lintong.
translations.idiomatic: Geng Bingwen was ordered to dredge the Hongqu Weir at Jingyang, watering more than two hundred li of fields in Jingyang, Sanyuan, Liquan, Gaoling, and Lintong.

sentences.zh: 九年修彭州都江堰。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, the Dujiangyan works in Peng Prefecture were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 9 (1376), the Dujiangyan irrigation system in Peng Prefecture was repaired.

sentences.zh: 十二年，李文忠言：「陝西病鹹鹵，請穿渠城中，遙引龍首渠東注。」

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Li Wenzhong said: "Shaanxi suffers from brackish and saline water; I request that a canal be cut within the city to draw the Longshou Canal from afar eastward."
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 12 (1379), Li Wenzhong reported: "Shaanxi is afflicted by brackish and saline water; I ask that a canal be cut within the city to bring the Longshou Canal from afar and channel it eastward."

sentences.zh: 從其請，甃以石。

translations.literal: His request was granted, and the canal was lined with stone.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted, and the canal was faced with stone.

sentences.zh: 十四年築海鹽海塘。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, the seadike at Haiyan was built.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 14 (1381), the seadike at Haiyan was constructed.

sentences.zh: 十七年築磁州漳河決堤。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, the breached dike on the Zhang River at Ci Prefecture was built up.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 17 (1384), the breached Zhang River dike at Ci Prefecture was repaired.

sentences.zh: 決荊州嶽山壩以灌民田。

translations.literal: The Yueshan Dam in Jing Prefecture was breached to irrigate the people's fields.
translations.idiomatic: The Yueshan Dam in Jingzhou was opened to irrigate farmland.

sentences.zh: 十九年築長樂海堤。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, the seadike at Changle was built.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 19 (1386), the seadike at Changle was built.

sentences.zh: 二十三年修崇明、海門決堤二萬三千九百餘丈，役夫二十五萬人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, breached dikes at Chongming and Haimen totaling more than 23,900 zhang were repaired, with 250,000 laborers employed.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 23 (1390), more than 23,900 zhang of breached dikes at Chongming and Haimen were repaired, employing 250,000 laborers.

sentences.zh: 四川永甯宣慰使言：「所轄水道百九十灘，江門大灘八十二，皆被石塞。」

translations.literal: The Pacification Commissioner of Yongning in Sichuan reported: "Within my jurisdiction there are 190 rapids on the waterways, and 82 major rapids at Jiangmen, all blocked by rock."
translations.idiomatic: The Yongning Pacification Commissioner in Sichuan reported: "Within my jurisdiction are 190 rapids on the waterways, including 82 major ones at Jiangmen, all choked by rock."

sentences.zh: 詔景川侯曹震往疏之。

translations.literal: The emperor decreed that Marquis Cao Zhen of Jingchuan should go to dredge them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Marquis Cao Zhen of Jingchuan to go and clear them.

sentences.zh: 二十四年修臨海橫山嶺水閘，寧海、奉化海堤四千三百餘丈。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, the water sluice at Hengshan Ridge in Linhai was repaired, and seadikes at Ninghai and Fenghua totaling more than 4,300 zhang.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 24 (1391), the sluice at Hengshan Ridge in Linhai was repaired, and more than 4,300 zhang of seadike at Ninghai and Fenghua were built.

sentences.zh: 築上虞海堤四千丈，改建石閘。

translations.literal: A seadike of 4,000 zhang was built at Shangyu, and the sluice was rebuilt in stone.
translations.idiomatic: At Shangyu a 4,000-zhang seadike was built and the sluice rebuilt in stone.

sentences.zh: 浚定海、鄞二縣東錢湖，灌田數萬頃。

translations.literal: East Qian Lake in Dinghai and Yin counties was dredged, irrigating tens of thousands of qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: East Qian Lake in Dinghai and Yin counties was dredged, watering tens of thousands of qing of farmland.

sentences.zh: 二十五年鑿溧陽銀墅東壩河道，由十字港抵沙子河胭脂壩四千三百餘丈，役夫三十五萬九千餘人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, the channel at the eastern dam of Yinshu in Liyang was cut—more than 4,300 zhang from Shizi Harbor to the Yanzhi Dam on the Shazi River—with 359,000-odd laborers employed.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 25 (1392), the channel at Liyang's Yinshu eastern dam was excavated for more than 4,300 zhang from Shizi Harbor to the Yanzhi Dam on the Shazi River, employing over 359,000 laborers.

sentences.zh: 二十七年浚山陽支家河，鬱林州民言：「州南北二江相去二十餘里，乞鑿通，設石陡諸閘。」

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, the Zhijia River in Shanyang was dredged. The people of Yulin Prefecture said: "The two rivers north and south of the prefecture are more than twenty li apart; we beg that they be cut through and connected, with stone stepped locks and other sluices installed."
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 27 (1394), the Zhijia River in Shanyang was dredged. The people of Yulin Prefecture petitioned: "The prefecture's northern and southern rivers lie more than twenty li apart; we ask that they be linked by excavation and fitted with stone stepped locks and other gates."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 二十九年修築河南洛堤。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, the Luo River dikes in Henan were repaired and built.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 29 (1396), the Luo River dikes in Henan were repaired.

sentences.zh: 復興安靈渠。

translations.literal: The Ling Canal at Xing'an was restored again.
translations.idiomatic: The Ling Canal at Xing'an was restored once more.

sentences.zh: 時尚書唐鐸以軍興至其地，圖渠狀以聞。

translations.literal: At that time Minister Tang Duo, because of military mobilization, arrived at the site and submitted a diagram of the canal's condition to inform the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Tang Duo had arrived there on military business and submitted a diagram of the canal's condition to the throne.

sentences.zh: 請浚深廣，通官舟以餉軍。

translations.literal: He requested that it be dredged deeper and wider so that official boats could pass to supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that it be dredged deeper and wider so official transports could pass and provision the army.

sentences.zh: 命御史嚴震直燒鑿陡澗之石，餉道果通。

translations.literal: Censor Yan Zhenzhi was ordered to burn and cut through the rock of the steep ravines, and the supply route was indeed opened.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Yan Zhenzhi was ordered to blast and cut through the rock in the steep gorges, and the supply route was duly opened.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，洪渠堰圮，復命耿炳文修治之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, the Hongqu Weir collapsed, and Geng Bingwen was again ordered to repair it.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 31 (1398), the Hongqu Weir collapsed, and Geng Bingwen was again ordered to repair it.

sentences.zh: 且浚渠十萬三千餘丈。

translations.literal: Moreover, more than 103,000 zhang of canal were dredged.
translations.idiomatic: More than 103,000 zhang of canal were dredged as well.

sentences.zh: 建文四年疏吳淞江。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jianwen, the Wusong River was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianwen 4 (1402), the Wusong River was dredged.

sentences.zh: 命夏原吉治蘇、鬆、嘉興水患，浚華亭、上海運鹽河，金山衛閘及漕涇分水港。

translations.literal: Xia Yuanji was ordered to manage the water disasters of Suzhou, Songjiang, and Jiaxing, and to dredge the salt transport canals at Huating and Shanghai, the sluice at Jinshan Guard, and the Caojing distributary harbor.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Yuanji was ordered to address flooding in Suzhou, Songjiang, and Jiaxing, and to dredge the salt transport canals at Huating and Shanghai, the Jinshan Guard sluice, and the Caojing distributary.

sentences.zh: 原吉言：「浙西諸郡，蘇、鬆最居下流，嘉、湖、常頗高，環乙太湖，綿亙五百里。

translations.literal: Yuanji said: "Among the prefectures of western Zhejiang, Suzhou and Songjiang lie lowest downstream; Jiaxing, Huzhou, and Changzhou are rather higher, encircling Lake Tai for five hundred li in extent.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanji reported: "In western Zhejiang, Suzhou and Songjiang lie lowest downstream; Jiaxing, Huzhou, and Changzhou stand higher, ringing Lake Tai for five hundred li.

sentences.zh: 納杭、湖、宣、歙溪澗之水，散注澱山諸湖，以入三泖。

translations.literal: It receives the waters of streams and ravines from Hang, Hu, Xuan, and She, which disperse into the lakes such as Dianshan and then enter the three Mao channels.
translations.idiomatic: It receives streams from Hangzhou, Huzhou, Xuanzhou, and Shezhou, which spread into lakes such as Dianshan and then flow into the three Mao channels.

sentences.zh: 頃為浦港堙塞，漲溢害稼。

translations.literal: Recently the estuary harbors have silted shut, causing floods that harm the crops.
translations.idiomatic: Lately the estuary channels have silted up, causing floods that damage the harvest.

sentences.zh: 拯治之法，在浚吳淞諸浦。

translations.literal: The method of remedy lies in dredging the Wusong and its various tributary channels.
translations.idiomatic: The remedy is to dredge the Wusong River and its tributary channels.

sentences.zh: 按吳淞江袤二百餘里，廣百五十餘丈，西接太湖，東通海，前代常疏之。

translations.literal: The Wusong River extends more than two hundred li in length and is more than 150 zhang wide; west it joins Lake Tai, east it reaches the sea; former dynasties often dredged it.
translations.idiomatic: The Wusong River runs more than two hundred li, over 150 zhang wide, joining Lake Tai on the west and the sea on the east; earlier dynasties dredged it repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 然當潮汐之沖，旋疏旋塞。

translations.literal: Yet it lies in the path of tidal surges, so that as soon as it is dredged it silts up again.
translations.idiomatic: Yet it lies in the tidal surge zone, so that no sooner is it cleared than it silts up again.

sentences.zh: 自吳江長橋抵下界浦，百二十餘里，水流雖通，實多窄淺。

translations.literal: From Changqiao in Wujiang to Xiajie Harbor, more than 120 li, though the current flows, there are in fact many narrow and shallow stretches.
translations.idiomatic: From Changqiao in Wujiang to Xiajie Harbor, more than 120 li, the water flows but the channel is often narrow and shallow.

sentences.zh: 從浦抵上海南倉浦口，百三十餘里，潮汐淤塞，已成平陸，灩沙遊泥，難以施工。

translations.literal: From that harbor to Nancang Harbor mouth at Shanghai, more than 130 li, tidal silt has blocked the channel until it has become level land; shifting sand and drifting mud make construction difficult.
translations.idiomatic: From there to Nancang Harbor at Shanghai, more than 130 li, tidal silt has filled the channel until it is level ground; shifting sand and drifting mud make work nearly impossible.

sentences.zh: 嘉定劉家港即古婁江，徑入海，常熟白茆港徑入江，皆廣川急流。

translations.literal: Liujia Harbor in Jiading is the ancient Lou River, running straight to the sea; Baimao Harbor in Changshu runs straight into the river—both are broad channels with swift current.
translations.idiomatic: Liujia Harbor in Jiading is the ancient Lou River, running straight to the sea; Baimao Harbor in Changshu runs straight to the main stream—both are broad channels with swift current.

sentences.zh: 宜疏吳淞南北兩岸、安亭等浦，引太湖諸水入劉家、白茆二港，使其勢分。

translations.literal: It is fitting to dredge the north and south banks of the Wusong and channels such as Anting, drawing the various waters of Lake Tai into the two harbors of Liujia and Baimao so that their force is divided.
translations.idiomatic: The north and south banks of the Wusong and channels such as Anting should be dredged to divert Lake Tai's waters into Liujia and Baimao harbors and divide the current.

sentences.zh: 松江大黃浦乃通吳淞要道，今下流遏塞難浚。

translations.literal: The Dahuangpu in Songjiang is the main route connecting to the Wusong; now its lower reach is blocked and hard to dredge.
translations.idiomatic: Songjiang's Dahuangpu is the main route to the Wusong, but its lower reach is now blocked and difficult to dredge.

sentences.zh: 旁有範家浜，至南倉浦口徑達海。

translations.literal: Beside it is Fanjia Creek, which from Nancang Harbor mouth runs straight to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Nearby is Fanjia Creek, which from Nancang Harbor runs straight to the sea.

sentences.zh: 宜浚深闊，上接大黃浦，達泖湖之水，庶幾復《禹貢》「三江入海」之舊。

translations.literal: It should be dredged deep and wide, connecting above to the Dahuangpu and reaching the waters of the Mao lakes, so that perhaps the old condition of the "Three Rivers entering the sea" in the Yu Gong may be restored.
translations.idiomatic: It should be dredged deep and wide, linking above to the Dahuangpu and the Mao lake waters, so that the Yu Gong's "three rivers entering the sea" might be restored in some measure.

sentences.zh: 水道既通，乃相地勢，各置石閘，以時啟閉。

translations.literal: Once the waterways are open, then according to the terrain, stone sluices should be set up at each place and opened or closed according to season.
translations.idiomatic: Once the waterways are open, stone sluices should be placed according to terrain and opened or closed seasonally.

sentences.zh: 每歲水涸時，預修圩岸，以防暴流，則水患可息。」

translations.literal: Each year when the waters recede, polder dikes should be repaired in advance to guard against sudden floods; then water disasters can cease."
translations.idiomatic: Each year when waters run low, polder dikes should be repaired in advance against sudden floods, and flooding can be brought under control."

sentences.zh: 帝命發民丁開浚。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered corvée labor mobilized to open and dredge.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered corvée labor mobilized for the dredging.

sentences.zh: 原吉晝夜徙步，以身先之，功遂成。

translations.literal: Yuanji walked day and night on foot, taking the lead in person, and the work was completed.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanji walked the works day and night on foot, leading by example, until the project was finished.

sentences.zh: 二年，修泰州河塘萬八千丈，興化南北堤、泰興沿江圩岸、六合瓜步等屯。

translations.literal: In the second year, 18,000 zhang of river embankment in Taizhou were repaired, as well as the north and south dikes of Xinghua, the riverside polders of Taixing, and the garrisons at Guabu in Liuhe and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 2 (1404), 18,000 zhang of Taizhou river embankment were repaired, along with Xinghua's north and south dikes, Taixing's riverside polders, and the garrisons at Guabu in Liuhe and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 浚丹徒通潮舊江，又修象山茭湖塘岸，海康、徐聞二縣那隱坡、調黎等港堤岸，黃嚴混水等十五閘、六陡門，孟津河堤，分宜湖塘，武陟馬田堤岸，香山竹徑水陂，復興安分水塘。

translations.literal: The old tidal channel at Dantu was dredged; moreover the Jiaohu embankment at Xiangshan was repaired; the harbor dikes at Nayinpo and Diaoli in Haikang and Xuwen counties; fifteen sluices including Hunshui in Huangyan and six stepped gates; the Mengjin River dike; the lake embankment at Fenyi; the Matian dike at Wuzhi; the Zhujing water barrage at Xiangshan; and the Fenishuitang at Xing'an were restored.
translations.idiomatic: The old tidal channel at Dantu was dredged; embankments were repaired at Xiangshan's Jiaohu, harbor dikes at Nayinpo and Diaoli in Haikang and Xuwen, fifteen Huangyan sluices including Hunshui and six stepped gates, the Mengjin River dike, Fenyi's lake embankment, Wuzhi's Matian dike, Xiangshan's Zhujing barrage, and Xing'an's Fenishuitang were restored.

sentences.zh: 興安有江，源出海陽山。

translations.literal: At Xing'an there is a river whose source is on Haiyang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: At Xing'an a river rises on Haiyang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 江中橫築石埭，分南北渠，溉民田甚溥。

translations.literal: A stone weir was built across the river to divide north and south channels, irrigating the people's fields very extensively.
translations.idiomatic: A stone weir built across the river divided north and south channels and irrigated a vast extent of farmland.

sentences.zh: 埭上疊石如鱗，以防沖溢。

translations.literal: On the weir stones were stacked like fish scales to guard against rushing overflow.
translations.idiomatic: Stones were laid on the weir like fish scales to withstand flood surges.

sentences.zh: 嚴震直撤石增埭，水迫無所泄，沖塘岸，盡趨北渠，南渠淺澀，民失利。

translations.literal: Yan Zhenzhi removed the stones and raised the weir; the water, pressed with nowhere to discharge, burst the pond banks and all rushed into the north channel; the south channel became shallow and sluggish, and the people lost benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Zhenzhi had removed the stones and raised the weir; with nowhere to discharge, the water burst the pond banks and all rushed into the north channel, leaving the south channel shallow and depriving the people of irrigation.

sentences.zh: 至是修復如舊。

translations.literal: At this time it was repaired and restored as before.
translations.idiomatic: It was now restored to its former condition.

sentences.zh: 海門民請發淮安、蘇、常民丁協修張墩港、東明港百餘里潰堤。

translations.literal: The people of Haimen requested that corvée from Huai'an, Suzhou, and Changzhou be mobilized to assist in repairing more than 100 li of breached dikes at Zhangdun Harbor and Dongming Harbor.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Haimen asked that corvée from Huai'an, Suzhou, and Changzhou be mobilized to help repair more than 100 li of breached dikes at Zhangdun and Dongming harbors.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「三郡民方苦水患，不可重勞。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "The people of the three prefectures are already suffering from water disasters; they must not be burdened again."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "The people of those three prefectures are already suffering from flooding; they must not be burdened further.

sentences.zh: 遣官行視，以揚州民協築之。

translations.literal: Officials were dispatched to inspect on site, and Yangzhou labor was used to assist in the construction.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were sent to inspect the site, and Yangzhou labor was used for the repairs instead.

sentences.zh: 當塗民言：「慈湖瀕江，上通宣、歙，東抵丹陽湖，西接蕪湖。

translations.literal: The people of Dangtu said: "Cihu borders the Yangtze; upstream it connects to Xuan and She; east it reaches Danyang Lake; west it joins Wuhu.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Dangtu reported: "Cihu lies on the Yangtze, linking upstream to Xuanzhou and Shezhou, east to Danyang Lake, and west to Wuhu.

sentences.zh: 久雨浸淫，潮漲傷農，宜遣勘修築。」

translations.literal: Prolonged rain has soaked the land, and rising tides have harmed agriculture; officials should be sent to survey and repair and build."
translations.idiomatic: Prolonged rain and rising tides have damaged the crops; officials should be sent to survey and repair the works.

sentences.zh: 帝從其請，且諭工部，安、徽、蘇、鬆，浙江、江西、湖廣，凡湖泊卑下，圩岸傾頹，亟督有司治之。

translations.literal: The emperor granted their request, and moreover instructed the Ministry of Works that in Anhui, Suzhou, Songjiang, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, and Huguang, wherever lakes were low-lying and polder dikes had collapsed, local officials should be urgently directed to repair them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted the request and instructed the Ministry of Works to urge officials in Anhui, Suzhou, Songjiang, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, and Huguang to repair promptly wherever lakes lay low and polder dikes had collapsed.

sentences.zh: 夏原吉復奉命治水蘇、鬆，盡通舊河港。

translations.literal: Xia Yuanji was again ordered to manage the waters of Suzhou and Songjiang, fully reopening the old river harbors.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Yuanji was again ordered to manage Suzhou and Songjiang waters and fully reopen the old river channels.

sentences.zh: 又浚蘇州千墩浦、致和塘、安亭、顧浦、陸皎浦、尤涇、黃涇共二萬九千餘丈，松江大黃浦、赤雁浦、範家浜共萬二千丈，以通太湖下流。

translations.literal: Moreover, Qiandun Harbor, Zhihe Pond, Anting, Gupu, Lujiaopu, Youjing, and Huangjing in Suzhou—more than 29,000 zhang in all—and the Dahuangpu, Chiyanpu, and Fanjiabang in Songjiang—12,000 zhang in all—were dredged to open the lower outflow of Lake Tai.
translations.idiomatic: He also dredged more than 29,000 zhang of Suzhou channels including Qiandun Harbor, Zhihe Pond, Anting, Gupu, Lujiaopu, Youjing, and Huangjing, and 12,000 zhang in Songjiang including the Dahuangpu, Chiyanpu, and Fanjiabang, to open Lake Tai's lower outflow.

sentences.zh: 先是，修含山崇義堰。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Chongyi Weir in Hanshan was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, the Chongyi Weir in Hanshan had been repaired.

sentences.zh: 未幾，和州民言：「銅城閘上抵巢湖，下揚子江，決圩岸七十餘處，乞修治。」

translations.literal: Before long, the people of He Prefecture said: "The Tongcheng Sluice reaches Chaohu Lake upstream and the Yangtze downstream; more than seventy places on the polder dikes have breached; we beg that repairs be undertaken."
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, the people of He Prefecture reported: "The Tongcheng Sluice reaches Chaohu upstream and the Yangtze downstream; more than seventy breaches have opened in the polder dikes; we ask for repairs.

sentences.zh: 其吏目張良興又言：「水淹麻、澧二湖田五萬餘頃，宜築圩埂，起桃花橋，訖含山界三十里。」

translations.literal: Its clerk Zhang Liangxing further said: "Water has flooded more than 50,000 qing of fields in the Ma and Li lakes; polder embankments should be built from Taohua Bridge for thirty li to the Hanshan border."
translations.idiomatic: Clerk Zhang Liangxing added: "Floods have submerged more than 50,000 qing of fields in the Ma and Li lakes; polder embankments should be built from Taohua Bridge for thirty li to the Hanshan border."

sentences.zh: 俱從之。

translations.literal: Both requests were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Both requests were granted.

sentences.zh: 三年，修上虞曹娥江壩埂，溫縣馱塢村堤堰四千餘丈，南海衛蓮塘、四會縣鴉鵲水等堤岸，無為州周興等鄉及鷹揚衛烏江屯江岸。

translations.literal: In the third year, the Cao'e River dam embankment in Shangyu was repaired; dikes and weirs at Tuowu Village in Wen County totaling more than 4,000 zhang; the dikes at Liantang in Nanhai Guard and Yaque Water in Sihui County; and the river banks at Zhouxing and other townships in Wuwei Prefecture and at the Wujiang garrison of Yingyang Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 3 (1405), the Cao'e River dam at Shangyu was repaired; more than 4,000 zhang of dikes at Tuowu Village in Wen County; dikes at Nanhai Guard's Liantang and Sihui's Yaque Water; and river banks at Wuwei's Zhouxing townships and Yingyang Guard's Wujiang garrison.

sentences.zh: 築昌黎及曆城小清河決堤，應天新河口北岸，從大勝關抵江東驛三千三百丈。

translations.literal: Breached dikes on the Xiaoqing River at Changli and Licheng were built up; the north bank at the new river mouth in Yingtian—3,300 zhang from Dasheng Pass to Jiangdong Post.
translations.idiomatic: Breached Xiaoqing River dikes at Changli and Licheng were repaired; 3,300 zhang of north bank at Yingtian's new river mouth from Dasheng Pass to Jiangdong Post.

sentences.zh: 浚海州北舊河，上通高橋，下接臨洪場及山陽運鹽河十八里。

translations.literal: The old north river at Haizhou was dredged, connecting above to Gaoqiao and below to Linhong Station and the eighteen-li salt transport canal at Shanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Haizhou's old north river was dredged, linking Gaoqiao upstream to Linhong Station and Shanyang's eighteen-li salt canal downstream.

sentences.zh: 四年，修築宣城十九圩，豐城穆湖圩岸，石首臨江萬石堤，溧水決圩。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, nineteen polders in Xuancheng were repaired and built; the Mu Lake polder embankment in Fengcheng; the Wanshi Dike facing the river at Shishou; and breached polders in Lishui.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 4 (1406), nineteen Xuancheng polders were repaired, Fengcheng's Mu Lake polder embankment and Shishou's riverside Wanshi Dike were built, and breached Lishui polders were restored.

sentences.zh: 修懷寧鬥潭河、彭灘圩岸，順天固安，保定荊岱，樂亭魯家套、社河口，吉水劉家塘、雲陂，江都劉家圩港。

translations.literal: The Doutan River and Pengtan polder embankment in Huaining were repaired; Gu'an in Shuntian; Jingdai in Baoding; Lujiatou and Shehekou in Leting; Liujiatang and Yunpo in Jishui; and Liujiaweigang in Jiangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Huaining's Doutan River and Pengtan polder, Shuntian's Gu'an, Baoding's Jingdai, Leting's Lujiatou and Shehekou, Jishui's Liujiatang and Yunpo, and Jiangdu's Liujiaweigang were repaired.

sentences.zh: 築湖廣廣濟、武家穴等江岸。

translations.literal: River banks at Guangji and Wujiaxue in Huguang were built.
translations.idiomatic: River banks at Huguang's Guangji and Wujiaxue were constructed.

sentences.zh: 新建石頭岡圩岸、江浦沿江堤。

translations.literal: Newly built were the Shitougang polder embankment and the riverside dike at Jiangpu.
translations.idiomatic: New works included the Shitougang polder embankment and Jiangpu's riverside dike.

sentences.zh: 開泰州運鹽河、普定秦潼河、西溪南儀阡三處河口，導流興化、鹽城界入海。

translations.literal: The salt transport canal at Taizhou was opened; the Qintong River at Puding; and three river mouths at Nanyiqian in Xixi—directing the flow from the border of Xinghua and Yancheng to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Taizhou's salt canal, Puding's Qintong River, and three mouths at Xixi's Nanyiqian were opened to channel water from the Xinghua–Yancheng border to the sea.

sentences.zh: 浚常熟福山塘三十六里。

translations.literal: Fushantang in Changshu was dredged for thirty-six li.
translations.idiomatic: Changshu's Fushantang was dredged for thirty-six li.

sentences.zh: 五年，修長洲、吳江、崑山、華亭、錢塘、仁和、嘉興堤岸，餘姚南湖壩，築高要銀岡、金山等潰堤，溉田五百餘頃。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, dikes at Changzhou, Wujiang, Kunshan, Huating, Qiantang, Renhe, and Jiaxing were repaired; the Nanhu Dam in Yuyao; breached dikes at Yingang and Jinshan in Gaoyao were built up, irrigating more than 500 qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 5 (1407), dikes at Changzhou, Wujiang, Kunshan, Huating, Qiantang, Renhe, and Jiaxing were repaired, Yuyao's Nanhu Dam was restored, breached dikes at Gaoyao's Yingang and Jinshan were rebuilt, irrigating more than 500 qing.

sentences.zh: 治杭州江岸之淪者。

translations.literal: The collapsed stretches of Hangzhou's river bank were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Collapsed sections of Hangzhou's riverbank were repaired.

sentences.zh: 六年浚浙江平陽縣河。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the river in Pingyang County, Zhejiang, was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 6 (1408), Pingyang County's river in Zhejiang was dredged.

sentences.zh: 七年修安陸州渲馬灘決岸、海鹽石堤，築泰興攔江堤三千九百餘丈。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, the breached bank at Xuanmatan in Anlu Prefecture and the stone dike at Haiyan were repaired; the river-blocking dike at Taixing was built for more than 3,900 zhang.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 7 (1409), Anlu's breached Xuanmatan bank and Haiyan's stone dike were repaired, and more than 3,900 zhang of Taixing's river-blocking dike were built.

sentences.zh: 且浚大港北淤河，抵縣南，出大江，四千五百餘丈。

translations.literal: Moreover, the silted north branch of Dagang was dredged to the south of the county seat and out to the great river—more than 4,500 zhang.
translations.idiomatic: The silted north branch of Dagang was also dredged south of the county seat to the main river for more than 4,500 zhang.

sentences.zh: 八年修丹陽練湖塘，汝陽汝河堤岸，南陵野塘圩、蚌蕩壩，鬆滋張家坑、何家洲堤岸，平度州濰水、浮糠河決口百十二，堤堰八千餘丈，吳江石塘官路橋樑。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Lianhu Pond embankment in Danyang was repaired; the Ru River dikes in Ruyang; the Yetang polder and Bangdang Dam in Nanling; the dikes at Zhangjiakeng and Hejiazhou in Songzi; 112 breaches on the Weishui and Fukang River in Pingdu Prefecture and more than 8,000 zhang of dikes and weirs; and the Shitang official road bridges in Wujiang.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 8 (1410), Danyang's Lianhu embankment, Ruyang's Ru River dikes, Nanling's Yetang polder and Bangdang Dam, Songzi's Zhangjiakeng and Hejiazhou dikes, 112 Pingdu breaches on the Weishui and Fukang River with over 8,000 zhang of dikes and weirs, and Wujiang's Shitang road bridges were repaired.

sentences.zh: 九年，修安福丁陂等塘堰，安仁鐃家陂、壽光堤，安陸京山景陵圩岸，長樂官塘，長洲至嘉興石土塘橋路七十餘里，泄水洞百三十一處，監利車水堤四千四百餘丈，高安華陂屯陂堤，仁和、海寧、海鹽土石塘岸萬餘丈。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, ponds and weirs including Dingpi in Anfu were repaired; the Raojia Barrage in Anren and the dike in Shouguang; the polder embankment at Jingling in Jingshan, Anlu; the official pond in Changle; stone and earth embankments, bridges, and roads from Changzhou to Jiaxing for more than seventy li; 131 drainage culverts; the water-lifting dike at Jianli for more than 4,400 zhang; the barrage dike at Huapi Garrison in Gao'an; and more than 10,000 zhang of earth and stone embankments in Renhe, Haining, and Haiyan.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 9 (1411), Anfu's Dingpi and other ponds and weirs, Anren's Raojia Barrage, Shouguang's dike, Anlu Jingshan's Jingling polder, Changle's official pond, more than seventy li of stone and earth embankments and bridges from Changzhou to Jiaxing, 131 drainage culverts, Jianli's 4,400-zhang water-lifting dike, Gao'an's Huapi garrison barrage, and over 10,000 zhang of embankments in Renhe, Haining, and Haiyan were repaired.

sentences.zh: 築沂州沭河口決岸，並瀹述陽述河。。

translations.literal: The breached bank at the mouth of the Shu River in Yi Prefecture was built up, and the Shuyang River was also dredged.
translations.idiomatic: The breached Shu River mouth at Yi Prefecture was repaired, and the Shuyang River was dredged.

sentences.zh: 築直隸新城張村等口決堤，仁和黃濠塘岸三百餘丈，孫家圍塘岸二十餘里。

translations.literal: Breached dikes at Zhangcun and other openings in Xincheng, Zhili, were built up; the Huanghao embankment in Renhe for more than 300 zhang; and the Sunjiawei embankment for more than twenty li.
translations.idiomatic: Breached dikes at Zhangcun and other openings in Zhili's Xincheng were repaired; more than 300 zhang of Renhe's Huanghao embankment; and more than twenty li of Sunjiawei embankment were built.

sentences.zh: 浚濰縣幹丹河、定襄故渠六十三里，引滹沱水灌田六百餘頃。

translations.literal: The Gandan River in Wei County and the old channel in Dingxiang—sixty-three li—were dredged, drawing Hutuo River water to irrigate more than 600 qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: Wei County's Gandan River and Dingxiang's old channel—sixty-three li—were dredged to draw Hutuo water and irrigate more than 600 qing.

sentences.zh: 疏福山官渠，浚江陰青陽河道，鄒平白條溝河三十餘里。

translations.literal: The official canal at Fushan was cleared; the Qingyang River channel in Jiangyin was dredged; and the Baitiao Ditch in Zouping for more than thirty li.
translations.idiomatic: Fushan's official canal was cleared, Jiangyin's Qingyang channel was dredged, and Zouping's Baitiao Ditch for more than thirty li.

sentences.zh: 麗水民言：「縣有通濟渠，截鬆陽、遂昌諸溪水入焉。

translations.literal: The people of Lishui said: "The county has the Tongji Canal, which intercepts the stream waters of Songyang, Suichang, and other places and channels them into it.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Lishui reported: "The county has the Tongji Canal, which diverts stream waters from Songyang, Suichang, and elsewhere into it.

sentences.zh: 上、中、下三源，流四十八派，溉田二千餘頃。

translations.literal: Its upper, middle, and lower sources branch into forty-eight channels, irrigating more than 2,000 qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: Its upper, middle, and lower sources divide into forty-eight channels and irrigate more than 2,000 qing of farmland.

sentences.zh: 上源民泄水自利，下源流絕，沙壅渠塞。

translations.literal: People of the upper source release water for their own benefit; the lower source's flow is cut off, sand piles up, and the canal is blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Upstream communities drain the water for their own use, the lower reach runs dry, sand accumulates, and the canal is choked.

sentences.zh: 請修堤堰如舊。」

translations.literal: They request that dikes and weirs be repaired as before."
translations.idiomatic: They ask that the dikes and weirs be restored to their former condition.

sentences.zh: 部議從之。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated and assented.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry deliberated and approved the request.

sentences.zh: 齊東知縣張升言：「小清河洪水沖決，淹沒諸鹽場及青州田。

translations.literal: Zhang Sheng, magistrate of Qidong, said: "Floods on the Xiaoqing River have burst through and inundated the salt fields and farmland in Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Sheng, magistrate of Qidong, reported: "Floods on the Xiaoqing River have broken through and submerged the salt works and farmland of Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 請浚上流，修長堤，使水行故道。」

translations.literal: We request dredging upstream, repairing long dikes, and making the water follow its old course."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the upper reach be dredged, long dikes be rebuilt, and the water be returned to its former channel.

sentences.zh: 皇太子遣官經理之。

translations.literal: The crown prince dispatched officials to oversee it.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince sent officials to take charge of the work.

sentences.zh: 鄜州民言：「洛水橫決而西，沖塌州城東北隅。

translations.literal: The people of Fu Prefecture said: "The Luo River burst sideways toward the west and collapsed the northeastern corner of the prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Fu Prefecture reported: "The Luo River broke out westward and washed away the northeastern corner of the prefectural city.

sentences.zh: 請浚故道，循州東山麓南流。」

translations.literal: We request dredging the old channel so it follows the southern slope of the mountains east of the prefecture and flows south."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the old channel be dredged so the river may run south along the foothills east of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: [The court] assented.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the request.

sentences.zh: 十年，修浙江平陽捍潮堤岸，黃梅臨江決岸百二十餘里，海門捍潮堤百三十里。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, tide-blocking embankments in Pingyang, Zhejiang were repaired; more than 120 li of breached banks along the Yangtze at Huangmei; and 130 li of tide-blocking dikes at Haimen.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, tide-blocking embankments at Pingyang in Zhejiang were repaired, more than 120 li of breached Yangtze banks at Huangmei were restored, and 130 li of tide-blocking dikes at Haimen were built.

sentences.zh: 築新會圩岸二千餘丈，獻縣、饒陽恭儉等岸，安丘紅河決岸，安州直亭等河決口八十九，華容、安津等堤決口四十六。

translations.literal: More than 2,000 zhang of polder embankment in Xinhui were built; embankments including Gongjian in Xian and Raoyang counties; the breached bank of the Hong River in Anqiu; eighty-nine breaches on rivers including Zhiting in Anzhou; and forty-six breaches on dikes at Huarong, Anjin, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: More than 2,000 zhang of polder embankment were built at Xinhui; embankments including Gongjian in Xian and Raoyang were repaired; Anqiu's breached Hong River bank was rebuilt; eighty-nine breaches were closed on rivers such as Zhiting in Anzhou; and forty-six dike breaches were repaired at Huarong, Anjin, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 浚上海蟠龍江、濰縣白浪河。

translations.literal: The Panlong River in Shanghai and the Bailang River in Wei County were dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Shanghai's Panlong River and Wei County's Bailang River were dredged.

sentences.zh: 北京行太僕卿楊砥言：「吳橋、東光、興濟、交河及天津等衛屯田，雨水決堤傷稼。

translations.literal: Yang Di, acting Grand Steward of the Beijing branch, said: "Military colony fields in the guards of Wuqiao, Dongguang, Xingji, Jiaohe, Tianjin, and elsewhere have suffered breached dikes and damaged crops from rainwater.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Di, acting Grand Steward of the Beijing branch, reported: "Rainwater has burst the dikes and damaged the crops of military colony fields in the guards of Wuqiao, Dongguang, Xingji, Jiaohe, Tianjin, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 德州良店驛東南二十五里有黃河故道，與州南土河通。

translations.literal: Twenty-five li southeast of Liangdian Post in Dezhou is the old course of the Yellow River, which connects with the earthen river south of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-five li southeast of Liangdian Post in Dezhou lies the old Yellow River channel, which connects with the earthen river south of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 穿渠置閘，分殺水勢，大為民便。」

translations.literal: Digging a canal and installing sluice gates would divide and reduce the water's force, greatly benefiting the people."
translations.idiomatic: Cutting a canal and installing sluice gates would split and tame the flood, greatly benefiting the people.

sentences.zh: 命侍郎蘭芳往理之。

translations.literal: [The emperor] ordered Vice Minister Lan Fang to go manage it.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Lan Fang was ordered to go and oversee the work.

sentences.zh: 十一年，修蕪湖陶辛、政和二圩，保定、文安二縣河口決岸五十四，應天新河圩岸，天長福勝、戚家莊二塘，滎澤大濱河堤。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, the Taoxin and Zhenghe second polders in Wuhu were repaired; fifty-four breached banks at river mouths in Baoding and Wen'an counties; the Xinghe polder embankment in Yingtian; the Fusheng and Qijiazhuang ponds in Tianchang; and the Dabin River dike in Xingze.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Wuhu's Taoxin and Zhenghe second polders were repaired, fifty-four breached river mouths in Baoding and Wen'an counties were restored, Yingtian's Xinghe polder embankment was rebuilt, Tianchang's Fusheng and Qijiazhuang ponds were repaired, and Xingze's Dabin River dike was restored.

sentences.zh: 浚崑山太平河。

translations.literal: The Taiping River in Kunshan was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Kunshan's Taiping River was dredged.

sentences.zh: 十二年修鳳陽安豐塘水門十六座及牛角壩、新倉鋪塌岸，武陟郭村、馬曲堤岸，聊城龍灣河，濮州紅船口，範縣曹村河堤岸。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, sixteen sluice gates at Anfeng Pond in Fengyang were repaired, along with the Niujiao Dam and the collapsed bank at Xincangpu; dikes at Guocun and Maqu in Wuzhi; Longwan River in Liaocheng; Hongchuankou in Puzhou; and the Cacun River dike in Fan County.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, sixteen sluice gates at Fengyang's Anfeng Pond were repaired, along with the Niujiao Dam and the collapsed bank at Xincangpu; dikes at Guocun and Maqu in Wuzhi; Liaocheng's Longwan River; Puzhou's Hongchuankou; and Fan County's Cacun River dike.

sentences.zh: 築三河決堤。

translations.literal: Breached dikes at Sanhe were built up.
translations.idiomatic: Breached dikes at Sanhe were repaired.

sentences.zh: 浚海州官河二百四十里。

translations.literal: The official canal in Haizhou was dredged for 240 li.
translations.idiomatic: Haizhou's official canal was dredged for 240 li.

sentences.zh: 解州民言：「臨晉涑水河逆流，決姚暹渠堰，入砂地，淹民田，將及鹽池。」

translations.literal: The people of Xie Prefecture said: "The Suishui River at Linjin flows backward, breached the Yaoqian Canal weir, entered sandy ground, inundated the people's fields, and is about to reach the salt ponds."
translations.idiomatic: The people of Xie Prefecture reported: "The Suishui River at Linjin is flowing backward, has burst the Yaoqian Canal weir, spread into sandy ground, flooded farmland, and is nearing the salt ponds.

sentences.zh: 尋又言：「硝池水溢，決豁口，入鹽池。」

translations.literal: Soon they reported again: "Nitrate pond water overflowed, burst through a gap, and entered the salt ponds."
translations.idiomatic: They soon reported again: "Nitrate-pond water has overflowed, broken through a breach, and entered the salt ponds.

sentences.zh: 以涑水渠、姚暹渠並流，故命官修築如其請。

translations.literal: Because the Suishui Canal and Yaoqian Canal flowed together, officials were ordered to repair and build as they had requested.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Suishui and Yaoqian canals had merged, officials were ordered to carry out repairs as requested.

sentences.zh: 十三年，修興濟決岸、南京羽林右衛刁家圩屯田堤。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, the breached bank at Xingji and the Dijia polder colony dike of the Right Yulin Guard in Nanjing were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, Xingji's breached bank and the Dijia polder colony dike of Nanjing's Right Yulin Guard were repaired.

sentences.zh: 吳江縣丞李升言：「蘇、鬆水患，太湖為甚，急宜泄其下流。

translations.literal: Li Sheng, assistant magistrate of Wujiang, said: "Suzhou and Songjiang suffer from water disasters, Lake Tai especially; it is urgent to release its lower outflow.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sheng, assistant magistrate of Wujiang, reported: "Suzhou and Songjiang are afflicted by flooding, Lake Tai above all; its lower outflow must be opened without delay.

sentences.zh: 若常熟白茆諸港，崑山千墩等河，長洲十八都港汊，吳縣、無錫近湖河道，皆宜循其故跡，浚而深之。

translations.literal: Such harbors as Baimao in Changshu, rivers such as Qiandun in Kunshan, the harbor branches in the Eighteenth Ward of Changzhou, and the lake-adjacent channels in Wu and Wuxi counties should all follow their old traces and be dredged deeper.
translations.idiomatic: Harbors such as Baimao in Changshu, rivers such as Qiandun in Kunshan, the harbor branches in Changzhou's Eighteenth Ward, and the lake-side channels in Wu and Wuxi counties should all be traced to their former courses and dredged deep.

sentences.zh: 乃修蔡涇等閘，候潮來往，以時啟閉。

translations.literal: Then sluice gates such as at Caijing should be repaired, awaiting the tide's coming and going and opening and closing them at proper times.
translations.idiomatic: Sluice gates such as those at Caijing should be rebuilt and opened and closed in time with the tides.

sentences.zh: 則氾濫可免，而民獲耕種之利。」

translations.literal: Then flooding can be avoided and the people will gain the benefit of planting and harvest."
translations.idiomatic: Flooding would then be averted and the people would regain the benefit of cultivation.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: [The court] assented.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 十五年修固安孫家口及臨漳固塚堤岸。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Sunjiakou in Gu'an and the Guzhong dike in Linzhang were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, Sunjiakou in Gu'an and the Guzhong dike in Linzhang were repaired.

sentences.zh: 十六年，修魏縣決岸。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, the breached bank in Wei County was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, Wei County's breached bank was repaired.

sentences.zh: 十七年，蕭山民言：「境內河渠四十五里，溉田萬頃，比年淤塞。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, the people of Xiaoshan said: "The rivers and canals within our jurisdiction extend forty-five li and irrigate ten thousand qing; in recent years they have silted up.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, the people of Xiaoshan reported: "Rivers and canals within the county run forty-five li and irrigate ten thousand qing, but in recent years they have silted shut.

sentences.zh: 乞疏浚，仍置閘錢清小江壩東，庶旱潦無憂。」

translations.literal: We beg that they be dredged, and sluice gates placed east of the Qianqing Xiaojiang Dam, so drought and flood need not be feared."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that they be dredged and sluice gates installed east of the Qianqing Xiaojiang Dam, so that drought and flood may both be borne without fear.

sentences.zh: 山東新城民言：「縣東鄭黃溝源出淄川，下流壅沮，霖潦妨農。

translations.literal: The people of Xincheng in Shandong said: "Zhenghuang Ditch east of the county rises in Zichuan; its lower course is blocked and stagnant, and torrential rains hinder farming.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Xincheng in Shandong reported: "Zhenghuang Ditch east of the county rises in Zichuan, but its lower reach is choked and stagnant, and heavy rains are ruining the crops.

sentences.zh: 陳家莊南有乾河，上與溝接，下通烏江，乞浚治。」

translations.literal: South of Chenjiazhuang is the Gan River, which connects above with the ditch and below with Wujiang; we beg that it be dredged and repaired."
translations.idiomatic: South of Chenjiazhuang lies the Gan River, which joins the ditch above and reaches Wujiang below; we ask that it be dredged and restored.

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: Both [requests] were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Both petitions were approved.

sentences.zh: 十八年，海甯諸縣民言：「潮沒海塘二千六百餘丈，延及吳家等壩。」

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, the people of Haining and other counties said: "Tides have swallowed more than 2,600 zhang of seawall, extending to dams such as Wujia."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, the people of Haining and neighboring counties reported: "Tides have destroyed more than 2,600 zhang of seawall, reaching dams such as Wujia.

sentences.zh: 通政嶽福亦言：「仁和、海寧壞長降等壩，淪海千五百餘丈。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Yue Fu also reported: "At dams such as Changjiang in Renhe and Haining, more than 1,500 zhang have been lost to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Yue Fu also reported: "At dams such as Changjiang in Renhe and Haining, more than 1,500 zhang have been lost to the sea.

sentences.zh: 東岸赭山、嚴門山、蜀山舊有海道，淤絕久，故西岸潮愈猛。

translations.literal: On the east shore at Zheshan, Yanmenshan, and Shushan there were formerly sea channels, long silted shut, so tides on the west shore have grown fiercer.
translations.idiomatic: On the east shore at Zheshan, Yanmenshan, and Shushan there were once sea channels, long since silted closed, which is why tides on the west shore have grown fiercer.

sentences.zh: 乞以軍民修築。」

translations.literal: We beg that troops and civilians be used to repair and build."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that soldiers and civilians be mobilized for the repairs.

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: Both were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Both requests were approved.

sentences.zh: 明年修海寧等縣塘岸。

translations.literal: The next year, seawall embankments in Haining and other counties were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, seawall embankments in Haining and other counties were repaired.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，修嘉定抵松江潮圮圩岸五千餘丈、交恥順化衛決堤百餘丈。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, more than 5,000 zhang of tide-collapsed polder dikes from Jiading to Songjiang were repaired, and more than 100 zhang of breached dikes at Shunhua Guard in Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, more than 5,000 zhang of tide-wrecked polder dikes from Jiading to Songjiang were repaired, along with more than 100 zhang of breached dikes at Jiaozhi's Shunhua Guard.

sentences.zh: 文水民言：「文谷山常稔渠分引文穀河流，袤三十餘里，灌田。

translations.literal: The people of Wenshui said: "The Changren Canal on Wengu Mountain branches off the Wengu River, extending more than thirty li and irrigating fields.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Wenshui reported: "The Changren Canal on Wengu Mountain draws off the Wengu River, runs more than thirty li, and irrigates farmland.

sentences.zh: 今河潰泄水。」

translations.literal: Now the river has breached and the water is leaking away."
translations.idiomatic: The river has now breached and the water is draining away.

sentences.zh: 從其奏，葺治之。

translations.literal: [The court] granted their memorial and repaired it.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved their memorial and ordered repairs.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，修臨海廣濟河閘。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, the sluice on the Guangji River in Linhai was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, the sluice on Linhai's Guangji River was repaired.

sentences.zh: 洪熙元年修黃巖濱海閘壩。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongxi, the coastal sluice dam at Huangyan was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongxi 1, Huangyan's coastal sluice dam was repaired.

sentences.zh: 視永樂初，增府判一員，專其事。

translations.literal: Compared with the early Yongle period, one assistant prefect was added to manage the matter exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: Compared with the early Yongle reign, one assistant prefect was added to oversee the work exclusively.

sentences.zh: 修獻縣、鐃陽恭儉堤及窯堤口。

translations.literal: The Gongjian dike in Xian and Raoyang counties and Yaodikou were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: The Gongjian dike in Xian and Raoyang counties and Yaodikou were repaired.

sentences.zh: 宣德二年，浙江歸安知縣華嵩言：「涇陽洪渠堰溉五縣田八千四百餘頃。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuande, Hua Song, magistrate of Gui'an in Zhejiang, said: "The Hongqu Weir in Jingyang irrigates more than 8,400 qing across five counties.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande 2, Hua Song, magistrate of Gui'an in Zhejiang, reported: "The Hongqu Weir in Jingyang irrigates more than 8,400 qing across five counties.

sentences.zh: 洪武時，長興侯耿炳文前後修浚，未久堰壞。

translations.literal: During Hongwu, the Marquis of Changxing, Geng Bingwen, dredged and repaired it repeatedly, but before long the weir broke again.
translations.idiomatic: During the Hongwu reign, the Marquis of Changxing, Geng Bingwen, dredged and repaired it more than once, yet the weir broke again before long.

sentences.zh: 永樂間，老人徐齡言於朝，遣官修築，會營造不果。

translations.literal: During Yongle, the elder Xu Ling spoke to the court; officials were dispatched to repair and build, but construction projects intervened and it was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: During Yongle, the elder Xu Ling petitioned the court and officials were sent to rebuild the works, but other construction projects intervened and the work was never completed.

sentences.zh: 乞專命大臣起軍夫協治。」

translations.literal: We beg that a high minister be especially appointed to mobilize corvée soldiers and laborers for cooperative repairs."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that a senior minister be specially appointed to mobilize soldiers and corvée labor for a joint repair effort.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: [The court] assented.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the request.

sentences.zh: 三年修灌縣都江等堰四十四。

translations.literal: In the third year, forty-four weirs including Dujiang in Guan County were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, forty-four weirs including Dujiang in Guan County were repaired.

sentences.zh: 臨海民言：「胡巉諸閘瀦水灌田，近年閘壞而金鰲、大浦、湖淶、舉嶼等河遂皆壅阻，乞為開築。」

translations.literal: The people of Linhai said: "Sluice gates such as at Huyan impound water to irrigate fields; in recent years the gates broke, and rivers such as Jin'ao, Dapu, Hulai, and Juyu all became blocked; we beg that they be opened and built."
translations.idiomatic: The people of Linhai reported: "Sluice gates such as those at Huyan hold back water to irrigate fields, but in recent years the gates have broken and rivers such as Jin'ao, Dapu, Hulai, and Juyu are all choked; we ask that they be reopened and rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「水利急務，使民自訴於朝，此守令不得人爾。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Water conservancy is an urgent task; that the people must petition the court themselves—this means the prefects and magistrates are not the right men."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Waterworks are urgent business. When the people must petition the court themselves, it shows that the prefects and magistrates are not the right men for their posts.

sentences.zh: 命工部即飭郡縣秋收起工。

translations.literal: He ordered the Ministry of Works at once to instruct prefectures and counties to begin work after the autumn harvest.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the Ministry of Works to instruct the prefectures and counties to begin work immediately after the autumn harvest.

sentences.zh: 仍詔天下：「凡水利當興者，有司即舉行，毋緩視。」

translations.literal: He also decreed to the empire: "Wherever water conservancy should be undertaken, local officials shall carry it out at once; they must not treat it lightly."
translations.idiomatic: He also issued an edict to the empire: "Wherever waterworks ought to be undertaken, local officials shall act at once and must not neglect them."

sentences.zh: 巡按江西御史許勝言：「南昌瑞河兩岸低窪，多良田。

translations.literal: Xu Sheng, touring censor of Jiangxi, said: "Both banks of the Rui River in Nanchang are low-lying and hold much good farmland.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Sheng, the touring censor of Jiangxi, reported: "Both banks of the Rui River at Nanchang are low-lying and hold much good farmland.

sentences.zh: 洪武間修築，水不為患。

translations.literal: Built and repaired during Hongwu, water was not a threat.
translations.idiomatic: After repairs during the Hongwu reign, the river no longer caused harm.

sentences.zh: 比年水溢，岸圮二十餘處。

translations.literal: In recent years water has overflowed and more than twenty stretches of bank have collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years the river has overflowed and more than twenty stretches of bank have collapsed.

sentences.zh: 豐城安沙繩灣圩岸三千六百餘丈，永樂間水沖，改修百三十餘丈。

translations.literal: More than 3,600 zhang of polder bank at Shengwan in Ansha, Fengcheng; during Yongle water washed it away and more than 130 zhang were rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: More than 3,600 zhang of polder bank at Shengwan in Ansha, Fengcheng, were washed away during Yongle and more than 130 zhang were rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 近者久雨，江漲堤壞。

translations.literal: Recently, prolonged rain raised the river and the dikes broke.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, prolonged rain swelled the river and the dikes gave way.

sentences.zh: 乞敕有司募夫修理。」

translations.literal: We beg that local officials be ordered to recruit laborers for repairs."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that local officials be ordered to recruit laborers for the repairs.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人陸伯倫言：「常熟七浦塘東西百里，灌常熟、崑山田，歲租二十餘萬石。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Lu Bolun said: "Qipu Pond in Changshu extends east and west for a hundred li, irrigating fields in Changshu and Kunshan; annual grain tribute exceeds 200,000 shi.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Lu Bolun reported: "Qipu Pond in Changshu runs a hundred li east to west, irrigating fields in Changshu and Kunshan and yielding more than 200,000 shi in annual grain tribute.

sentences.zh: 乞聽民自浚之。」

translations.literal: We beg that the people be allowed to dredge it themselves."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the people be permitted to dredge it themselves.

sentences.zh: 皆詔可。

translations.literal: All were approved by imperial decree.
translations.idiomatic: All the petitions were approved by imperial decree.

sentences.zh: 四年，修獻縣柳林口堤岸。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the dike at Liulin Mouth in Xian County was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, the dike at Liulin Mouth in Xian County was repaired.

sentences.zh: 潛江民言：「蚌湖、陽湖皆臨襄河，水漲岸決，害荊州三衛、荊門、江陵諸州縣官民屯田無算。

translations.literal: The people of Qianjiang said: "Banghu and Yanghu both border the Xiang River; when water rises the banks breach, harming beyond reckoning the official and civilian colony fields of the three Jingzhou guards, Jingmen, Jiangling, and other prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Qianjiang reported: "Banghu and Yanghu both lie on the Xiang River; when the water rises the banks break, damaging beyond reckoning the official and civilian colony fields of the three Jingzhou guards and the prefectures and counties of Jingmen, Jiangling, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 乞發軍民築治。」

translations.literal: We beg that troops and civilians be mobilized to build and repair."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that soldiers and civilians be mobilized for the repairs."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: [The court] assented.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the request.

sentences.zh: 福清民言：「光賢裏官民田百餘頃，堤障海水。

translations.literal: The people of Fuqing said: "More than 100 qing of official and civilian fields in Guangxian Village are protected by dikes against seawater.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Fuqing reported: "More than 100 qing of official and civilian fields in Guangxian Village are protected from the sea by dikes.

sentences.zh: 堤壞久，田盡荒。

translations.literal: The dikes have been broken a long time and the fields are wholly wasteland.
translations.idiomatic: The dikes have long been ruined and the fields lie wholly fallow.

sentences.zh: 永樂中，嘗命修治，迄今未舉，民不得耕。」

translations.literal: During Yongle, repairs were once ordered, but to this day nothing has been done and the people cannot farm."
translations.idiomatic: During Yongle repairs were once ordered, yet to this day nothing has been done and the people cannot cultivate the land.

sentences.zh: 帝責有司亟治，而諭尚書吳中嚴飭郡邑，陂池堤堰及時修浚，慢者治以罪。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked local officials to repair it at once, and instructed Minister Wu Zhong to strictly order prefectures and counties to repair ponds, pools, dikes, and weirs in timely fashion; those who were negligent would be punished.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked the local officials and ordered immediate repairs, and instructed Minister Wu Zhong to strictly require prefectures and counties to maintain ponds, reservoirs, dikes, and weirs in good repair; negligent officials would be punished.

sentences.zh: 五年，巡撫侍郎成均言：「海鹽去海二里，石嵌土岸二千四百餘丈，水齧其石，皆已刓敝。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Vice Minister and Grand Coordinator Cheng Jun said: "Haiyan lies two li from the sea; more than 2,400 zhang of stone-inlaid earthen bank—the water has gnawed at the stones and all are worn down.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Vice Minister and Grand Coordinator Cheng Jun reported: "Haiyan lies two li from the sea; more than 2,400 zhang of stone-faced earthen bank have been worn away where the water gnaws at the stones.

sentences.zh: 議築新石於岸內，而存其舊者以為外障。

translations.literal: It is proposed to build new stone on the inner side of the bank while keeping the old as an outer barrier.
translations.idiomatic: It is proposed to set new stonework on the inner side of the bank while retaining the old facing as an outer barrier.

sentences.zh: 乞如洪武中令嘉、嚴、紹三府協夫舉工。」

translations.literal: We beg that, as in Hongwu, the three prefectures of Jia, Yan, and Shao be ordered to supply corvée jointly for the work."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that, as in the Hongwu reign, the three prefectures of Jiaxing, Yanzhou, and Shaoxing be ordered to supply corvée jointly for the work.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: [The court] assented.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 六年，修瀏陽、廣濟諸縣堤堰，豐城西北臨江石堤及西南七圩壩，石首臨江三堤。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, dikes and weirs in Liuyang, Guangji, and other counties were repaired; the stone dike along the river in northwest Fengcheng and the seven polder dams in the southwest; and three riverfront dikes in Shishou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, dikes and weirs in Liuyang, Guangji, and other counties were repaired, along with the northwest riverfront stone dike and seven southwestern polder dams in Fengcheng and three riverfront dikes in Shishou.

sentences.zh: 浚餘姚舊河池。

translations.literal: The old river pool in Yuyao was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Yuyao's old river pool was dredged.

sentences.zh: 巡撫侍郎周忱言：「溧水永豐圩周圍八十餘里，環以丹陽、石臼諸湖。

translations.literal: Vice Minister and Grand Coordinator Zhou Chen said: "Yongfeng Polder in Lishui extends more than eighty li in circuit, encircled by lakes such as Danyang and Shijiu.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister and Grand Coordinator Zhou Chen reported: "Yongfeng Polder in Lishui runs more than eighty li in circuit and is ringed by lakes such as Danyang and Shijiu.

sentences.zh: 舊築埂壩，通陟門石塔，農甚利之。

translations.literal: Embankment dams were formerly built, connecting Shengmen and Shita; farming greatly benefited.
translations.idiomatic: Embankment dams were once built linking Shengmen and Shita, greatly benefiting agriculture.

sentences.zh: 今頹敗，請葺治。」

translations.literal: Now they have collapsed; we request repairs."
translations.idiomatic: They have now fallen into ruin; we ask that they be restored.

sentences.zh: 教諭唐敏言：「常熟耿涇塘，南接梅裏，通昆承湖，北達大江。

translations.literal: Instructor Tang Min said: "Gengjing Pond in Changshu connects south to Meili and Lake Kun-Cheng, and reaches north to the great river.
translations.idiomatic: Instructor Tang Min reported: "Gengjing Pond in Changshu joins Meili to the south and Lake Kun-Cheng, and reaches the great river to the north.

sentences.zh: 洪武中，浚以溉田。

translations.literal: During Hongwu it was dredged to irrigate fields.
translations.idiomatic: During the Hongwu reign it was dredged to irrigate fields.

sentences.zh: 今壅阻，請疏導。」

translations.literal: Now it is blocked; we request dredging and clearing."
translations.idiomatic: It is now choked; we ask that it be dredged and cleared.

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: Both were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Both petitions were approved.

sentences.zh: 七年，修眉州新津通濟堰。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, the Tongji Weir at Xinjin in Meizhou was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, the Tongji Weir at Xinjin in Meizhou was repaired.

sentences.zh: 堰水出彭山，分十六渠，溉田二萬五千餘畝。

translations.literal: Its water issues from Peng Mountain, divides into sixteen channels, and irrigates more than 25,000 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Its waters rise on Peng Mountain, divide into sixteen channels, and irrigate more than 25,000 mu.

sentences.zh: 河東鹽運使言：「鹽池近地姚暹河，流入五星湖轉黃流河，兩岸窪下。

translations.literal: The Salt Transport Commissioner of Hedong said: "The Yaoqian River near the salt ponds flows into Wuxing Lake and then turns into the Huangliu River; both banks are low-lying.
translations.idiomatic: The Hedong Salt Transport Commissioner reported: "The Yaoqian River near the salt ponds flows into Wuxing Lake and then into the Huangliu River; both banks are low-lying.

sentences.zh: 比歲雨溢水漲，沖至解州。

translations.literal: In recent years rain has overflowed and water risen, rushing as far as Xie Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years heavy rains have swollen the waters, which have rushed as far as Xie Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 浪益急，遂潰南岸，沒民田三十餘里，鹽池護堤皆壞。

translations.literal: The waves grew fiercer, the south bank burst, more than thirty li of people's fields were submerged, and all protective dikes around the salt ponds were ruined.
translations.idiomatic: The surge grew fiercer, the south bank gave way, more than thirty li of farmland was submerged, and all the protective dikes around the salt ponds were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 復因下流涑水河高，壅淤逆流，姚暹以決。

translations.literal: Moreover, because the lower Suishui River was higher, silt built up and water flowed backward, and Yaoqian breached.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, because the lower Suishui River stood higher, silt accumulated and the current reversed, causing Yaoqian to breach.

sentences.zh: 乞起民夫疏瀹。」

translations.literal: We beg that civilian corvée be mobilized to dredge and clear."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that civilian corvée be mobilized to dredge and clear the channels.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: [The court] assented.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the request.

sentences.zh: 蘇州知府況鐘言：「蘇、鬆、嘉、湖湖有六，曰太湖、龐山、陽城、沙湖、昆承、尚湖。

translations.literal: Kuang Zhong, prefect of Suzhou, said: "Among Suzhou, Song, Jia, and Hu there are six lakes, called Tai Lake, Pangshan, Yangcheng, Shahu, Kun-Cheng, and Shang Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Kuang Zhong, prefect of Suzhou, reported: "In Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and the Lake region there are six lakes: Tai Lake, Pangshan, Yangcheng, Shahu, Kun-Cheng, and Shang Lake.

sentences.zh: 永樂初，夏原吉浚導，今復淤。

translations.literal: At the start of Yongle, Xia Yuanji dredged and cleared them; now they have silted up again.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Yongle reign, Xia Yuanji dredged and cleared them, but they have silted up again.

sentences.zh: 乞遣大臣疏浚。」

translations.literal: We beg that a senior minister be dispatched to dredge them."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that a senior minister be dispatched to dredge them.

sentences.zh: 乃命周忱與鐘治之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Zhou Chen and Zhong were ordered to manage the work.
translations.idiomatic: The court then ordered Zhou Chen and Zhong to oversee the dredging.

sentences.zh: 是歲，汾河驟溢，敗太原堤。

translations.literal: That year, the Fen River suddenly overflowed and breached the Taiyuan dikes.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Fen River surged over its banks and destroyed the Taiyuan dikes.

sentences.zh: 鎮守都司李謙、巡按御史徐傑以便宜修治，然後馳奏。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Li Qian and Censor-in-Tour Xu Jie repaired them under emergency authority and then sent urgent memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Li Qian and touring censor Xu Jie repaired the dikes under emergency authority and then reported by urgent dispatch.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉獎之。

translations.literal: The emperor commended and rewarded them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended and rewarded them.

sentences.zh: 八年，葺湖廣偏橋衛高陂石洞，完縣南關舊河。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the stone sluice at Gaopo in Bianqiao Guard, Huguang, was restored; the old river at the south gate of Wan County was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, the Gaopo stone sluice at Bianqiao Guard in Huguang was restored and Wan County's old river at the south gate was completed.

sentences.zh: 復和州銅城堰閘。

translations.literal: The Tongcheng Weir and sluice at He Prefecture were restored.
translations.idiomatic: He Prefecture's Tongcheng Weir and sluice were restored.

sentences.zh: 修安陽廣惠等渠，磁州滏陽河、五爪濟民渠。

translations.literal: The Guanghui and other canals in Anyang were repaired; the Fuyang River and the Wuzhao Jimin Canal in Ci Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Guanghui and other canals in Anyang were repaired, along with Ci Prefecture's Fuyang River and the Wuzhao Jimin Canal.

sentences.zh: 九年修江陵枝江沿江堤岸。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, the riverfront dikes at Zhijiang in Jiangling were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, Jiangling's Zhijiang riverfront dikes were repaired.

sentences.zh: 築薊州決岸。

translations.literal: Breached banks at Ji Prefecture were built up.
translations.idiomatic: Breached banks at Ji Prefecture were repaired.

sentences.zh: 毀蘇、鬆民私築堤堰。

translations.literal: Privately built dikes and weirs by the people of Suzhou and Song were demolished.
translations.idiomatic: Privately built dikes and weirs in Suzhou and Songjiang were demolished.

sentences.zh: 十年築海鹽潮決海塘千五百餘丈。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, more than 1,500 zhang of seadike breached by tides at Haiyan was built up.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, more than 1,500 zhang of seadike torn open by tidal surges at Haiyan was rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 主事沈中言：「山陰西小江，上通金、嚴，下接三江海口，引諸暨、浦江、義烏諸湖水以通舟。

translations.literal: Section Director Shen Zhong said: "The West Small River in Shanyin connects upstream to Jinhua and Yanzhou and downstream to the estuary of the Three Rivers, drawing lake waters from Zhuji, Pujiang, and Yiwu to permit boats to pass.
translations.idiomatic: Section Director Shen Zhong reported: "Shanyin's West Small River connects upstream to Jinhua and Yanzhou and downstream to the Three Rivers estuary, channeling lake waters from Zhuji, Pujiang, and Yiwu to allow navigation.

sentences.zh: 江口近淤，宜築臨浦戚堰障諸湖水，俾仍出小江。」

translations.literal: The river mouth is recently silted; it is fitting to build the Linpu Qi Weir to block the various lake waters and make them still issue through the small river."
translations.idiomatic: The river mouth has recently silted up; a Linpu Qi Weir should be built to hold back the lake waters and keep their discharge through the small river.

sentences.zh: 詔部覆奪。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the ministry to review, and the proposal was rejected.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the ministry to review the proposal, which was then rejected.

sentences.zh: 正統元年，修吉安沿江堤。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhengtong, the riverfront dikes at Ji'an were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 1, Ji'an's riverfront dikes were repaired.

sentences.zh: 築海陽、登雲、都雲、步村等決堤。

translations.literal: Breached dikes at Haiyang, Dengyun, Duyun, Bucun, and elsewhere were built up.
translations.idiomatic: Breached dikes at Haiyang, Dengyun, Duyun, Bucun, and elsewhere were repaired.

sentences.zh: 浚陝西西安灞橋河。

translations.literal: The Baqiao River at Xi'an in Shaanxi was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Xi'an's Baqiao River in Shaanxi was dredged.

sentences.zh: 二年築蠡縣王家等決口。

translations.literal: In the second year, breached openings at Wangjia and elsewhere in Li County were built up.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, breached openings at Wangjia and elsewhere in Li County were repaired.

sentences.zh: 修新會鸞臺山至瓦塘浦頹岸，江陵、鬆滋、公安、石首、潛江、監利近江決堤。

translations.literal: Collapsed banks from Luantai Mountain to Watang Estuary in Xinhui were repaired; river-adjacent breached dikes in Jiangling, Songzi, Gong'an, Shishou, Qianjiang, and Jianli.
translations.idiomatic: Collapsed banks from Luantai Mountain to Watang Estuary in Xinhui were repaired, along with river-adjacent breached dikes in Jiangling, Songzi, Gong'an, Shishou, Qianjiang, and Jianli.

sentences.zh: 又修湖廣老龍堤，以為漢水所潰也。

translations.literal: The Old Dragon Dike in Huguang was also repaired, for it had been breached by the Han River.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang's Old Dragon Dike was also repaired, as it had been breached by the Han River.

sentences.zh: 三年疏泰興順德鄉三渠，引湖溉田；

translations.literal: In the third year, three channels in Shunde Township, Taixing, were cleared to draw lake water and irrigate fields;
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, three channels in Taixing's Shunde Township were cleared to draw lake water for irrigation;

sentences.zh: 潞州永祿等溝渠二十八道，通於漳河。

translations.literal: twenty-eight ditches and channels such as Yonglu in Lu Prefecture, connecting to the Zhang River.
translations.idiomatic: and twenty-eight ditches and channels including Yonglu in Lu Prefecture were opened to the Zhang River.

sentences.zh: 四年修容城杜村口堤。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the dike at Ducun Estuary in Rongcheng was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Rongcheng's dike at Ducun Estuary was repaired.

sentences.zh: 設正陽門外減水河，並疏城內溝渠。

translations.literal: A flood-relief river was established outside Zhengyang Gate, and ditches and channels within the city were cleared.
translations.idiomatic: A flood-relief channel was established outside Zhengyang Gate, and the city's ditches and drains were cleared.

sentences.zh: 荊州民言：「城西江水高城十餘丈，霖潦壞堤，水即灌城。

translations.literal: The people of Jingzhou said: "The river west of the city stands more than ten zhang above the city; torrential rains ruin the dikes, and water at once floods the city.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Jingzhou reported: "West of the city the river stands more than ten zhang above ground; heavy rains destroy the dikes and water immediately floods the city.

sentences.zh: 請先事修治。」

translations.literal: We request preventive repairs beforehand."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that repairs be carried out in advance.

sentences.zh: 寧夏巡撫都御史金濂言：「鎮有五渠，資以行溉，今明沙州七星、漢伯、石灰三渠久塞。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-Chief Jin Lian of Ningxia said: "The garrison has five channels relied upon for irrigation; now the three channels at Qixing, Hanbo, and Shihui in Mingsha Prefecture have long been blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-Chief Jin Lian of Ningxia reported: "The garrison has five irrigation channels, but the three at Qixing, Hanbo, and Shihui in Mingsha Prefecture have long been blocked.

sentences.zh: 請用夫四萬疏浚，溉蕪田千三百餘頃。」

translations.literal: We request the use of forty thousand laborers to dredge them, irrigating more than 1,300 qing of overgrown fields."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that forty thousand laborers be mobilized to dredge them and irrigate more than 1,300 qing of abandoned farmland.

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: Both petitions were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Both petitions were approved.

sentences.zh: 五年，修太湖堤，海鹽海岸，南京上中下新河及濟川衛新江口防水堤，漷縣、南宮諸堤。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the Tai Lake dikes, the Haiyan seacoast, the upper, middle, and lower new rivers at Nanjing and the flood-control dikes at Xinjing Estuary in Jichuan Guard, and dikes in Huo County, Nangong, and elsewhere were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Tai Lake dikes, the Haiyan coast, Nanjing's upper, middle, and lower new rivers and Jichuan Guard's flood-control dikes at Xinjing Estuary, and dikes in Huo County, Nangong, and elsewhere were repaired.

sentences.zh: 築順天、河間及容城杜村口、郎家口決堤。

translations.literal: Breached dikes in Shuntian, Hejian, and at Ducun Estuary and Langjia Estuary in Rongcheng were built up.
translations.idiomatic: Breached dikes in Shuntian, Hejian, and at Rongcheng's Ducun and Langjia estuaries were repaired.

sentences.zh: 塞海寧蠣巖決堤口。

translations.literal: The breached dike opening at Liyan in Haining was blocked.
translations.idiomatic: The breached dike opening at Liyan in Haining was sealed.

sentences.zh: 浚鹽城伍祐、新興二場運河。

translations.literal: The transport canals at the Wuyou and Xinxing saltworks in Yancheng were dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Yancheng's transport canals at the Wuyou and Xinxing saltworks were dredged.

sentences.zh: 初，溧水有鎮曰廣通，其西固城湖入大江，東則三塔堰河入太湖。

translations.literal: Initially, Lishui had a market town called Guangtong; westward Gucheng Lake entered the great river, and eastward the Sanba Weir River entered Tai Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, Lishui had a market town called Guangtong; to the west Gucheng Lake flowed into the great river, and to the east the Sanba Weir River flowed into Tai Lake.

sentences.zh: 中間相距十五里，洪武中鑿以通舟。

translations.literal: The distance between them was fifteen li; during Hongwu a channel was cut to permit boats to pass.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen li separated the two, and during the Hongwu reign a channel was excavated to allow navigation.

sentences.zh: 縣地稍ＡＨ，而湖納甯國、廣德諸水，遇潦即溢，乃築壩於鎮以禦之，而堰水不能至壩下。

translations.literal: The county's terrain was slightly low-lying, and the lake received waters from Ningguo, Guangde, and elsewhere; when floods came it overflowed, so a dam was built at the town to defend against it, yet weir water could not reach below the dam.
