translations.idiomatic: The county's land lay slightly low, and the lake received waters from Ningguo, Guangde, and elsewhere; when floods came it spilled over, so a dam was built at the town to hold the water back, but the weir waters could not reach below the dam.

sentences.zh: 是歲，改築壩於葉家橋。

translations.literal: That year, the dam was rebuilt at Ye Family Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: That year the dam was relocated and rebuilt at Ye Family Bridge.

sentences.zh: 胭脂河者，溧水入秦淮道也。

translations.literal: Yanzhi River is the channel by which Lishui enters the Qinhuai.
translations.idiomatic: The Yanzhi River is Lishui's channel into the Qinhuai.

sentences.zh: 蘇、鬆船皆由以達，沙石壅塞，因並浚之。

translations.literal: Boats from Suzhou and Song all passed through it to reach their destinations; sand and stone had choked it, so it was dredged as well.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou and Songjiang boats all passed through it; sand and stone had choked the channel, so it was dredged as well.

sentences.zh: 山陽涇河壩，上接漕河，下達鹽城，舊置絞關以通舟，歲久且敝，又恐盜泄水利，遂築塞河口。

translations.literal: At the Jing River Dam in Shanyang, upstream connecting to the transport canal and downstream reaching Yancheng, a rope sluice had formerly been installed to permit boats to pass; after long years it was worn out, and fearing theft of water resources, the river mouth was built up and blocked.
translations.idiomatic: At Shanyang's Jing River Dam, which connects upstream to the transport canal and downstream to Yancheng, a rope sluice had once allowed boats through; after long years it had decayed, and fearing illicit drainage of irrigation water, the river mouth was blocked up.

sentences.zh: 是歲，從民請，修壩並復絞關。

translations.literal: That year, at the people's request, the dam was repaired and the rope sluice restored.
translations.idiomatic: That year, at the people's request, the dam was repaired and the rope sluice restored.

sentences.zh: 六年，造宣武門東城河南岸橋。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, a bridge was built on the south bank of the eastern city moat outside Xuanwu Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, a bridge was built on the south bank of the eastern moat outside Xuanwu Gate.

sentences.zh: 修江米巷玉河橋及堤，並浚京城西南河。

translations.literal: The Yuhe Bridge and its dike at Jiangmi Lane were repaired, and the southwestern river within the capital was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuhe Bridge and its embankment at Jiangmi Lane were repaired, and the southwestern river within the capital was dredged.

sentences.zh: 築豐城沙月諸河堤、蕪湖陶辛圩新埂。

translations.literal: River dikes at Shayue and elsewhere in Fengcheng were built up; new embankments at Taoxin Polder in Wuhu.
translations.idiomatic: River dikes at Shayue and elsewhere in Fengcheng were built up, along with new embankments at Wuhu's Taoxin Polder.

sentences.zh: 浚海寧官河及花塘河、硤石橋塘河，築瓦石堰二所。

translations.literal: The official canal in Haining and the Huatang River and Qiaoshi Bridge Pond River were dredged; two tile-and-stone weirs were built.
translations.idiomatic: Haining's official canal, the Huatang River, and the Qiaoshi Bridge Pond River were dredged, and two tile-and-stone weirs were built.

sentences.zh: 疏南京江洲，殺其水勢，以便修築塌岸。

translations.literal: Sandbars in the Yangtze at Nanjing were cleared to reduce the water's force and facilitate repair of collapsed banks.
translations.idiomatic: Yangtze sandbars at Nanjing were cleared to reduce the current and facilitate repair of collapsed banks.

sentences.zh: 高郵知州韓簡言：「官河上下二閘皆圮，河亦不通，且子嬰溝塞，減水陰洞閉，致旱澇無所濟。

translations.literal: Han Jian, prefect of Gaoyou, said: "Both the upper and lower sluices on the official canal have collapsed, the canal is impassable, Ziying Ditch is blocked, and the flood-relief culverts are closed, so neither drought nor flood can be mitigated.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jian, prefect of Gaoyou, reported: "Both upper and lower sluices on the official canal have collapsed, the canal is blocked, Ziying Ditch is choked, and the flood-relief culverts are shut, so neither drought nor flood can be relieved.

sentences.zh: 俱乞浚治。」

translations.literal: We beg that all be dredged and repaired."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that all be dredged and repaired.

sentences.zh: 詔部核實以行。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the ministry to verify the facts and act accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the ministry to verify the facts and carry out the repairs.

sentences.zh: 七年，修江西廣昌江岸、蕭山長山浦海塘、彭山通濟堰。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, the Jiang riverbank at Guangchang in Jiangxi, the seadike at Changshan Estuary in Xiaoshan, and the Tongji Weir at Peng Mountain were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Guangchang's Jiang riverbank in Jiangxi, Xiaoshan's Changshan Estuary seadike, and Peng Mountain's Tongji Weir were repaired.

sentences.zh: 築南京浦子口、大勝關堤，九江及武昌臨江塌岸。

translations.literal: Dikes at Puzikou and Dasheng Pass in Nanjing were built up; collapsed riverfront banks at Jiujiang and Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: Dikes at Nanjing's Puzikou and Dasheng Pass were built up, along with collapsed riverfront banks at Jiujiang and Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 浚江陵、荊門、潛江淤沙三十餘里。

translations.literal: Silt buildup for more than thirty li in Jiangling, Jingmen, and Qianjiang was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: More than thirty li of silt in Jiangling, Jingmen, and Qianjiang was dredged.

sentences.zh: 八年修蘭溪卸橋浦口堤，弋陽官陂三所。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the dike at Xieqiao Estuary in Lanxi and three official reservoirs in Yiyang were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Lanxi's dike at Xieqiao Estuary and three official reservoirs in Yiyang were repaired.

sentences.zh: 浚南京城河。

translations.literal: The city moat at Nanjing was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Nanjing's city moat was dredged.

sentences.zh: 九年，修德州耿家灣等堤岸、杞縣離溝堤。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, embankments at Gengjia Bay and elsewhere in Dezhou and the Ligo Dike in Qi County were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, embankments at Dezhou's Gengjia Bay and elsewhere and Qi County's Ligo Dike were repaired.

sentences.zh: 築容城杜村堤決口。

translations.literal: The breached opening in the Ducun Dike in Rongcheng was built up.
translations.idiomatic: The breach in Rongcheng's Ducun Dike was repaired.

sentences.zh: 易上虞菱湖土壩為石閘。

translations.literal: The earthen dam at Ling Lake in Shangyu was replaced with a stone sluice.
translations.idiomatic: Shangyu's earthen dam at Ling Lake was replaced with a stone sluice.

sentences.zh: 挑無錫裏谷、蘇塘、華港、上村、李走馬塘諸河，東南接蘇州苑山湖塘，北通揚子江，西接新興河，引水灌田。

translations.literal: The Ligou, Sutang, Huagang, Shangcun, and Lizoumatang rivers in Wuxi were excavated; southeast connecting to Yuan Mountain lake and pond in Suzhou, north reaching the Yangtze, west connecting to the Xinxing River, drawing water to irrigate fields.
translations.idiomatic: Wuxi's Ligou, Sutang, Huagang, Shangcun, and Lizoumatang rivers were excavated to link southeast to Suzhou's Yuan Mountain lake and pond, north to the Yangtze, and west to the Xinxing River, drawing water to irrigate fields.

sentences.zh: 浚杞縣牛墓岡舊河，武進太平、永興二河。

translations.literal: The old river at Niumugang in Qi County and the Taiping and Yongxing rivers in Wujin were dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Qi County's old river at Niumugang and Wujin's Taiping and Yongxing rivers were dredged.

sentences.zh: 疏海鹽永安省，茶市院新涇、陶涇塘諸河。

translations.literal: The Yong'an River in Haiyan and the Xinjing, Taojing Pond, and other rivers at Chashiyuan were cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Haiyan's Yong'an River and the Xinjing, Taojing Pond, and other rivers at Chashiyuan were cleared.

sentences.zh: 都御史陳鎰言：「朝邑多沙鹻，難耕。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Chen Yi said: "Chaoyi has much sandy alkaline soil and is hard to farm.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Chen Yi reported: "Chaoyi has much sandy alkaline soil and is difficult to cultivate.

sentences.zh: 縣治洛河，與渭水通，請穿渠灌之。」

translations.literal: The county borders the Luo River, which connects to the Wei River; we request that a canal be cut to irrigate it."
translations.idiomatic: The county adjoins the Luo River, which connects to the Wei; we ask that a canal be cut for irrigation.

sentences.zh: 新安民言：「城南長溝河，西通徐、漕二水，東連雄縣直沽，沙土淤塞，請發丁夫疏浚。」

translations.literal: The people of Xin'an said: "The Changgou River south of the city connects west to the Xu and transport canal waters and east to Zhigu in Xiong County; sand and soil have silted it; we request corvée labor be mobilized to dredge it."
translations.idiomatic: The people of Xin'an reported: "The Changgou River south of the city connects west to the Xu and transport canal waters and east to Zhigu in Xiong County; sand and silt have choked it; we ask that corvée labor be mobilized to dredge it.

sentences.zh: 海陽民蕭瑤言：「縣有長溪，源出山麓，流抵海口，周袤潮郡，故登隆等都俱置溝通溉。

translations.literal: Xiao Yao, a man of Haiyang, said: "The county has the Long Stream, which rises from the mountain foothills and flows to the sea mouth, encircling the Chaozhou prefecture; therefore the Denglong and other districts all have channels installed for irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yao, a man of Haiyang, reported: "The county has the Long Stream, rising in the foothills and flowing to the sea, encircling Chaozhou prefecture; the Denglong and other districts therefore all have irrigation channels.

sentences.zh: 惟隆津等都陸野絕水，歲旱無所賴。

translations.literal: Only the Longjin and other districts on dry land have no water; in years of drought there is nothing to rely upon.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Longjin and other districts on dry upland have no water supply; in drought years they have nothing to fall back on.

sentences.zh: 乞開溝如登隆。」

translations.literal: We beg that channels be opened as at Denglong."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that channels be opened as in the Denglong districts.

sentences.zh: 長樂民劉彥樑言：「嚴湖二十餘里，南接稠菴溪，西通倒流溪，可備旱溢。

translations.literal: Liu Yanliang, a man of Changle, said: "Yan Lake extends more than twenty li; south connecting to Chou'an Stream, west connecting to Daoliu Stream, it can guard against drought and overflow.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yanliang, a man of Changle, reported: "Yan Lake runs more than twenty li, joining Chou'an Stream to the south and Daoliu Stream to the west, and can buffer both drought and flood.

sentences.zh: 又有張塘涵、塘前涵、大塘涵、陳塘港，其利如嚴湖。

translations.literal: There are also Zhangtang Han, Tangqian Han, Datang Han, and Chentang Harbor, whose benefits are like those of Yan Lake.
translations.idiomatic: There are also Zhangtang Han, Tangqian Han, Datang Han, and Chentang Harbor, offering benefits comparable to Yan Lake.

sentences.zh: 乞令有司疏浚。」

translations.literal: We beg that officials be ordered to dredge them."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the local authorities be ordered to dredge them.

sentences.zh: 廣濟民言：「縣與鄰邑黃梅，歲運糧三萬石於望牛墩。

translations.literal: The people of Guangji said: "The county, with neighboring Huangmei, transports thirty thousand shi of grain each year to Wangniudun.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Guangji reported: "Together with neighboring Huangmei, the county transports thirty thousand shi of grain each year to Wangniudun.

sentences.zh: 小車盤剝，不堪其勞。

translations.literal: Small carts transfer and unload it—they cannot bear the labor.
translations.idiomatic: Small carts transfer the grain at every stage, and the labor is unbearable.

sentences.zh: 連城湖港廖家口有溝抵墩前，淤淺不能行船。

translations.literal: At Liaojia Mouth in Liancheng Lake Harbor there is a ditch reaching before the pier; silted shallow, boats cannot pass.
translations.idiomatic: At Liaojia Mouth in Liancheng Lake Harbor a ditch runs to the pier, but it is silted too shallow for boats.

sentences.zh: 請與黃梅合力浚通，以便水運。」

translations.literal: We request joint dredging with Huangmei to open it for water transport."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that Huangmei join in dredging it open to facilitate water transport.

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: All were granted.
translations.idiomatic: All petitions were approved.

sentences.zh: 十一年，修洞庭湖堤。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, the Dongting Lake dikes were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Dongting Lake dikes were repaired.

sentences.zh: 築登州河岸。

translations.literal: The riverbank at Deng Prefecture was built up.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Prefecture's riverbank was repaired.

sentences.zh: 浚通州金沙場八里河，以通運渠。

translations.literal: The Bali River at Jinsha Field in Tongzhou was dredged to connect to the transport canal.
translations.idiomatic: Tongzhou's Bali River at Jinsha Field was dredged to connect with the transport canal.

sentences.zh: 任丘民言：「淩城港去縣二十五里，內有定安橋河，北十八里通流，東七里沙塞。

translations.literal: The people of Renqiu said: "Lingcheng Harbor is twenty-five li from the county; within it is Ding'an Bridge River—eighteen li to the north flows freely, seven li to the east is sand-blocked.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Renqiu reported: "Lingcheng Harbor lies twenty-five li from the county; within it is Ding'an Bridge River—eighteen li to the north are open, but seven li to the east are sand-choked.

sentences.zh: 宜疏通與港相接。

translations.literal: It should be cleared and connected to the harbor.
translations.idiomatic: It should be dredged and linked to the harbor.

sentences.zh: 入直沽張家灣。」

translations.literal: It enters Zhangjiawan at Zhigu."
translations.idiomatic: It would enter Zhangjiawan at Zhigu.

sentences.zh: 巡撫周忱言：「應天、鎮江、太平、甯國諸府，舊有石臼等湖。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Zhou Chen said: "The prefectures of Yingtian, Zhenjiang, Taiping, and Ningguo formerly had lakes such as Shijiu.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Zhou Chen reported: "The prefectures of Yingtian, Zhenjiang, Taiping, and Ningguo once had lakes such as Shijiu.

sentences.zh: 其中溝港，歲辦魚課。

translations.literal: Ditches and harbors within them supplied annual fish taxes.
translations.idiomatic: Ditches and inlets within them supplied annual fish taxes.

sentences.zh: 其外平圩淺灘，聽民牧放孳畜、採掘菱藕，不許種耕。

translations.literal: Outside them on level polders and shallow flats, people were permitted to pasture livestock and gather water chestnuts and lotus roots; cultivation was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Outside them, on level polders and shallows, people were allowed to pasture livestock and gather water chestnuts and lotus roots, but not to farm.

sentences.zh: 故山溪水漲，有所宣洩。

translations.literal: Therefore when mountain streams rose, there was release and drainage.
translations.idiomatic: Thus when mountain streams swelled, the waters had an outlet.

sentences.zh: 近者富豪築圩田，遏湖水，每遇泛溢，害即及民，宜悉禁革。」

translations.literal: Recently the wealthy have built polder fields and dammed lake water; whenever floods overflow, harm immediately reaches the people; all should be completely forbidden and abolished."
translations.idiomatic: Recently the wealthy have built polder fields and blocked lake waters; whenever floods rise, the harm reaches the common people; all such encroachment should be banned.

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: All was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 十二年，疏平度州大灣口河道，荊州公安門外河，以便公安、石首諸縣輸納。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, the river channel at Dawankou in Pingdu Prefecture and the river outside Gong'an Gate in Jingzhou were cleared to facilitate tax delivery from Gong'an, Shishou, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, the channel at Pingdu's Dawankou and the river outside Gong'an Gate in Jingzhou were cleared to facilitate tax transport from Gong'an, Shishou, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 浙江聽選官王信言：「紹興東小江，南通諸暨七十二湖，西通錢塘江。

translations.literal: Wang Xin, a selected official of Zhejiang, said: "The East Small River in Shaoxing connects south to the seventy-two lakes of Zhuji and west to the Qiantang River.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xin, a selected official in Zhejiang, reported: "Shaoxing's East Small River connects south to Zhuji's seventy-two lakes and west to the Qiantang River.

sentences.zh: 近為潮水湧塞，江與田平，舟不能行，久雨水溢，鄰田輒受其害。

translations.literal: Recently tidal surges have choked it; the river is level with the fields; boats cannot pass; after prolonged rain water overflows, and neighboring fields constantly suffer harm.
translations.idiomatic: Recently tidal surges have choked it; the river stands level with the fields and boats cannot pass; after prolonged rains it overflows and neighboring fields suffer.

sentences.zh: 乞發丁夫疏浚。」

translations.literal: We beg that corvée labor be mobilized to dredge it."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that corvée labor be mobilized to dredge it.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: [The court] assented.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the request.

sentences.zh: 十三年，築寧夏漢、唐壩決口。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, breached openings at the Han and Tang dams in Ningxia were built up.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, breached openings at Ningxia's Han and Tang dams were repaired.

sentences.zh: 疏山西涑水河、南海縣通海泉源。

translations.literal: The Suishui River in Shanxi and the sea-connecting spring source in Nanhai County were cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi's Suishui River and Nanhai County's spring source leading to the sea were cleared.

sentences.zh: 鑿宣府城濠，引城北山水入南城大河。

translations.literal: The moat at Xuanfu was excavated, drawing northern mountain waters outside the city into the great river south of the city.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanfu's moat was excavated to channel mountain waters from north of the city into the great river south of the city.

sentences.zh: 湖廣五開衛言：「衛與苗接，山路峻險。

translations.literal: Wukai Guard in Huguang said: "The guard adjoins the Miao; mountain roads are steep and perilous.
translations.idiomatic: Wukai Guard in Huguang reported: "The guard adjoins Miao territory and the mountain roads are steep and perilous.

sentences.zh: 去衛三十里有水通靖州江，亂石沙灘，請疏以便輸運。」

translations.literal: Thirty li from the guard there is water connecting to the Jingzhou River; boulders and sandy shoals—we request dredging to facilitate transport."
translations.idiomatic: Thirty li from the guard a waterway connects to the Jingzhou River, but boulders and sandy shoals block it; we ask that it be dredged to facilitate transport.

sentences.zh: 雲南鄧川州言：「本州民田與大理衛屯田接壤湖畔，每歲雨水沙土壅淤，禾苗淹沒。

translations.literal: Dengchuan Prefecture in Yunnan said: "This prefecture's civilian fields and Dali Guard's garrison fields border the lakeshore; each year rain brings sand and silt that choke the channels, and grain shoots are submerged.
translations.idiomatic: Dengchuan Prefecture in Yunnan reported: "Civilian fields in this prefecture and garrison fields of Dali Guard adjoin the lakeshore; each year rain washes sand and silt that choke the waterways, submerging the crops.

sentences.zh: 乞命州衛軍民疏治。」

translations.literal: We beg that the prefecture, guard, military, and civilians be ordered to dredge and repair."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that troops and civilians from the prefecture and guard be ordered to dredge and repair the channels.

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: Both were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Both requests were approved.

sentences.zh: 十四年，浚南海潘埇堤岸，置水閘。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, the embankments at Panweng in Nanhai were dredged, and water sluices were installed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, Nanhai's Panweng embankments were dredged and water sluices installed.

sentences.zh: 和州民言：「州有姥鎮河，上通麻、澧二湖，下接牛屯大河，長七十里許，廣八丈。

translations.literal: The people of He Prefecture said: "The prefecture has the Laozhen River, which connects upstream to the Ma and Li lakes and downstream to the Niutun Great River, about seventy li long and eight zhang wide.
translations.idiomatic: The people of He Prefecture reported: "The prefecture has the Laozhen River, connecting upstream to the Ma and Li lakes and downstream to the Niutun Great River, about seventy li long and eight zhang wide.

sentences.zh: 又有張家溝，連銅城閘，通大江，長減姥鎮之半，廣如之，灌溉降福等七十餘圩及南京諸衛屯田，近年河潰閘圮，率皆淤塞。

translations.literal: There is also Zhang Family Ditch, connecting to Tongcheng Sluice and reaching the great river, half the length of Laozhen and the same width, irrigating more than seventy polders such as Jiangfu and garrison fields of various guards at Nanjing; in recent years the river has breached and sluices collapsed, and all are largely silted shut.
translations.idiomatic: There is also Zhang Family Ditch, linking to Tongcheng Sluice and the great river at half Laozhen's length but the same width, irrigating more than seventy polders including Jiangfu and Nanjing garrison fields; in recent years the river has breached and sluices collapsed, and nearly everything is choked with silt.

sentences.zh: 請興役疏浚，仍於姥鎮、豐山嘴、葉公坡各建閘以備旱澇。」

translations.literal: We request labor be mobilized for dredging, and that sluices still be built at Laozhen, Fengshan Mouth, and Ye Family Slope to guard against drought and flood."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that labor be mobilized to dredge them, and that sluices be built at Laozhen, Fengshan Mouth, and Ye Family Slope to guard against drought and flood.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: [The court] assented.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the request.

sentences.zh: 景泰元年，築丹陽甘露等壩。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingtai, dams such as Ganlu in Danyang were built up.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingtai 1, dams such as Ganlu in Danyang were built up.

sentences.zh: 二年修玉河東、西堤。

translations.literal: In the second year, the eastern and western embankments of the Yu River were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, the eastern and western embankments of the Yu River were repaired.

sentences.zh: 浚安定門東城河，永嘉三十六都河，常熟顧新塘，南至當湖，北至揚子江。

translations.literal: The eastern city moat at Anding Gate, the thirty-six district rivers in Yongjia, and Gu Xin's pond in Changshu were dredged, south to Dang Lake and north to the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern moat at Anding Gate, Yongjia's thirty-six district rivers, and Gu Xin's pond in Changshu were dredged, south to Dang Lake and north to the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 三年修泰和信豐堤。

translations.literal: In the third year, dikes at Xinfeng in Taihe were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, Xinfeng dikes in Taihe were repaired.

sentences.zh: 築延安、綏德決河，綿州西岔河通江堤岸。

translations.literal: Breached rivers at Yan'an and Suide were built up; the embankment where Xicha River at Mian Prefecture reaches the river was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Breached rivers at Yan'an and Suide were repaired, along with the embankment where Mian Prefecture's Xicha River reaches the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 浚常熟七浦塘，劍州海子。

translations.literal: Qipu Pond in Changshu and Haizi in Jian Prefecture were dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Changshu's Qipu Pond and Jian Prefecture's Haizi were dredged.

sentences.zh: 疏孟瀆河浜涇十一。

translations.literal: Eleven Hongjing streams along the banks of the Mengdu River were cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven Hongjing channels along the Mengdu River banks were cleared.

sentences.zh: 工部言：「海鹽石塘十八里，潮水沖決，浮土修築，不能久。」

translations.literal: The Ministry of Works said: "An eighteen-li stone seadike at Haiyan has been breached by tidal surges; building with loose earth cannot last."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Works reported: "An eighteen-li stone seadike at Haiyan has been breached by tidal surges; repairs with loose earth cannot endure.

sentences.zh: 詔別築石塘捍之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered a separate stone seadike be built to defend against it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered a separate stone seadike built to hold back the tides.

sentences.zh: 四年，浚江陰順塘河十餘里，東接永利倉大河，西通夏港及揚子江。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, more than ten li of Shuntang River in Jiangyin were dredged, east connecting to Yongli Granary's great river and west reaching Xiogang and the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, more than ten li of Jiangyin's Shuntang River were dredged, east to Yongli Granary's great river and west to Xiogang and the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 雲南總兵官沐璘言：「城東有水南流，源發邵甸，會九十九泉為一，抵松花壩分為二支：一繞金馬山麓，入滇池；

translations.literal: Mu Lin, regional commander of Yunnan, said: "East of the city water flows south, its source rising at Shaodian, gathering ninety-nine springs into one, reaching Songhua Dam where it divides into two branches: one circling the foot of Golden Horse Mountain and entering Dian Lake;
translations.idiomatic: Mu Lin, regional commander of Yunnan, reported: "East of the city water flows south from Shaodian, gathering ninety-nine springs into one stream that reaches Songhua Dam and divides into two branches: one circling the foot of Golden Horse Mountain into Dian Lake;

sentences.zh: 一從黑窯村流至雲澤橋，亦入滇池。

translations.literal: one flowing from Heiyao Village to Yunze Bridge, also entering Dian Lake.
translations.idiomatic: the other flowing from Heiyao Village to Yunze Bridge, also into Dian Lake.

sentences.zh: 舊於下流築堰，溉軍民田數十萬頃，霖潦無所泄。

translations.literal: Formerly a weir was built downstream, irrigating hundreds of thousands of qing of military and civilian fields, but torrential rains had no outlet.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly a weir was built downstream to irrigate hundreds of thousands of qing of military and civilian fields, but torrential rains had no outlet.

sentences.zh: 請令受利之家，自造石閘，啟閉以時。」

translations.literal: We request that households benefiting be ordered to build stone sluices themselves, opening and closing them according to the season."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that benefiting households be ordered to build stone sluices themselves and open and close them according to the season.

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 五年疏靈寶黎園莊渠，通鴻瀘澗，溉田萬頃。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the Liyuanzhuang Canal in Lingbao was cleared, connecting to Honglu Stream and irrigating ten thousand qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Lingbao's Liyuanzhuang Canal was cleared to connect with Honglu Stream and irrigate ten thousand qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 六年浚華容杜預渠，通運船入江，避洞庭險。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Du Yu Canal in Huarong was dredged, allowing transport boats to enter the river and avoid Dongting's dangers.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Huarong's Du Yu Canal was dredged so transport boats could reach the river and avoid the hazards of Dongting.

sentences.zh: 修容城白溝河杜村口、固安楊家等口決堤。

translations.literal: Breached dikes at Ducun Estuary on Baigou River in Rongcheng and Yangjia and other openings in Gu'an were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Breached dikes at Rongcheng's Ducun Estuary on Baigou River and at Yangjia and other openings in Gu'an were repaired.

sentences.zh: 七年，尚書孫原貞言：「杭州西湖舊有二閘，近皆傾圮，湖遂淤塞。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Minister Sun Yuanzhen said: "West Lake at Hangzhou formerly had two sluices; recently both have collapsed, and the lake has silted up.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Minister Sun Yuanzhen reported: "Hangzhou's West Lake formerly had two sluices, but both have recently collapsed and the lake has silted up.

sentences.zh: 按宋蘇軾雲『杭本江海故地，水泉堿苦。

translations.literal: According to Su Shi of the Song: 'Hangzhou was originally seabed; its springs are brackish and bitter.
translations.idiomatic: As Su Shi of the Song wrote: 'Hangzhou was originally seabed, and its springs are brackish and bitter.

sentences.zh: 自唐李泌引湖水入城為六井，然後井邑日富，不可許人佃種。』

translations.literal: Since Li Bi of Tang drew lake water into the city for six wells, the wells and town grew daily in prosperity; lease-farming must not be permitted.'
translations.idiomatic: Since Li Bi of Tang drew lake water into the city for six wells, the wells and town grew daily in prosperity, and lease-farming must not be permitted.'

sentences.zh: 周淙亦言：『西湖貴深闊。』

translations.literal: Zhou Cong also said: 'West Lake must be kept deep and broad.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Cong also said: 'West Lake must be kept deep and broad.

sentences.zh: 因招兵二百，專一撈湖。

translations.literal: Therefore two hundred soldiers were recruited to dredge the lake exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred soldiers were therefore recruited to dredge the lake exclusively.

sentences.zh: 其後，豪戶復請佃，湖日益填塞，大旱水涸。

translations.literal: Afterward powerful households again requested leases, the lake grew daily more choked, and in great drought the water dried up.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward powerful households again requested leases; the lake grew daily more choked, and in great drought the water dried up.

sentences.zh: 詔郡守趙與亹開浚，芰荷茭蕩悉去，杭民以利。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Prefect Zhao Yu'e to open and dredge; water caltrop, lotus, and all aquatic growth were removed, and the people of Hangzhou benefited.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Prefect Zhao Yu'e to open and dredge the lake; water caltrop, lotus, and all aquatic growth were removed, and the people of Hangzhou benefited.

sentences.zh: 此前代經理西湖大略也。

translations.literal: This is roughly how earlier generations managed West Lake.
translations.idiomatic: This is roughly how earlier generations managed West Lake.

sentences.zh: 其後，勢豪侵佔無已，湖小淺狹，閘石毀壞。

translations.literal: Afterward powerful families encroached without end; the lake grew small, shallow, and narrow, and the sluice stonework was ruined.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward powerful families encroached without end; the lake grew small, shallow, and narrow, and the sluice stonework was ruined.

sentences.zh: 今民田無灌溉資，官河亦澀阻。

translations.literal: Now civilian fields lack irrigation resources, and official canals are also silted and blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Now civilian fields lack irrigation, and official canals are also silted and blocked.

sentences.zh: 乞敕有司興浚，禁侵佔以利軍民。」

translations.literal: We beg that officials be ordered to dredge and encroachment be forbidden for the benefit of military and civilians."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that officials be ordered to dredge the lake and forbid encroachment for the benefit of troops and civilians.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: [The court] assented.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the request.

sentences.zh: 天順二年，修彭縣萬工堰，灌田千餘頃。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianshun, Wangong Weir in Peng County was repaired, irrigating more than a thousand qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshun 2, Peng County's Wangong Weir was repaired, irrigating more than a thousand qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 五年，僉事李觀言：「涇水出涇陽仲山谷，道高陵，至櫟陽入渭，袤二百里。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Vice Commissioner Li Guan said: "Jing River rises from Zhong Mountain Valley in Jingyang, passes Gaoling, and at Liyang enters the Wei, extending two hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Vice Commissioner Li Guan reported: "The Jing River rises from Zhong Mountain Valley in Jingyang, passes Gaoling, and at Liyang enters the Wei, running two hundred li.

sentences.zh: 漢開渠溉田，宋、元俱設官主之。

translations.literal: The Han opened channels to irrigate fields; Song and Yuan both established officials to manage them.
translations.idiomatic: The Han opened channels to irrigate fields, and both Song and Yuan established officials to manage them.

sentences.zh: 今雖有瓠口鄭、白二渠，而堤堰摧決，溝洫壅瀦，民弗蒙利。」

translations.literal: Now although there are the Hugu Zheng and Bai channels, dikes and weirs are destroyed and breached, ditches and drains are blocked and stagnant, and the people receive no benefit."
translations.idiomatic: Although the Hugu Zheng and Bai channels still exist, dikes and weirs are destroyed and breached, ditches and drains are choked and stagnant, and the people receive no benefit.

sentences.zh: 乃命有司浚之。

translations.literal: Local officials were then ordered to dredge them.
translations.idiomatic: Local officials were then ordered to dredge them.

sentences.zh: 八年，永平民言：「漆河繞城西南流入海，城趾皆石，故水不能決。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the people of Yongping said: "Qi River wraps southwest around the city and flows to the sea; the city foundations are all stone, so water cannot breach them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, the people of Yongping reported: "The Qi River wraps southwest around the city and flows to the sea; the city foundations are all stone, so the water cannot breach them.

sentences.zh: 其餘則沙土易潰，前人於東北築土堤，西南甓岸。

translations.literal: The rest is sandy soil easily breached; predecessors built earthen dikes to the northeast and brick embankments to the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: The rest is sandy soil easily breached; predecessors built earthen dikes to the northeast and brick embankments to the southwest.

sentences.zh: 今歲久日塌，宜作堤於東流，橫以激之，使合西流，庶無蕩析患。」

translations.literal: Now after long years they have collapsed daily; it is fitting to build a dike on the eastern flow and place a transverse barrier to force the waters together into the western flow, so there may be no scour and destruction."
translations.idiomatic: Now after long years they have collapsed; a dike should be built on the eastern flow with a transverse barrier to force the waters into the western channel, so there may be no scour and destruction.

sentences.zh: 都御史項忠言：「涇陽之瓠口鄭、白二渠，引涇水溉田數萬頃，至元猶溉八千頃。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Xiang Zhong said: "The Hugu Zheng and Bai channels at Jingyang, drawing Jing water to irrigate tens of thousands of qing of fields, still irrigated eight thousand qing under the Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Xiang Zhong reported: "The Hugu Zheng and Bai channels at Jingyang, drawing Jing water to irrigate tens of thousands of qing of fields, still irrigated eight thousand qing under the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 其後渠日淺，利因以廢。

translations.literal: Afterward the channels grew daily shallower, and the benefits were abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the channels grew daily shallower, and the benefits were lost.

sentences.zh: 宣德初，遣官修鑿，畝收四三石。

translations.literal: Early in Xuande, officials were dispatched to repair and excavate, and harvests reached three or four shi per mu.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Xuande reign, officials were dispatched to repair and excavate them, and harvests reached three or four shi per mu.

sentences.zh: 無何復塞，渠旁之田，遇旱為赤地。

translations.literal: Before long they silted again; fields beside the channels, when drought came, became bare red earth.
translations.idiomatic: Before long they silted again, and fields beside the channels became bare red earth in drought.

sentences.zh: 涇陽、醴泉、三原、高陵皆患苦之。

translations.literal: Jingyang, Liquan, Sanyuan, and Gaoling all suffered from this.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyang, Liquan, Sanyuan, and Gaoling all suffered from this.

sentences.zh: 昨請於涇水上源龍潭左側疏浚，訖舊渠口，尋以詔例停止。

translations.literal: Yesterday we requested dredging on the left side of Longtan at the upper Jing source, reaching the old channel mouth, but it was soon halted under an edict regulation.
translations.idiomatic: We recently requested dredging on the left side of Longtan at the upper Jing source, reaching the old channel mouth, but it was soon halted under an edict regulation.

sentences.zh: 今宜畢其役。

translations.literal: Now the work should be completed.
translations.idiomatic: The work should now be completed.

sentences.zh: 西安城西井泉堿苦，飲者輒病。

translations.literal: West of Xi'an city the well springs are brackish and bitter; those who drink fall ill at once.
translations.idiomatic: West of Xi'an the well springs are brackish and bitter, and those who drink them fall ill at once.

sentences.zh: 龍首渠引水七十里，修築不易，且利止及城東。

translations.literal: Longshou Canal draws water seventy li; repair and construction are not easy, and the benefit reaches only east of the city.
translations.idiomatic: Longshou Canal draws water seventy li, but repair and construction are difficult, and its benefit reaches only east of the city.

sentences.zh: 西南皁河去城一舍許，可鑿，令引水與龍首渠會，則居民盡利。」

translations.literal: Zao River southwest is about one she from the city and can be excavated; drawing its water to join Longshou Canal would benefit all residents."
translations.idiomatic: Zao River to the southwest lies about one she from the city and can be excavated; drawing its water to join Longshou Canal would benefit all residents.

sentences.zh: 邳州知州孟琳言：「榆行諸社俱臨沂河，久雨岸崩二十八處，低田盡淹。

translations.literal: Meng Lin, prefect of Pizhou, said: "Yuhang and other communities all border the Yi River; after prolonged rain twenty-eight places on the banks collapsed, and low fields were all flooded.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Lin, prefect of Pizhou, reported: "Yuhang and other communities all border the Yi River; after prolonged rain twenty-eight places on the banks collapsed and low fields were all flooded.

sentences.zh: 乞與修築。」

translations.literal: We beg assistance for repair and construction."
translations.idiomatic: We ask for assistance with repairs."

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: All were granted.
translations.idiomatic: All petitions were approved.

sentences.zh: 成化二年，修壽州安豐塘。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chenghua, Anfeng Pond in Shou Prefecture was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 2, Shou Prefecture's Anfeng Pond was repaired.

sentences.zh: 四年，疏石州城河。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Shizhou's city moat was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Shizhou's city moat was cleared.

sentences.zh: 六年，修平湖周家涇及獨山海塘。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Zhou Family Hong in Pinghu and the seadike at Dushan were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Pinghu's Zhou Family Hong and Dushan's seadike were repaired.

sentences.zh: 七年，潮決錢塘江岸及山陰、會稽、蕭山、上虞，乍浦、瀝海二所，錢清諸場。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, tides breached the Qiantang River bank and [areas in] Shanyin, Kuaiji, Xiaoshan, and Shangyu, the two salterns at Zhapu and Lihai, and various salterns at Qianqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, tides breached the Qiantang River bank and areas in Shanyin, Kuaiji, Xiaoshan, and Shangyu, the two salterns at Zhapu and Lihai, and various salterns at Qianqing.

sentences.zh: 命侍郎李顒修築。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Li Yong was ordered to repair and build.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Li Yong was ordered to oversee repairs.

sentences.zh: 八年，堤襄陽決岸。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, breached banks at Xiangyang were diked.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, breached banks at Xiangyang were repaired.

sentences.zh: 十年，廷臣會議：江浦北城圩古溝，北通滁河浦子口；

translations.literal: In the tenth year, court ministers conferenced: the ancient ditch at Jiangpu's north city polder connects north to Chuzhou River at Puzikou;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, court ministers conferred: the ancient ditch at Jiangpu's north city polder connects north to Chuzhou River at Puzikou;

sentences.zh: 城東黑水泉古溝，南入大江。

translations.literal: the ancient ditch at Heishui Spring east of the city enters the great river southward.
translations.idiomatic: the ancient ditch at Heishui Spring east of the city flows south into the great river.

sentences.zh: 二溝相望，岡壟中截。

translations.literal: The two ditches face each other, cut off in the middle by ridges.
translations.idiomatic: The two ditches face each other but are cut off in the middle by ridges.

sentences.zh: 宜鑿通成河，旱引澇泄。

translations.literal: It is fitting to excavate and connect them into a river, drawing water in drought and draining in flood.
translations.idiomatic: They should be excavated and connected into a river to draw water in drought and drain in flood.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: [The court] assented.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 十一年，浚杭州錢塘門故渠，左屬湧金門，建橋閘以蓄湖水。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, the old channel at Qiantang Gate in Hangzhou was dredged, left linking to Yongjin Gate, and bridge sluices were built to store lake water.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, the old channel at Hangzhou's Qiantang Gate was dredged, linking left to Yongjin Gate, and bridge sluices were built to store lake water.

sentences.zh: 巡撫都御史牟俸言：「山東小清河，上接濟南趵突諸泉，下通樂安沿海高家港鹽場。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-Chief Mou Feng said: "The Xiaoqing River in Shandong connects upstream to Jinan's Baotu and other springs and downstream to the Gaojia Harbor saltern on the Le'an coast.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-Chief Mou Feng reported: "Shandong's Xiaoqing River connects upstream to Jinan's Baotu and other springs and downstream to the Gaojia Harbor saltern on the Le'an coast.

sentences.zh: 大清河，上接東平坎河諸泉，下通濱州海豐、利津，沿海富國鹽場。

translations.literal: The Daqing River connects upstream to Dongping's Kan River and other springs and downstream to Haifeng and Lijin in Bin Prefecture and the Fuguo coastal saltern.
translations.idiomatic: The Daqing River connects upstream to Dongping's Kan River and other springs and downstream to Haifeng and Lijin in Bin Prefecture and the Fuguo coastal saltern.

sentences.zh: 淤塞，苦盤剝，雨水又患淹沒。

translations.literal: Silting has choked them; transfer and unloading are painful, and rain also brings flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Silt has choked them; transfer and unloading are arduous, and rain also brings flooding.

sentences.zh: 勸農參政唐虞浚河造閘，請令兼治水利。」

translations.literal: Agriculture-promoting Vice Commissioner Tang Yu dredged rivers and built sluices; we request he be ordered to oversee water conservancy as well."
translations.idiomatic: Agriculture-promoting Vice Commissioner Tang Yu dredged rivers and built sluices; we ask that he also be ordered to oversee water conservancy.

sentences.zh: 詔可。

translations.literal: An edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved the request.

sentences.zh: 十二年，巡按御史許進言：「河西十五衛，東起莊浪，西抵肅州，綿亙幾二千里，所資水利多奪於勢豪。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Touring Censor Xu Jin said: "The fifteen guards west of the river, from Zhuanglang in the east to Suzhou in the west, stretch nearly two thousand li; much of their water resources has been seized by powerful families.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, touring censor Xu Jin reported: "The fifteen guards west of the river, from Zhuanglang in the east to Suzhou in the west, stretch nearly two thousand li, and much of their water resources has been seized by powerful families.

sentences.zh: 宜設官專理。」

translations.literal: Officials should be established to manage this exclusively."
translations.idiomatic: Officials should be appointed to manage this exclusively.

sentences.zh: 詔屯田僉事兼之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the garrison-field vice commissioner to hold the additional duty.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the garrison-field vice commissioner to take on the additional duty.

sentences.zh: 十四年，俸言：「直隸蘇、鬆與浙西各府，頻年旱澇，緣周環太湖，乃東南最窪地，而蘇、鬆尤最下之沖。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, Feng said: "The directly administered Suzhou and Songjiang and the various prefectures of western Zhejiang have suffered drought and flood in successive years because they surround Tai Lake, the lowest land in the southeast, with Suzhou and Songjiang especially the lowest channel.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, Mou Feng reported: "Directly administered Suzhou and Songjiang and the various prefectures of western Zhejiang have suffered drought and flood in successive years because they surround Tai Lake, the lowest land in the southeast, with Suzhou and Songjiang especially the lowest outlet.

sentences.zh: 故每逢積雨，眾水奔潰，湖泖漲漫，淹沒無際。

translations.literal: Therefore whenever rains accumulate, all waters rush and burst forth, lakes and marshes swell and spread, and submersion knows no bounds.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore whenever rains accumulate, all waters rush and burst forth, lakes and marshes swell and spread, and flooding knows no bounds.

sentences.zh: 按太湖即古震澤，上納嘉、湖、宣、歙諸州之水，下通婁、東、吳淞三江之流，東江今不復見，婁、淞入海故跡具存。

translations.literal: Tai Lake is the ancient Zhenze; upstream it receives waters from Jiaxing, Huzhou, Xuanzhou, and Shezhou; downstream it connects to the flows of the Lou, Dong, and Wusong rivers; the Dong River is no longer seen today, but the old traces of the Lou and Wusong entering the sea remain fully intact.
translations.idiomatic: Tai Lake is the ancient Zhenze; upstream it receives waters from Jiaxing, Huzhou, Xuanzhou, and Shezhou, and downstream it connects to the Lou, Dong, and Wusong rivers; the Dong River is no longer seen today, but the old traces of the Lou and Wusong entering the sea remain fully intact.

sentences.zh: 其地勢與常熟福山、白茆二塘俱能導太湖入江海，使民無墊溺，而土可耕種，歷代開浚具有成法。

translations.literal: Their terrain, together with the Fushan and Baimao embankments at Changshu, can all channel Tai Lake into river and sea so the people need not drown and the land can be cultivated; successive dynasties dredged and opened them with established methods.
translations.idiomatic: Their terrain, together with Changshu's Fushan and Baimao embankments, can channel Tai Lake into river and sea so the people need not drown and the land can be cultivated; successive dynasties dredged and opened them by established methods.

sentences.zh: 本朝亦常命官修治，不得其要。

translations.literal: Our dynasty also often ordered officials to repair them, but without grasping the essentials.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty also often ordered officials to repair them, but without grasping the essentials.

sentences.zh: 而濱湖豪家盡將淤灘栽蒔為利。

translations.literal: Yet lakeside magnates all planted crops on silted shoals for profit.
translations.idiomatic: Yet lakeside magnates all planted crops on silted shoals for profit.

sentences.zh: 治水官不悉利害，率於泄處置石樑，壅土為道，或慮盜船往來，則釘木為柵。

translations.literal: Water officials did not understand the pros and cons; they habitually placed stone weirs at discharge points and piled earth for paths, or fearing bandit boats passing back and forth, nailed wooden palisades.
translations.idiomatic: Water officials did not understand the trade-offs; they habitually placed stone weirs at discharge points and piled earth for paths, or fearing bandit boats, nailed wooden palisades.

sentences.zh: 以致水道堙塞，公私交病。

translations.literal: Thereby water channels were choked shut, and public and private interests alike suffered.
translations.idiomatic: Thereby water channels were choked shut, and public and private interests alike suffered.

sentences.zh: 請擇大臣深知水利者專理之，設提督水利分司一員隨時修理，則水勢疏通，東南厚利也。」

translations.literal: We request that a senior minister who deeply understands water conservancy be chosen to manage this exclusively, and a Water Conservancy Assistant Commissioner be established for timely repair; then the water flow would be cleared and the southeast would reap great benefit."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that a senior minister who deeply understands water conservancy be chosen to manage this exclusively, and a Water Conservancy Assistant Commissioner be established for timely repair; then the water flow would be cleared and the southeast would reap great benefit.

sentences.zh: 帝即令俸兼領水利，聽所浚築。

translations.literal: The emperor immediately ordered Feng also to oversee water conservancy, authorizing whatever dredging and construction he saw fit.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor immediately ordered Mou Feng also to oversee water conservancy, authorizing whatever dredging and construction he saw fit.

sentences.zh: 功成，乃專設分司。

translations.literal: When the work was done, a dedicated assistant commission was then established.
translations.idiomatic: When the work was completed, a dedicated assistant commission was then established.

sentences.zh: 十五年，修南京內外河道。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, inner and outer canals at Nanjing were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, Nanjing's inner and outer canals were repaired.

sentences.zh: 十八年，浚雲南東西二溝，自鬆華壩黑龍潭抵西南柳壩南村，灌田數萬頃。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, eastern and western ditches in Yunnan were dredged, from Black Dragon Pool at Songhua Dam to Nan Village at Liu Dam southwest, irrigating tens of thousands of qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, eastern and western ditches in Yunnan were dredged from Black Dragon Pool at Songhua Dam to Nan Village at Liu Dam southwest, irrigating tens of thousands of qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 修居庸關水關、城券及隘口水門四十九，樓鋪、墩臺百二。

translations.literal: Juyong Pass water gates, ramparts and archways, and forty-nine pass water gates were repaired, along with one hundred and two tower-posts and beacon platforms.
translations.idiomatic: Juyong Pass water gates, ramparts and archways, and forty-nine pass water gates were repaired, along with one hundred and two tower-posts and beacon platforms.

sentences.zh: 二十年，修嘉興等六府海田堤岸，特選京堂官往督之。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, seafield dikes and embankments in six prefectures including Jiaxing were repaired; capital officials were specially selected to supervise.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, seafield dikes and embankments in six prefectures including Jiaxing were repaired, and capital officials were specially selected to supervise.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，浚南京中下二新河。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, Nanjing's middle and lower new rivers were dredged.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, Nanjing's middle and lower new rivers were dredged.

sentences.zh: 弘治三年，從巡撫都御史丘鼐言，設官專領灌縣都江堰。

translations.literal: In the third year of Hongzhi, following Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-Chief Qiu Xi's memorial, an official was established to manage Dujiang Weir in Guan County exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi 3, following Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-Chief Qiu Xi's memorial, an official was appointed to manage Guan County's Dujiang Weir exclusively.

sentences.zh: 六年，敕撫民參政硃瑄浚河南伊、洛，彰德高平、萬金，懷慶廣濟，南陽召公等渠，汝寧桃陂等堰。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, an edict ordered Vice Commissioner for Pacifying the People Zhu Xuan to dredge the Yi and Luo in Henan; Gaoping and Wanjin in Zhangde; Guangji in Huaiqing; the Duke Shao and other channels in Nanyang; and Taopi and other weirs in Runing.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, an edict ordered Vice Commissioner for Pacifying the People Zhu Xuan to dredge the Yi and Luo in Henan; Gaoping and Wanjin in Zhangde; Guangji in Huaiqing; the Duke Shao and other channels in Nanyang; and Taopi and other weirs in Runing.

sentences.zh: 七年，浚南京天、潮二河，備軍衛屯田水利。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Tian and Chao rivers at Nanjing were dredged for garrison-field water conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Nanjing's Tian and Chao rivers were dredged for garrison-field water conservancy.

sentences.zh: 七月命侍郎徐貫與都御史何鑒經理浙西水利。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Vice Minister Xu Guan and Censor-in-Chief He Jian were ordered to manage water conservancy in western Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Vice Minister Xu Guan and Censor-in-Chief He Jian were ordered to manage water conservancy in western Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 明年四月告成。

translations.literal: The following year in the fourth month it was reported complete.
translations.idiomatic: The following year in the fourth month the work was reported complete.

sentences.zh: 貫初奉命，奏以主事祝萃自隨。

translations.literal: When Guan first received his orders, he memorialized that Director Zhu Cui accompany him.
translations.idiomatic: When Xu Guan first received his commission, he memorialized that Director Zhu Cui accompany him.

sentences.zh: 萃乘小舟究悉源委。

translations.literal: Cui took a small boat and traced every source and course.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Cui took a small boat and traced every source and course.

sentences.zh: 貫乃令蘇州通判張旻疏各河港水，瀦之大壩。

translations.literal: Guan then ordered Suzhou Assistant Prefect Zhang Min to clear the waters of the various river channels and impound them in a great dam.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Guan then ordered Suzhou Assistant Prefect Zhang Min to clear the waters of the various river channels and impound them behind a great dam.

sentences.zh: 旋開白茆港沙面，乘潮退，決大壩水沖激之，沙泥刷盡。

translations.literal: Then Baimao Harbor's sand flats were opened; when the tide ebbed, the great dam was breached and the released water scoured them until sand and mud were swept clean.
translations.idiomatic: Then Baimao Harbor's sand flats were opened; when the tide ebbed, the great dam was breached and the released water scoured them until sand and mud were swept clean.

sentences.zh: 潮水蕩激，日益闊深，水達海無阻。

translations.literal: Tidal surges washed and churned them daily wider and deeper, and water reached the sea without obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: Tidal surges washed and churned the channel daily wider and deeper, and water reached the sea without obstruction.

sentences.zh: 又令浙江參政周季麟修嘉興舊堤三十餘里，易之以石，增繕湖州長興堤岸七十餘里。

translations.literal: He also ordered Zhejiang Vice Commissioner Zhou Jilin to repair more than thirty li of old dikes at Jiaxing, replacing them with stone, and to extend repairs to more than seventy li of dikes and embankments at Changxing in Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered Zhejiang Vice Commissioner Zhou Jilin to repair more than thirty li of old dikes at Jiaxing, replacing them with stone, and to extend repairs to more than seventy li of dikes and embankments at Changxing in Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 貫乃上言：「東南財賦所出，而水患為多。

translations.literal: Guan then submitted a memorial: "The southeast is where tax revenues originate, yet flooding is frequent.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Guan then submitted a memorial: "The southeast is where tax revenues originate, yet flooding is frequent.

sentences.zh: 永樂初，命夏原吉疏浚。

translations.literal: Early in Yongle, Xia Yuanji was ordered to dredge and clear.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yongle reign, Xia Yuanji was ordered to dredge and clear the waterways.

sentences.zh: 時以吳淞江灩沙浮蕩，未克施工。

translations.literal: At the time silt sand drifting in the Wusong River prevented work from proceeding.
translations.idiomatic: At the time drifting silt in the Wusong River prevented work from proceeding.

sentences.zh: 迨今九十餘年，港浦愈塞。

translations.literal: Nearly ninety years have passed since then, and harbors and channels have grown ever more choked.
translations.idiomatic: Nearly ninety years have passed since then, and harbors and channels have grown ever more choked.

sentences.zh: 臣督官行視，浚吳江長橋，導太湖散入澱山、陽城、昆承等湖泖。

translations.literal: Your subject supervised officials on inspection tours, dredged Chang Bridge at Wujiang, and channeled Tai Lake to disperse into the lake marshes of Dianshan, Yangcheng, Kunshchen, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject supervised officials on inspection tours, dredged Chang Bridge at Wujiang, and channeled Tai Lake to disperse into the lake marshes of Dianshan, Yangcheng, Kunshchen, and others.

sentences.zh: 復開吳淞江並大石、趙屯等浦，泄澱山湖水，由吳淞江以達於海。

translations.literal: The Wusong River was reopened along with Dashi, Zhaotun, and other channels to drain Dianshan lake waters through the Wusong River to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Wusong River was reopened along with Dashi, Zhaotun, and other channels to drain Dianshan lake waters through the Wusong River to the sea.

sentences.zh: 開白茆港白魚洪、鯰魚口，泄昆承湖水，由白茆港以注於江。

translations.literal: Baiyu Hong and Nianyu Estuary at Baimao Harbor were opened to drain Kunshchen lake waters through Baimao Harbor into the river.
translations.idiomatic: Baiyu Hong and Nianyu Estuary at Baimao Harbor were opened to drain Kunshchen lake waters through Baimao Harbor into the river.

sentences.zh: 開斜堰、七鋪、鹽鐵等塘，泄陽城湖水，由七丫港以達於海。

translations.literal: Xieyan, Qipu, Yantie, and other embankments were opened to drain Yangcheng lake waters through Qiya Harbor to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Xieyan, Qipu, Yantie, and other embankments were opened to drain Yangcheng lake waters through Qiya Harbor to the sea.

sentences.zh: 下流疏通，不復壅塞。

translations.literal: Downstream channels were cleared and no longer choked.
translations.idiomatic: Downstream channels were cleared and no longer choked.

sentences.zh: 乃開湖州之漊涇，泄西湖、天目、安吉諸山之水，自西南入於太湖。

translations.literal: Then Loujing in Huzhou was opened to drain waters from West Lake, Tianmu Mountain, Anji, and other mountain sources southwest into Tai Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Then Loujing in Huzhou was opened to drain waters from West Lake, Tianmu Mountain, Anji, and other mountain sources southwest into Tai Lake.

sentences.zh: 開常州之百瀆，泄溧陽、鎮江、練湖之水，自西北入於太湖。

translations.literal: Baifu in Changzhou was opened to drain waters from Liyang, Zhenjiang, and Lian Lake northwest into Tai Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Baifu in Changzhou was opened to drain waters from Liyang, Zhenjiang, and Lian Lake northwest into Tai Lake.

sentences.zh: 又開諸陡門，泄漕河之水，由江陰以入於大江。

translations.literal: Various sluice gates were also opened to drain Grand Canal waters through Jiangyin into the great river.
translations.idiomatic: Various sluice gates were also opened to drain Grand Canal waters through Jiangyin into the great river.

sentences.zh: 上流亦通，不復堙滯。」

translations.literal: Upstream channels were also cleared and no longer blocked and stagnant."
translations.idiomatic: Upstream channels were also cleared and no longer blocked and stagnant.

sentences.zh: 是役也，修浚河、港、涇、瀆、湖、塘、陡門、堤岸百三十五道，役夫二十餘萬，祝萃之功多焉。

translations.literal: In this project one hundred thirty-five rivers, harbors, channels, lakes, embankments, sluice gates, and dikes were dredged or repaired, with more than two hundred thousand corvée laborers; Zhu Cui's contributions were great.
translations.idiomatic: In this project one hundred thirty-five rivers, harbors, channels, lakes, embankments, sluice gates, and dikes were dredged or repaired, with more than two hundred thousand corvée laborers; Zhu Cui's contributions were especially great.

sentences.zh: 巡撫都御史王珣言：「寧夏古渠三道，東漢、中唐並通。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-Chief Wang Xun said: "Ningxia has three ancient canals; all three were open in Eastern Han and mid-Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-Chief Wang Xun reported: "Ningxia has three ancient canals; all three were open in Eastern Han and mid-Tang.

sentences.zh: 惟西一渠傍山，長三百餘里，廣二十餘丈，兩岸危峻，漢、唐舊跡俱堙。

translations.literal: Only the western canal runs along the mountains, more than three hundred li long and more than twenty zhang wide; both banks are steep and perilous, and Han and Tang relics are all buried.
translations.idiomatic: Only the western canal runs along the mountains, more than three hundred li long and more than twenty zhang wide; both banks are steep and perilous, and Han and Tang relics are all buried.

sentences.zh: 宜發卒浚鑿，引水下流。

translations.literal: Troops should be dispatched to dredge and excavate, drawing water downstream.
translations.idiomatic: Troops should be dispatched to dredge and excavate, drawing water downstream.

sentences.zh: 即以土築東岸，建營堡屯兵以遏寇沖。

translations.literal: With the excavated earth the eastern bank should be built up and fortresses established with garrison troops to block raiding incursions.
translations.idiomatic: With the excavated earth the eastern bank should be built up and fortresses established with garrison troops to block raiding incursions.

sentences.zh: 請帑銀三萬兩，並靈州六年鹽課，以給其費。」

translations.literal: We request thirty thousand taels from the treasury, together with six years of salt tax from Ling Prefecture, to cover the expense."
translations.idiomatic: We request thirty thousand taels from the treasury, together with six years of salt tax from Ling Prefecture, to cover the expense.

sentences.zh: 又請於靈州金積山河，開渠灌田，給軍民佃種。

translations.literal: He also requested that at Jinji Mountain River in Ling Prefecture channels be opened to irrigate fields and allocate them to military and civilians for tenant farming.
translations.idiomatic: He also requested that at Jinji Mountain River in Ling Prefecture channels be opened to irrigate fields and allocate them to troops and civilians for tenant farming.

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: Both were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Both requests were approved.

sentences.zh: 十八年，修築常熟塘壩，自尚湖口抵江，及黃、泗等浦，新莊等沙三十餘處。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, Changshu embankments and dams were built and repaired from Shang Lake Estuary to the river, and at Huang, Si, and other channels and more than thirty sandbanks including Xinzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, Changshu embankments and dams were built and repaired from Shang Lake Estuary to the river, and at Huang, Si, and other channels and more than thirty sandbanks including Xinzhuang.

sentences.zh: 浚杭州西湖。

translations.literal: Hangzhou's West Lake was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Hangzhou's West Lake was dredged.

sentences.zh: 正德七年，修廣平滏陽河口堤岸。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhengde, dikes and embankments at the Fuyang River estuary in Guangping were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde 7, dikes and embankments at the Fuyang River estuary in Guangping were repaired.

sentences.zh: 十四年浚南京新江口右河。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, the right branch river at Nanjing's Xinjiang Estuary was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, the right branch river at Nanjing's Xinjiang Estuary was dredged.

sentences.zh: 十五年，御史成英言：「應天等衛屯田在江北滁、和、六合者，地勢低，屢為水敗。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Censor Cheng Ying said: "Garrison fields of Yingtian and other guards in Chuzhou, He, and Luhe north of the Yangtze lie on low ground and have been ruined by flood again and again.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, Censor Cheng Ying reported: "Garrison fields of Yingtian and other guards in Chuzhou, He, and Luhe north of the Yangtze lie on low ground and have been ruined by flood again and again.

sentences.zh: 從金城港抵濁河達烏江三十餘里，因舊跡浚之，則水勢泄而屯田利。」

translations.literal: Dredging more than thirty li from Jincheng Harbor through Zhuo River to Wujiang along the old course would release the water pressure and benefit the garrison fields."
translations.idiomatic: Dredging more than thirty li from Jincheng Harbor through Zhuo River to Wujiang along the old course would release the water pressure and benefit the garrison fields.

sentences.zh: 詔可。

translations.literal: An edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved the request.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖元年，築浚束鹿、肥鄉、獻、魏堤渠。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiajing, dikes and channels at Shulu, Feixiang, Xian, and Wei were built and dredged.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 1, dikes and channels at Shulu, Feixiang, Xian, and Wei were built and dredged.

sentences.zh: 初，蘇、鬆水道盡為勢家所據。

translations.literal: Initially all waterways in Suzhou and Songjiang had been seized by powerful families.
translations.idiomatic: Initially all waterways in Suzhou and Songjiang had been seized by powerful families.

sentences.zh: 巡撫李充嗣畫水為井地，示開鑿法，戶佔一區，計工刻日。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Li Chongsi charted the waters into a grid, showed how to excavate, assigned each household one section, and set labor quotas with deadlines.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Li Chongsi charted the waters into a grid, showed how to excavate, assigned each household one section, and set labor quotas with deadlines.

sentences.zh: 造浚川爬，用巨筏數百，曳木齒，隨潮進退，擊汰泥沙。

translations.literal: River dredgers were built: several hundred giant rafts dragged wooden teeth, advancing and retreating with the tide to pound and wash away sand and mud.
translations.idiomatic: River dredgers were built: several hundred giant rafts dragged wooden teeth, advancing and retreating with the tide to pound and wash away sand and mud.

sentences.zh: 置小艇百餘，尾鐵帚以導之。

translations.literal: More than a hundred small boats were deployed, each trailing iron brooms to guide the flow.
translations.idiomatic: More than a hundred small boats were deployed, each trailing iron brooms to guide the flow.

sentences.zh: 浚故道，穿新渠，巨浦支流，罔不灌注。

translations.literal: Old channels were dredged, new canals cut, and main harbors and tributaries all brought into flow.
translations.idiomatic: Old channels were dredged, new canals cut, and main harbors and tributaries all brought into flow.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉其勞，賚以銀幣。

translations.literal: The emperor commended his labors and rewarded him with silver and silk.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended his labors and rewarded him with silver and silk.

sentences.zh: 二年，修德勝門東、朝陽門北城垣河道，築儀真、江都官塘五區。

translations.literal: In the second year, canals along the walls east of Desheng Gate and north of Chaoyang Gate were repaired, and five sections of official embankment at Yizhen and Jiangdu were built.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, canals along the walls east of Desheng Gate and north of Chaoyang Gate were repaired, and five sections of official embankment at Yizhen and Jiangdu were built.

sentences.zh: 十年，工部郎中陸時雍言：「良鄉盧溝河，涿州琉璃、胡良二河，新城、雄縣白溝河，河間沙河，青縣滹沱河，下流皆淤。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Director Lu Shiyong of the Ministry of Works said: "Lugou River at Liangxiang, the Liuli and Huliang rivers at Zhuozhou, Baigou River at Xincheng and Xiong County, Sha River at Hejian, and Hutuo River at Qing County are all silted downstream.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, Director Lu Shiyong of the Ministry of Works reported: "Lugou River at Liangxiang, the Liuli and Huliang rivers at Zhuozhou, Baigou River at Xincheng and Xiong County, Sha River at Hejian, and Hutuo River at Qing County are all silted downstream.

sentences.zh: 宜以時浚，使達於海。」

translations.literal: They should be dredged in season so they reach the sea."
translations.idiomatic: They should be dredged in season so they reach the sea.

sentences.zh: 詔巡撫議之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the grand coordinator to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the grand coordinator to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 十一年，太僕卿何棟勘畿封河患有二。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Minister of the Imperial Stud He Dong surveyed river disasters in the metropolitan region and found two general categories.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Minister of the Imperial Stud He Dong surveyed river disasters in the metropolitan region and found two general categories.

sentences.zh: 一論滹沱河。

translations.literal: One concerned the Hutuo River.
translations.idiomatic: One concerned the Hutuo River.

sentences.zh: 其一言：「真定鴨、沙、磁三河，俱發源五臺。

translations.literal: The first stated: "The Ya, Sha, and Ci rivers at Zhending all rise on Wutai Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The first stated: "The Ya, Sha, and Ci rivers at Zhending all rise on Wutai Mountain.

sentences.zh: 會諸支水，抵唐河蘭家圈，合流入河間。

translations.literal: Gathering tributary waters, they reach Lanjiaquan at Tang River and merge to flow into Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: Gathering tributary waters, they reach Lanjiaquan at Tang River and merge to flow into Hejian.

sentences.zh: 東南經任丘、霸州、天津入海，此故道也。

translations.literal: Southeast they passed through Renqiu, Bazhou, and Tianjin to the sea—this was the old course.
translations.idiomatic: Southeast they passed through Renqiu, Bazhou, and Tianjin to the sea—this was the old course.

sentences.zh: 河間東南高，東北下，故水決蘭家口，而肅寧、新安皆罹其害。

translations.literal: Hejian is higher to the southeast and lower to the northeast, so water breached at Lanjiakou and both Suning and Xin'an suffered.
translations.idiomatic: Hejian is higher to the southeast and lower to the northeast, so water breached at Lanjiakou and both Suning and Xin'an suffered.

sentences.zh: 宜築決口，浚故道。

translations.literal: The breach should be dammed and the old course dredged.
translations.idiomatic: The breach should be dammed and the old course dredged.

sentences.zh: 涿州胡良河，自拒馬分流，至州東入渾河。

translations.literal: Huliang River at Zhuozhou branches from the Juma River and east of the prefectural seat enters the Hun River.
translations.idiomatic: Huliang River at Zhuozhou branches from the Juma River and east of the prefectural seat enters the Hun River.

sentences.zh: 良鄉琉璃河，發源磁家務，潛入地中，至良鄉東入渾河。

translations.literal: Liuli River at Liangxiang rises at Cijiawu, runs underground, and east of Liangxiang enters the Hun River.
translations.idiomatic: Liuli River at Liangxiang rises at Cijiawu, runs underground, and east of Liangxiang enters the Hun River.

sentences.zh: 比者渾河壅塞，二河不流。

translations.literal: Recently the Hun River has been choked and neither river flows.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the Hun River has been choked and neither river flows.

sentences.zh: 然下流淤沙僅四五里，請亟浚之。」

translations.literal: Yet downstream silt extends only four or five li; we urgently request dredging."
translations.idiomatic: Yet downstream silt extends only four or five li; we urgently request dredging.

sentences.zh: 部覆允行。

translations.literal: The ministry reviewed and approved implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry reviewed and approved implementation.

sentences.zh: 郎中徐元祉受命振災，上言：「河本以泄水，今反下壅；

translations.literal: Director Xu Yuanzhi, ordered to relieve disaster, submitted a memorial: "Rivers exist to discharge water, yet now they choke downstream instead;
translations.idiomatic: Director Xu Yuanzhi, ordered to relieve disaster, submitted a memorial: "Rivers exist to discharge water, yet now they choke downstream instead;

sentences.zh: 澱本以瀦水，今反上溢。

translations.literal: Marshes exist to store water, yet now they overflow upstream instead.
translations.idiomatic: Marshes exist to store water, yet now they overflow upstream instead.

sentences.zh: 故畿輔常苦水，順天利害相半，真定利多於害，保定害多於利，河間全受其害。

translations.literal: Therefore the metropolitan region constantly suffers from water: Shuntian sees benefit and harm in equal measure, Zhending sees more benefit than harm, Baoding more harm than benefit, and Hejian suffers harm entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the metropolitan region constantly suffers from water: Shuntian sees benefit and harm in equal measure, Zhending sees more benefit than harm, Baoding more harm than benefit, and Hejian suffers harm entirely.

sentences.zh: 弘、正間，嘗築長堤，排決口，旋即潰敗。

translations.literal: Between Hongzhi and Zhengde, long dikes were built and breaches cleared, but they soon collapsed again.
translations.idiomatic: Between the Hongzhi and Zhengde reigns, long dikes were built and breaches cleared, but they soon collapsed again.

sentences.zh: 今惟疏浚可施，其策凡六。

translations.literal: Now only dredging can be applied; the plan has six points in all.
translations.idiomatic: Now only dredging can be applied; the plan has six points in all.

sentences.zh: 一浚本河，俾河身寬邃。

translations.literal: First, dredge the main river so its bed is wide and deep.
translations.idiomatic: First, dredge the main river so its bed is wide and deep.

sentences.zh: 九河自山西來者，南合滹沱而不侵真定諸郡，北合白溝而不侵保定諸郡。

translations.literal: The nine rivers coming from Shanxi should merge with the Hutuo to the south without flooding Zhending prefectures, and with Baigou to the north without flooding Baoding prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The nine rivers coming from Shanxi should merge with the Hutuo to the south without flooding Zhending prefectures, and with Baigou to the north without flooding Baoding prefectures.

sentences.zh: 此第一義也。

translations.literal: This is the first principle.
translations.idiomatic: This is the first principle.

sentences.zh: 一浚支河。

translations.literal: Second, dredge branch rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Second, dredge branch rivers.

sentences.zh: 令九河之流，經大清河，從紫城口入；

translations.literal: Let the flow of the nine rivers pass through the Daqing River and enter at Zicheng Estuary;
translations.idiomatic: Let the flow of the nine rivers pass through the Daqing River and enter at Zicheng Estuary;

sentences.zh: 經文都村，從涅槃口入；

translations.literal: pass through Wendu Village and enter at Nirvana Estuary;
translations.idiomatic: pass through Wendu Village and enter at Nirvana Estuary;

sentences.zh: 經白洋澱，從蘭家口入；

translations.literal: pass through Baiyang Marsh and enter at Lanjiakou;
translations.idiomatic: pass through Baiyang Marsh and enter at Lanjiakou;

sentences.zh: 經章哥ＡＨ，從楊村河入。

translations.literal: pass through Zhangge Ao and enter at Yangcun River.
translations.idiomatic: pass through Zhangge Ao and enter at Yangcun River.

sentences.zh: 直遂以納細流，水力分矣。

translations.literal: Straight channels to receive minor flows would divide the water's force.
translations.idiomatic: Straight channels to receive minor flows would divide the water's force.

sentences.zh: 一浚決河。

translations.literal: Third, dredge breach channels.
translations.idiomatic: Third, dredge breach channels.

sentences.zh: 九河安流時，本支二河可受，遇漲則岸口四沖。

translations.literal: When the nine rivers flow smoothly the main and branch rivers can absorb them; when waters rise, the banks breach in four places.
translations.idiomatic: When the nine rivers flow smoothly the main and branch rivers can absorb them; when waters rise, the banks breach in four places.

sentences.zh: 宜每衝量存一口，復浚令合成一渠，以殺湍急，備淫溢。

translations.literal: At each breach one outlet should be retained as appropriate, then dredged and united into a single channel to tame the torrent and guard against overflow.
translations.idiomatic: At each breach one outlet should be retained as appropriate, then dredged and united into a single channel to tame the torrent and guard against overflow.

sentences.zh: 一浚澱河。

translations.literal: Fourth, dredge marsh channels.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, dredge marsh channels.

sentences.zh: 令澱澱相通，達於本支二河，使下有所泄。

translations.literal: Let marsh connect to marsh until they reach the main and branch rivers, giving downstream an outlet.
translations.idiomatic: Let marsh connect to marsh until they reach the main and branch rivers, giving downstream an outlet.

sentences.zh: 一浚淤河。

translations.literal: Fifth, dredge silted rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, dredge silted rivers.

sentences.zh: 九河東逝，悉由故道，高者下，下者通。

translations.literal: The nine rivers flowing east should all follow their old courses—the high lowered, the low cleared.
translations.idiomatic: The nine rivers flowing east should all follow their old courses—the high lowered, the low cleared.

sentences.zh: 佔據曲防者抵罪。

translations.literal: Those who seize land and build crooked dikes shall be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Those who seize land and build crooked dikes shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 一浚下河。

translations.literal: Sixth, dredge the lower rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth, dredge the lower rivers.

sentences.zh: 九河一出青縣，一出丁字沽，二流相匝於苑家口。

translations.literal: One of the nine rivers exits at Qing County, another at Dingzigu, and the two streams circle each other at Yuanjiakou.
translations.idiomatic: One of the nine rivers exits at Qing County, another at Dingzigu, and the two streams circle each other at Yuanjiakou.

sentences.zh: 故施工必自苑家口始，漸有成效，然後次第舉行，庶減諸郡水害。」

translations.literal: Therefore work must begin at Yuanjiakou; when results appear, projects may proceed in sequence, so water disasters in the various prefectures may be reduced."
translations.idiomatic: Therefore work must begin at Yuanjiakou; when results appear, projects may proceed in sequence, so water disasters in the various prefectures may be reduced.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉納之。

translations.literal: The emperor praised and accepted the memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and accepted the memorial.

sentences.zh: 明年，香河郭家莊自開新河一道，長百七十丈，闊五十丈，近舊河十里餘。

translations.literal: The following year at Guojiazhuang in Xianghe a new river opened of its own accord, one hundred seventy zhang long and fifty zhang wide, about ten li from the old river.
translations.idiomatic: The following year at Guojiazhuang in Xianghe a new river opened of its own accord, one hundred seventy zhang long and fifty zhang wide, about ten li from the old river.

sentences.zh: 詔河官亟繕治。

translations.literal: An edict ordered river officials to repair it urgently.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered river officials to repair it urgently.

sentences.zh: 十三年，巡撫都御史周金言：「蘭家圈決口，塞之則東溢，病河間；

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-Chief Zhou Jin said: "The breach at Lanjiaquan, if sealed, will overflow eastward and afflict Hejian;
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-Chief Zhou Jin reported: "The breach at Lanjiaquan, if sealed, will overflow eastward and afflict Hejian;

sentences.zh: 不塞則東流漸淤，病保定。

translations.literal: if left unsealed the eastward flow will gradually silt up and afflict Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: if left unsealed the eastward flow will gradually silt up and afflict Baoding.

sentences.zh: 宜存決口而浚廣新河，使水東北平流，無壅涸患。」

translations.literal: The breach should be retained while the new river is dredged and widened, so water flows level east and north without choking or drying up."
translations.idiomatic: The breach should be retained while the new river is dredged and widened, so water flows level east and north without choking or drying up.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: [The court] assented.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the request.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，浚南京後湖。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, Nanjing's Rear Lake was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, Nanjing's Rear Lake was dredged.

sentences.zh: 初，胡體乾按吳，以松江泛溢，進六策：「曰開川，曰浚湖，曰殺上流之勢，曰決下流之壑，曰排潮漲之沙，曰立治田之規。」

translations.literal: Initially Hu Tigan, while investigating Wu, submitted six policies because the Songjiang River had overflowed: "Open channels, dredge lakes, reduce upstream force, open downstream outlets, flush out tidal sand, and establish rules for managing fields."
translations.idiomatic: Initially Hu Tigan, while investigating Wu, submitted six policies because the Songjiang River had overflowed: "Open channels, dredge lakes, reduce upstream force, open downstream outlets, flush out tidal sand, and establish rules for managing fields."

sentences.zh: 是年，呂光洵按吳，復奏蘇、鬆水利五事：

translations.literal: That year Lü Guangxun, while investigating Wu, again memorialized on five matters of water conservancy in Suzhou and Songjiang:
translations.idiomatic: That year Lü Guangxun, while investigating Wu, again memorialized on five matters of water conservancy in Suzhou and Songjiang:

sentences.zh: 一曰廣疏浚以備瀦泄。

translations.literal: First, broaden dredging to guard against impounding and discharge.
translations.idiomatic: First, broaden dredging to guard against impounding and discharge.

sentences.zh: 三吳澤國，西南受太湖諸澤，水勢尤卑。

translations.literal: The Three Wu region is a land of marshes; southwest it receives the marshes of Tai Lake, and its water level is especially low.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Wu region is a land of marshes; southwest it receives the marshes of Tai Lake, and its water level is especially low.

sentences.zh: 東北際海，岡隴之地，視西南特高。

translations.literal: Northeast it borders the sea, and the ridge lands there are especially high compared with the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Northeast it borders the sea, and the ridge lands there are especially high compared with the southwest.

sentences.zh: 高苦旱，卑苦澇。

translations.literal: The high ground suffers drought; the low ground suffers flood.
translations.idiomatic: The high ground suffers drought; the low ground suffers flood.

sentences.zh: 昔人於下流疏為塘浦，導諸湖水北入江，東入海，又引江潮流衍於岡隴外。
