translations.literal: Former generations dredged embankments and harbors downstream, channeling lake waters north into the river and east into the sea, and also drew river and tidal waters to spread beyond the ridges.
translations.idiomatic: Former generations dredged embankments and harbors downstream, channeling lake waters north into the river and east into the sea, and also drew river and tidal waters to spread beyond the ridges.

sentences.zh: 瀦泄有法，水旱無患。

translations.literal: With proper rules for impounding and discharge, drought and flood brought no disaster.
translations.idiomatic: With proper rules for impounding and discharge, drought and flood brought no disaster.

sentences.zh: 比來縱浦橫塘，多堙不治，惟黃浦、劉河二江頗通。

translations.literal: Recently longitudinal harbors and transverse embankments have largely been choked and left unrepaired; only the Huangpu and Liuhe rivers remain fairly open.
translations.idiomatic: Recently longitudinal harbors and transverse embankments have largely been choked and left unrepaired; only the Huangpu and Liuhe rivers remain fairly open.

sentences.zh: 然太湖之水源多勢盛，二江不足以泄之。

translations.literal: Yet Tai Lake has many sources and a powerful flow, and the two rivers are not enough to drain it.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Tai Lake has many sources and a powerful flow, and the two rivers are not enough to drain it.

sentences.zh: 岡隴支河又多壅絕，無以資灌溉。

translations.literal: Branch rivers on the ridge lands are again largely choked off, with no means to supply irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: Branch rivers on the ridge lands are again largely choked off, leaving nothing to supply irrigation.

sentences.zh: 於是高下俱病，歲常告災。

translations.literal: Thus both high and low ground alike suffer; each year disasters are reported.
translations.idiomatic: Thus both high and low ground alike suffer, and each year brings reports of disaster.

sentences.zh: 宜先度要害，於澱山等茭蘆地，導太湖水散入陽城、昆承、三泖等湖。

translations.literal: Critical points should first be surveyed; at rush-and-reed lands such as Dianshan, Tai Lake water should be directed to disperse into Yangcheng, Kunshchen, Sanmao, and other lakes.
translations.idiomatic: Critical points should first be surveyed; at rush-and-reed lands such as Dianshan, Tai Lake water should be directed to disperse into Yangcheng, Kunshchen, Sanmao, and other lakes.

sentences.zh: 又開吳淞江及大石、趙屯等浦，泄澱山之水以達於海。

translations.literal: The Wusong River and Dashi, Zhaotun, and other harbors should also be opened to drain Dianshan lake waters to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Wusong River and Dashi, Zhaotun, and other harbors should also be opened to drain Dianshan lake waters to the sea.

sentences.zh: 浚白茆、鯰魚諸口，泄昆承之水以注於江。

translations.literal: Baimao, Nianyu, and other estuaries should be dredged to drain Kunshchen lake waters into the river.
translations.idiomatic: Baimao, Nianyu, and other estuaries should be dredged to drain Kunshchen lake waters into the river.

sentences.zh: 開七浦、鹽鐵等塘，泄陽城之水以達於江。

translations.literal: Qipu, Yantie, and other embankments should be opened to drain Yangcheng lake waters into the river.
translations.idiomatic: Qipu, Yantie, and other embankments should be opened to drain Yangcheng lake waters into the river.

sentences.zh: 又導田間之水，悉入小浦，以納大浦，使流者皆有所歸，瀦者皆有所泄。

translations.literal: Field waters should also be channeled into smaller harbors to feed larger ones, so that flowing water all has a destination and impounded water all has an outlet.
translations.idiomatic: Field waters should also be channeled into smaller harbors to feed larger ones, so that all flowing water has somewhere to go and all impounded water has somewhere to drain.

sentences.zh: 則下流之地治，而澇無所憂矣。

translations.literal: Then the lower reaches would be restored and flooding would be no cause for concern.
translations.idiomatic: Then the lower reaches would be restored and there would be no cause to fear flooding.

sentences.zh: 乃浚艾祁、通波以溉青浦，浚顧浦、吳塘以溉嘉定，浚大瓦等浦以溉崑山之東，浚許浦等塘以溉常熟之北，浚臧村等港以溉金壇，浚澡港等河以溉武進。

translations.literal: Then Aiqi and Tongbo should be dredged to irrigate Qingpu; Gupu and Wutang to irrigate Jiading; Dawu and other harbors to irrigate eastern Kunshan; Xupu and other embankments to irrigate northern Changshu; Zangcun and other channels to irrigate Jintan; and Zaogang and other rivers to irrigate Wujin.
translations.idiomatic: Aiqi and Tongbo would be dredged to irrigate Qingpu; Gupu and Wutang to irrigate Jiading; Dawu and other harbors to irrigate eastern Kunshan; Xupu and other embankments to irrigate northern Changshu; Zangcun and other channels to irrigate Jintan; and Zaogang and other rivers to irrigate Wujin.

sentences.zh: 凡隴岡支河堙塞不治者，皆浚之深廣，使復其舊。

translations.literal: All ridge and hill branch rivers that are choked and left unrepaired should be dredged deep and wide until restored to their former state.
translations.idiomatic: All ridge and hill branch rivers that are choked and left unrepaired should be dredged deep and wide until restored to their former condition.

sentences.zh: 則上流之地亦治，而旱無所憂矣。

translations.literal: Then the upper reaches would also be restored and drought would be no cause for concern.
translations.idiomatic: Then the upper reaches would also be restored and there would be no cause to fear drought.

sentences.zh: 此三吳水利之經也。

translations.literal: This is the enduring principle of water conservancy in the Three Wu region.
translations.idiomatic: This is the enduring principle of water conservancy in the Three Wu region.

sentences.zh: 一曰修圩岸以固橫流。

translations.literal: One: repair polder embankments to secure against cross-flow.
translations.idiomatic: Second, repair polder embankments to guard against cross-flow.

sentences.zh: 蘇、鬆、常、鎮東南下流，而蘇、鬆又常、鎮下流，易瀦難泄。

translations.literal: Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang lie downstream to the southeast, and Suzhou and Songjiang lie downstream of Changzhou and Zhenjiang; water is easy to impound but hard to discharge.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang lie downstream to the southeast, with Suzhou and Songjiang below Changzhou and Zhenjiang; water pools easily here but drains with difficulty.

sentences.zh: 雖導河浚浦引注江海，而秋霖泛漲，風濤相薄，則河浦之水逆行田間，沖齧為患。

translations.literal: Even if rivers and harbors are dredged to channel water into the river and sea, when autumn rains swell the floods and wind and waves press against each other, river and harbor waters reverse course through the fields, eroding and causing harm.
translations.idiomatic: Even when rivers and harbors are dredged to channel water into the river and sea, autumn rains swell the floods and wind and waves clash; river and harbor waters then reverse course through the fields, eroding the land and causing harm.

sentences.zh: 宋轉運使王純臣嘗令蘇、湖作田塍禦水，民甚便之。

translations.literal: In Song times Transport Commissioner Wang Chunchen once ordered Suzhou and Huzhou to build field ridges against the water; the people found it very convenient.
translations.idiomatic: In Song times Transport Commissioner Wang Chunchen once ordered Suzhou and Huzhou to build field ridges against the water, and the people found it greatly to their benefit.

sentences.zh: 司農丞郟亦云：「治河以治田為本。」

translations.literal: Director of the Ministry of Revenue Jia Yi also said: "Managing rivers means taking field management as the foundation."
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Ministry of Revenue Jia Yi also said: "Managing rivers means taking field management as the foundation.

sentences.zh: 故老皆云，前二三十年，民間足食，因餘力治圩岸，田益完美。

translations.literal: Elders all say that twenty or thirty years ago the people had enough food and, with their surplus labor, maintained polder embankments, so the fields grew ever more perfect.
translations.idiomatic: Elders all say that twenty or thirty years ago the people had enough to eat and, with their surplus labor, maintained polder embankments, so the fields grew ever more productive.

sentences.zh: 近皆空乏，無暇修繕，故田圩漸壞，歲多水災。

translations.literal: Recently all are depleted and have no leisure for repairs, so field embankments gradually decay and water disasters come almost every year.
translations.idiomatic: Lately people are depleted and have no leisure for repairs, so field embankments gradually decay and water disasters come almost every year.

sentences.zh: 合敕所在官司專治圩岸。

translations.literal: An order should issue that local offices devote themselves exclusively to maintaining polder embankments.
translations.idiomatic: An order should issue directing local offices to devote themselves exclusively to maintaining polder embankments.

sentences.zh: 岸高則田自固，雖有霖澇，不能為害。

translations.literal: When embankments are high the fields secure themselves; even with heavy rains and flooding they cannot cause harm.
translations.idiomatic: When embankments are high the fields secure themselves; even with heavy rains and flooding they cannot be harmed.

sentences.zh: 且足制諸湖之水鹹歸河浦中，則不待決泄，自然湍流。

translations.literal: Moreover, this suffices to constrain all the waters of the various lakes and return them to the rivers and harbors; then without deliberate breaches and drainage, swift flow arises of itself.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, it suffices to keep all lake waters under control and return them to the rivers and harbors; then without deliberate breaches and drainage, swift flow arises of itself.

sentences.zh: 而岡隴之地，亦因江水稍高，又得畝引以資灌溉，不特利於低田而已。

translations.literal: And ridge lands, because river water stands slightly higher, could also draw it field by field for irrigation—not benefiting low fields alone.
translations.idiomatic: Ridge lands, because river water stands slightly higher, could also draw it field by field for irrigation—not benefiting low fields alone.

sentences.zh: 一曰復板閘以防汙澱。

translations.literal: One: restore plank sluice gates to guard against silt pollution.
translations.idiomatic: Third, restore plank sluice gates to guard against silting.

sentences.zh: 河浦之水皆自平原流入江海，水慢潮急，以故沙隨浪湧，其勢易淤。

translations.literal: River and harbor waters all flow from the plains into the river and sea; the current is slow and the tide swift, so sand rises with the waves and silting comes easily.
translations.idiomatic: River and harbor waters all flow from the plains into the river and sea; the current is slow and the tide swift, so sand rises with the waves and silting comes easily.

sentences.zh: 昔人權其便宜，去江海十里許夾流為閘，隨潮啟閉，以禦淤沙。

translations.literal: Former generations, weighing convenience, built gates spanning the flow about ten li from the river and sea, opening and closing with the tide to block silted sand.
translations.idiomatic: Former generations, weighing convenience, built gates spanning the flow about ten li from the river and sea, opening and closing with the tide to block incoming silt.

sentences.zh: 歲旱則長閉以蓄其流，歲澇則長啟以宣其溢，所謂置閘有三利，蓋謂此也。

translations.literal: In drought years they kept the gates long closed to store the flow; in flood years long open to release the overflow—the so-called three benefits of installing gates refer to this.
translations.idiomatic: In drought years they kept the gates long closed to store the flow; in flood years long open to release the overflow—the so-called three benefits of installing gates refer to this.

sentences.zh: 近多堙塞，惟常熟福山閘尚存。

translations.literal: Recently most have been choked and sealed; only the Fushan Gate at Changshu still survives.
translations.idiomatic: Recently most have been choked and sealed; only the Fushan Gate at Changshu still survives.

sentences.zh: 故老以為河浦入海之地，誠皆置閘，自可曆久不壅。

translations.literal: Elders believe that at every place where rivers and harbors enter the sea, if gates were truly installed, channels could remain unchoked for years on end.
translations.idiomatic: Elders believe that at every place where rivers and harbors enter the sea, if gates were truly installed, channels could remain unchoked for years on end.

sentences.zh: 一曰量緩急以處工費。

translations.literal: One: measure urgency and ease in allocating labor costs.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, weigh urgency against ease in allocating labor and expense.

sentences.zh: 一曰重委任以責成功。

translations.literal: One: weight commission and responsibility to demand success.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, invest heavy commission and responsibility to demand success.

sentences.zh: 詔悉如議。

translations.literal: An edict approved all as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved all as proposed.

sentences.zh: 光洵因請專委巡撫歐陽必進。

translations.literal: Guangxun thereupon requested that Grand Coordinator Ouyang Bijing be exclusively entrusted.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Guangxun thereupon requested that Grand Coordinator Ouyang Bijing be exclusively entrusted with the work.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: [The court] assented.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，給事中陳斐請仿江南水田法，開江北溝洫，以祛水患，益歲收。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, Supervising Secretary Chen Fei requested that following the Jiangnan paddy-field method, ditches and canals be opened north of the Yangtze to dispel water disasters and increase annual harvests.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, Supervising Secretary Chen Fei requested that following the Jiangnan paddy-field method, ditches and canals be opened north of the Yangtze to dispel water disasters and increase annual harvests.

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，總督尚書楊博請開宣、大荒田水利。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year, Governor-in-Chief Yang Bo requested that water conservancy for wasteland at Xuancheng and Datong be opened.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year, Governor-in-Chief Yang Bo requested that water conservancy for wasteland in Xuancheng and Datong be developed.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: [The court] assented.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 巡撫都御史翁大立言：「東吳水利，自震澤浚源以注江，三江導流以入海，而蘇州三十六浦，松江八匯，毘陵十四瀆，共以節宣旱澇。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-Chief Weng Dali said: "Eastern Wu's water conservancy, from dredging the source at Zhenze to channel into the river, and the Three Rivers guiding flow into the sea—Suzhou's thirty-six harbors, Songjiang's eight confluences, and Biling's fourteen channels together regulated drought and flood.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-Chief Weng Dali reported: "Eastern Wu's water conservancy, from dredging the source at Zhenze to channel water into the river, and the Three Rivers guiding flow into the sea—Suzhou's thirty-six harbors, Songjiang's eight confluences, and Biling's fourteen channels together regulated drought and flood.

sentences.zh: 近因倭寇衝突，汊港之交，率多釘柵築堤以為捍禦，因致水流停瀦，淤滓日積。

translations.literal: Recently, because of wokou raids, at the junctions of branch harbors many have nailed palisades and built dikes for defense, causing water to stagnate and silt to accumulate day by day.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, because of wokou raids, at the junctions of branch harbors many have nailed palisades and built dikes for defense, causing water to stagnate and silt to accumulate day by day.

sentences.zh: 管道之間，仰高成阜。

translations.literal: Between the channels, [silt] piled high into mounds.
translations.idiomatic: Between the channels, silt piled high into mounds.

sentences.zh: 且具區湖泖，並水而居者雜蒔茭蘆，積泥成蕩，民間又多自起圩岸。

translations.literal: Moreover, at Lake Juqu and the lake marshes, those dwelling along the water mixed plant water chestnuts and reeds; mud accumulated into shallows, and among the people many built their own polder embankments.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, at Lake Juqu and the lake marshes, those dwelling along the water planted water chestnuts and reeds in the shallows; mud accumulated into boggy flats, and among the people many built their own polder embankments.

sentences.zh: 上流日微，水勢日殺。

translations.literal: Upstream flow grew daily weaker and the force of the water daily diminished.
translations.idiomatic: Upstream flow grew daily weaker and the force of the water daily diminished.

sentences.zh: 黃浦、婁江之水又為舟師所居，下流亦淤。

translations.literal: The waters of the Huangpu and Lou rivers were again occupied by naval forces, and the lower reaches also silted up.
translations.idiomatic: The waters of the Huangpu and Lou rivers were again occupied by naval fleets, and the lower reaches also silted up.

sentences.zh: 海潮無力，水利難興，民田漸磽。

translations.literal: Sea tides lacked force, water conservancy was hard to revive, and civilian fields gradually turned barren.
translations.idiomatic: Sea tides lacked force, water conservancy was hard to revive, and civilian fields gradually turned barren.

sentences.zh: 宜於吳淞、白茆、七浦等處造成石閘，啟閉以時。

translations.literal: Stone gates should be built at Wusong, Baimao, Qipu, and other places, opened and closed according to season.
translations.idiomatic: Stone gates should be built at Wusong, Baimao, Qipu, and other places, opened and closed according to season.

sentences.zh: 挑鎮江、常州漕河深廣，使輸挽無阻，公私之利也。」

translations.literal: The Grand Canal at Zhenjiang and Changzhou should be dredged deep and wide so that transport haulage meets no obstruction—a benefit to public and private alike."
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Canal at Zhenjiang and Changzhou should be dredged deep and wide so that transport haulage meets no obstruction—a benefit to public and private alike.

sentences.zh: 詔可。

translations.literal: An edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved the request.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，給事中張憲臣言：「蘇、鬆、常、嘉、湖五郡水患疊見。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year, Supervising Secretary Zhang Xianchen said: "Water disasters have struck repeatedly in the five prefectures of Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year, Supervising Secretary Zhang Xianchen reported: "Water disasters have struck repeatedly in the five prefectures of Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 請浚支河，通潮水；

translations.literal: We request dredging branch rivers to connect tidal waters;
translations.idiomatic: We request dredging branch rivers to connect tidal waters;

sentences.zh: 築圩岸，禦湍流。

translations.literal: building polder embankments to resist torrential flow.
translations.idiomatic: building polder embankments to resist torrential flow.

sentences.zh: 其白茆港、劉家河、七浦、楊林及凡河渠河蕩壅淤沮洳者，悉宜疏導。」

translations.literal: Baimao Harbor, Liujia River, Qipu, Yanglin, and all rivers, channels, and lake marshes that are choked, silted, and boggy should all be dredged and cleared."
translations.idiomatic: Baimao Harbor, Liujia River, Qipu, Yanglin, and all rivers, channels, and lake marshes that are choked, silted, and boggy should all be dredged and cleared.

sentences.zh: 帝以江南久苦倭患，民不宜重勞，令酌浚支河而已。

translations.literal: The emperor, because Jiangnan had long suffered from wokou raids and the people should not be overburdened, ordered that only branch rivers be dredged as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, because Jiangnan had long suffered from wokou raids and the people should not be overburdened, ordered that only branch rivers be dredged as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，參政淩雲翼請專設御史督蘇、鬆水利。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year, Vice Commissioner Ling Yunyi requested that a censor be specially appointed to oversee water conservancy in Suzhou and Songjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year, Vice Commissioner Ling Yunyi requested that a censor be specially appointed to oversee water conservancy in Suzhou and Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 詔巡鹽御史兼之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Salt Circuit Censor to take this duty concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Salt Circuit Censor to take this duty concurrently.

sentences.zh: 隆慶三年，開湖廣竹筒河以泄漢江。

translations.literal: In the third year of Longqing, Zhutong River in Huguang was opened to discharge Han River waters.
translations.idiomatic: In Longqing 3, Zhutong River in Huguang was opened to discharge Han River waters.

sentences.zh: 巡撫都御史海瑞疏吳淞江下流上海淤地萬四千丈有奇。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-Chief Hai Rui dredged more than fourteen thousand zhang of silted land along the lower Wusong River at Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-Chief Hai Rui dredged more than fourteen thousand zhang of silted land along the lower Wusong River at Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 江面舊三十丈，增開十五丈，自黃渡至宋家橋長八十里。

translations.literal: The river surface was originally thirty zhang wide; an additional fifteen zhang was opened, from Huangdu to Songjia Bridge a length of eighty li.
translations.idiomatic: The river surface was originally thirty zhang wide; an additional fifteen zhang was opened, from Huangdu to Songjia Bridge a distance of eighty li.

sentences.zh: 明年春，瑞言：「三吳入海之道，南止吳淞，北止白茆，中止劉河。

translations.literal: The following spring Hai said: "The Three Wu routes to the sea are bounded on the south by the Wusong, on the north by Baimao, and in the center by the Liu River.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring Hai Rui reported: "The Three Wu routes to the sea are bounded on the south by the Wusong, on the north by Baimao, and in the center by the Liu River.

sentences.zh: 劉河通達無滯，吳淞方在挑疏。

translations.literal: The Liu River runs clear without obstruction; the Wusong is presently being dredged.
translations.idiomatic: The Liu River runs clear without obstruction; the Wusong is presently being dredged.

sentences.zh: 土人請開白茆，計浚五千餘丈，役夫百六十四萬餘。」

translations.literal: Local people request opening Baimao; dredging is estimated at more than five thousand zhang, with more than 1,640,000 corvée labor-days."
translations.idiomatic: Local people request opening Baimao; dredging is estimated at more than five thousand zhang, requiring more than 1,640,000 corvée labor-days.

sentences.zh: 又言：「吳淞役垂竣，惟東西二壩未開。

translations.literal: He also said: "The Wusong project is nearly complete, but the two east-west dams have not yet been opened.

translations.idiomatic: Elders all say that Xiakou at Kunshan, Chang Bridge at Wujiang, Baodai Bridge at Changzhou, Xukou in Wu County, and every place where water can flow down to the Wusong must be dredged one by one before the dams may be opened.

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

translations.literal: That year Haiyan sea walls were built.
translations.idiomatic: That year sea walls at Haiyan were built.

translations.idiomatic: Four years later, following Vice Grand Coordinator Xu Shi's proposal, Qinzhushan at Haiyan was reopened, south to the old river at Ganpu.

sentences.zh: 萬曆二年，築荊州採穴，承天泗港、謝家灣諸決堤口。

translations.literal: In the second year of Wanli, breach dikes at Caixue in Jingzhou, Sigang in Chengtian, Xiejiawan, and other places were built up.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli 2, breach dikes at Caixue in Jingzhou, Sigang in Chengtian, Xiejiawan, and other places were built up.

sentences.zh: 復築荊、嶽等府及鬆滋諸縣老垸堤。

translations.literal: Old polder dikes in Jing, Yue, and other prefectures and Songzi and other counties were also rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: Old polder dikes in Jingzhou, Yuezhou, and other prefectures and in Songzi and other counties were also rebuilt.

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-Chief Song Yiwang said: "The water regime of the Three Wu: from the southeast, from Jiaxing and Xiuzhou along the coast northward, all trend toward Songjiang and reach the sea along the Huangpu;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-Chief Song Yiwang reported: "The water regime of the Three Wu: from the southeast, from Jiaxing and Xiuzhou along the coast northward, all waters trend toward Songjiang and reach the sea along the Huangpu;

sentences.zh: 西北自常、鎮沿江而東，皆趨江陰、常熟。

translations.literal: from the northwest, from Changzhou and Zhenjiang along the Yangtze eastward, all trend toward Jiangyin and Changshu.
translations.idiomatic: from the northwest, from Changzhou and Zhenjiang along the Yangtze eastward, all waters trend toward Jiangyin and Changshu.

sentences.zh: 其中太湖瀦蓄，匯為巨浸，流注龐山、瀆墅、澱山、三泖，陽城諸湖。

translations.literal: Within, Tai Lake stores and impounds, gathering into a great expanse and flowing into the lakes of Pangshan, Dushu, Dianshan, Sanmao, Yangcheng, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Within, Tai Lake stores and impounds, gathering into a great expanse and flowing into the lakes of Pangshan, Dushu, Dianshan, Sanmao, Yangcheng, and others.

sentences.zh: 乃開浦引湖，北經常熟七浦、白茆諸港入於江，東北經崑山、太倉穿劉家河，東南通吳淞江、黃浦，各入於海。

translations.literal: Harbors are opened to draw from the lakes: north through Changshu's Qipu, Baimao, and other harbors into the river; northeast through Kunshan and Taicang via the Liujia River; southeast through the Wusong River and Huangpu—each reaching the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Harbors are opened to draw from the lakes: north through Changshu's Qipu, Baimao, and other harbors into the river; northeast through Kunshan and Taicang via the Liujia River; southeast through the Wusong River and Huangpu—each reaching the sea.

sentences.zh: 諸水聯絡，四面環護，中如仰盂。

translations.literal: The waters connect, encircled and protected on four sides, like an upturned bowl in the center.
translations.idiomatic: The waters connect, encircled and protected on four sides, like an upturned bowl at the center.

sentences.zh: 杭、嘉湖、常、鎮勢繞四隅，蘇州居中，松江為諸水所受，最居下。

translations.literal: Hangzhou, Jiahu, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang surround the four corners; Suzhou sits at the center; Songjiang receives all waters and lies lowest.
translations.idiomatic: Hangzhou, Jiaxing and Huzhou, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang surround the four corners; Suzhou sits at the center; Songjiang receives all these waters and lies lowest.

sentences.zh: 乞專設水利僉事以裨國計。」

translations.literal: We beg that a water conservancy assistant commissioner be specially established to aid state revenue."
translations.idiomatic: We request that a water conservancy assistant commissioner be specially established to aid state revenue.

sentences.zh: 部議遣御史董之。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated and dispatched Censor Dong Zhi to handle it.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry deliberated and dispatched Censor Dong Zhi to handle it.

sentences.zh: 六年，巡撫都御史胡執禮請先浚吳淞江長橋、黃浦。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-Chief Hu Zhili requested that Chang Bridge and the Huangpu on the Wusong River be dredged first.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-Chief Hu Zhili requested that Chang Bridge and the Huangpu on the Wusong River be dredged first.

sentences.zh: 先是，巡按御史林應訓言：

translations.literal: Earlier, Investigating Censor Lin Yingxun had said:
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Investigating Censor Lin Yingxun had reported:

sentences.zh: 「蘇、鬆水利在開吳淞江中段，以通入海之勢。

translations.literal: "Water conservancy in Suzhou and Songjiang lies in opening the middle reach of the Wusong River to connect the momentum toward the sea.
translations.idiomatic: "Water conservancy in Suzhou and Songjiang lies in opening the middle reach of the Wusong River to restore the momentum toward the sea.

sentences.zh: 太湖入海，其道有三：東北由劉河，即古婁江故道；

translations.literal: Tai Lake enters the sea by three routes: northeast through the Liu River, the old course of ancient Lou River;
translations.idiomatic: Tai Lake enters the sea by three routes: northeast through the Liu River, the old course of ancient Lou River;

sentences.zh: 東南由大黃浦，即古東江遺意；

translations.literal: southeast through the Great Huangpu, the remnant intent of ancient Dong River;
translations.idiomatic: southeast through the Great Huangpu, the remnant of ancient Dong River;

sentences.zh: 其中為吳淞江，經崑山、嘉定、青浦、上海，乃太湖正脈。

translations.literal: and in the center the Wusong River, passing Kunshan, Jiading, Qingpu, and Shanghai—the main artery of Tai Lake.
translations.idiomatic: and in the center the Wusong River, passing Kunshan, Jiading, Qingpu, and Shanghai—the main artery of Tai Lake.

sentences.zh: 今劉河、黃浦皆通，而中江獨塞者，蓋江流與海潮遇，海潮渾濁，賴江水迅滌之。

translations.literal: Now the Liu River and Huangpu both run clear while the middle river alone is choked, because when river flow meets sea tide the tide is turbid and relies on swift river water to wash it clean.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Liu River and Huangpu both run clear while the middle river alone is choked, because when river flow meets the sea tide the tide is turbid and relies on swift river water to wash it clean.

sentences.zh: 劉河獨受巴、陽諸湖，又有新洋江、夏駕浦從旁以注；

translations.literal: The Liu River alone receives the lakes of Ba and Yang, and has Xinyang River and Xiakou Harbor feeding it from the side;
translations.idiomatic: The Liu River alone receives the Ba and Yang lakes, and has Xinyang River and Xiakou Harbor feeding it from the side;

sentences.zh: 大黃浦總會杭、嘉之水，又有澱山、泖蕩從上而灌。

translations.literal: the Great Huangpu gathers waters from Hangzhou and Jiaxing, and has Dianshan and lake marshes pouring in from above.
translations.idiomatic: the Great Huangpu gathers waters from Hangzhou and Jiaxing, and has Dianshan and the lake marshes pouring in from above.

sentences.zh: 是以流皆清駛，足以敵潮，不能淤也。

translations.literal: Therefore their flows are all clear and swift, sufficient to resist the tide and unable to silt up.
translations.idiomatic: Thus all their currents run clear and swift, enough to hold off the tide so that silting cannot occur.

sentences.zh: 惟吳淞江源出長橋、石塘下，經龐山、九里二湖而入。

translations.literal: Only the Wusong River rises below Chang Bridge and Shitang, passing through the two lakes of Pangshan and Jiuli before entering.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Wusong River rises below Chang Bridge and Shitang, passing through the two lakes of Pangshan and Jiuli before entering.

sentences.zh: 今長橋、石塘已堙，龐山、九里復為灘漲，其來已微。

translations.literal: Now Chang Bridge and Shitang are choked, Pangshan and Jiuli have again become tidal flats, and the inflow is already slight.
translations.idiomatic: Now Chang Bridge and Shitang are choked, Pangshan and Jiuli have again become tidal flats, and the inflow is already slight.

sentences.zh: 又有新洋江、夏駕浦掣其水以入劉河，勢乃益弱，不能勝海潮洶湧之勢而滌濁渾之流，日積月累，淤塞僅留一線。

translations.literal: Moreover Xinyang River and Xiakou Harbor draw off its water into the Liu River, so its force grows ever weaker; it cannot overcome the surging sea tide and wash away the turbid flow; day by day and month by month silt accumulates until only a thread remains.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Xinyang River and Xiakou Harbor draw off its water into the Liu River, so its force grows ever weaker; it cannot overcome the surging sea tide and wash away the turbid flow; day by day and month by month silt accumulates until only a thread remains.

sentences.zh: 水失故道，時致淫濫。

translations.literal: Water has lost its old course and sometimes causes excessive flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Water has lost its old course and sometimes causes excessive flooding.

sentences.zh: 支河小港，亦復壅滯。

translations.literal: Branch rivers and small harbors are again choked and stagnant.
translations.idiomatic: Branch rivers and small harbors are again choked and stagnant.

sentences.zh: 舊熟之田，半成荒畝。

translations.literal: Fields once fertile are half turned to wasteland.
translations.idiomatic: Fields once fertile are half turned to wasteland.

sentences.zh: 前都御史海瑞力破羣議，挑自上海江口宋家橋至嘉定艾祁八十里，幸尚通流。

translations.literal: Former Censor-in-Chief Hai Rui forcefully broke through group opposition and dredged from Songjia Bridge at the Shanghai river mouth to Aiqi in Jiading, eighty li; fortunately flow still continues.
translations.idiomatic: Former Censor-in-Chief Hai Rui forcefully overcame widespread opposition and dredged from Songjia Bridge at the Shanghai river mouth to Aiqi in Jiading, eighty li; fortunately flow still continues.

sentences.zh: 自艾祁至崑山慢水港六十餘里，則俱漲灘，急宜開浚，計淺九千五百餘丈，闊二十丈。

translations.literal: From Aiqi to Manshuigang in Kunshan, more than sixty li, all are raised shoals and urgently need dredging—estimated shallow stretch more than nine thousand five hundred zhang, width twenty zhang.
translations.idiomatic: From Aiqi to Manshuigang in Kunshan, more than sixty li, all are raised shoals and urgently need dredging—an estimated shallow stretch of more than nine thousand five hundred zhang, twenty zhang wide.

sentences.zh: 此江一開，太湖直入於海，濱江諸渠得以引流灌田，青浦積荒之區俱可開墾成熟矣。」

translations.literal: Once this river is opened, Tai Lake will flow directly to the sea, riverside channels will be able to draw water to irrigate fields, and the accumulated wasteland of Qingpu can all be opened and brought to cultivation."
translations.idiomatic: Once this river is opened, Tai Lake will flow directly to the sea, riverside channels will be able to draw water to irrigate fields, and Qingpu's accumulated wasteland can all be opened and brought to cultivation."

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 至是，工成。

translations.literal: By this time the work was complete.
translations.idiomatic: By this time the work was complete.

sentences.zh: 應訓又言：

translations.literal: Yingxun again reported:
translations.idiomatic: Lin Yingxun again reported:

sentences.zh: 「吳江縣治居太湖正東，湖水由此下吳淞達海。

translations.idiomatic: "The seat of Wujiang County lies directly east of Tai Lake; lake water from here flows down the Wusong to the sea.

sentences.zh: 宋時運道所經，畏風阻險，乃建長橋、石塘以通牽挽。

translations.literal: In Song times it lay on the transport route; fearing wind and obstructive danger, Chang Bridge and Shitang were built to allow towing.
translations.idiomatic: In Song times it lay on the transport route; fearing wind and obstructive hazards, Chang Bridge and Shitang were built to allow towing.

sentences.zh: 長橋百三十丈，為洞六十有二。

translations.literal: Chang Bridge is one hundred thirty zhang long, with sixty-two openings.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Bridge spans one hundred thirty zhang and has sixty-two culvert openings.

sentences.zh: 石塘小則有竇，大則有橋，內外浦涇縱橫貫穿，皆為泄水計也。

translations.literal: Shitang has sluice openings where small and bridges where large; harbors and channels inside and out crisscross through it—all designed for draining water.
translations.idiomatic: At Shitang, small sections have sluice openings and large ones have bridges; harbors and channels within and without run crisscross through it—all planned for draining water.

sentences.zh: 石塘涇竇半淤，長橋內外俱圮，僅一二洞門通水。

translations.literal: Shitang's channel sluices are half silted; Chang Bridge is collapsed both inside and out; only one or two culvert gates still carry water.
translations.idiomatic: Shitang's channel sluices are half choked with silt; Chang Bridge has collapsed on both sides, and only one or two culvert gates still pass water.

sentences.zh: 若不疏浚，雖開吳淞下流，終無益也。

translations.literal: If not dredged, even opening the lower reach of the Wusong will ultimately be of no benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Without dredging, even opening the lower Wusong will ultimately do no good.

sentences.zh: 宜開龐山湖口，由長橋抵吳家港。

translations.literal: The mouth of Pangshan Lake should be opened, running from Chang Bridge to Wujia Harbor.
translations.idiomatic: The mouth of Pangshan Lake should be opened, with a channel from Chang Bridge to Wujia Harbor.

sentences.zh: 則湖有所泄，江有所歸，源盛流長，為利大矣。

translations.literal: Then the lake will have an outlet, the river a destination; with a strong source and long flow, the benefit will be great.
translations.idiomatic: Then the lake would have an outlet and the river a proper course; with a strong headwater and a long run, the gain would be immense.

sentences.zh: 松江大黃浦西南受杭、嘉之水，西北受澱、泖諸蕩之水，總會於浦，而秀州塘、山涇港諸處實黃浦來源也。

translations.literal: Songjiang's Dahuangpu receives Hangzhou and Jiaxing waters from the southwest, and waters from Dian and Mao lake marshes from the northwest; all gather in the pu, while Xiuzhou Canal, Shanjing Harbor, and such places are in fact the source of the Huangpu.
translations.idiomatic: Songjiang's Dahuangpu takes in waters from Hangzhou and Jiaxing to the southwest and from the Dian and Mao lake marshes to the northwest; all converge in the pu, while Xiuzhou Canal, Shanjing Harbor, and the like are in truth the Huangpu's headwaters.

sentences.zh: 澱山湖入黃浦道漸多淤淺，宜為疏瀹。

translations.literal: The route from Dianshan Lake into the Huangpu is gradually much silted and shallow; it should be dredged and cleared.
translations.idiomatic: The channel from Dianshan Lake into the Huangpu is growing increasingly silted and shallow and should be dredged and cleared.

sentences.zh: 而自黃浦、橫澇、洙涇，經秀州塘入南泖，至山涇港等處，萬四千餘丈，待浚尤急。

translations.literal: And from the Huangpu, Henglao, and Zhujing, passing through Xiuzhou Canal into South Mao, to Shanjing Harbor and elsewhere—more than fourteen thousand zhang—dredging is especially urgent.
translations.idiomatic: From the Huangpu, Henglao, and Zhujing, through Xiuzhou Canal into South Mao and on to Shanjing Harbor and beyond—more than fourteen thousand zhang in all—dredging is especially urgent.

sentences.zh: 他如蘇之茜涇、楊林、白茆、七浦諸港，鬆之蒲匯、官紹諸塘，常、鎮之澡港、九曲諸河，並宜設法開導，次第修舉。」

translations.literal: Others such as Suzhou's Qianjing, Yanglin, Baimao, and Qipu harbors; Songjiang's Puhui and Guanshao embankments; Changzhou and Zhenjiang's Zaogang, Jiuqu, and other rivers—all should have measures devised to open and guide them, with repairs undertaken in sequence."

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he again reported: "Suzhou and Songjiang and other prefectures have trunk rivers and branch harbors numbering in the hundreds—the large drain water to the sea, the medium connect lakes to rivers, the small draw water to irrigate fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he reported again: "Suzhou, Songjiang, and the other prefectures have trunk rivers and branch harbors by the hundreds—the largest drain floodwater to the sea, the next rank connect lakes to rivers, and the smallest draw water to irrigate fields.

sentences.zh: 今吳淞江、白茆塘、秀州塘、蒲匯塘、孟瀆河、舜河、青暘港俱已告成，支河數十，宜盡開浚。」

translations.literal: Now the Wusong River, Baimao Canal, Xiuzhou Canal, Puhui Canal, Mengdu River, Shun River, and Qingyang Harbor are all completed; several tens of branch rivers should all be opened and dredged.
translations.idiomatic: The Wusong River, Baimao Canal, Xiuzhou Canal, Puhui Canal, Mengdu River, Shun River, and Qingyang Harbor are now finished; several dozen branch rivers should all be opened and dredged.

sentences.zh: 俱從其請。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 久之，用儀望議，特設蘇、鬆水利副使，以許應逵領之。

translations.literal: After some time, adopting Song Yiwang's proposal, a special Deputy Commissioner for Waterworks of Suzhou and Songjiang was established, with Xu Yingkui appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: After some time, on Song Yiwang's recommendation, a special Deputy Commissioner for Suzhou and Songjiang waterworks was created, with Xu Yingkui placed in charge.

sentences.zh: 乃浚吳淞八十餘晨，築塘九十餘處，開新河百二十三道，浚內河百三十九道，築上海李家洪老鴉嘴海岸十八里，發帑金二十萬。

translations.literal: He dredged more than eighty li of the Wusong, built embankments at more than ninety places, opened one hundred twenty-three new canals, dredged one hundred thirty-nine interior canals, built eighteen li of coast at Laoyazui on the Shanghai Lijiahong shore, and disbursed two hundred thousand taels from the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: He dredged more than eighty li of the Wusong, built embankments at more than ninety sites, opened one hundred twenty-three new canals, dredged one hundred thirty-nine interior canals, constructed eighteen li of coast at Laoyazui on Shanghai's Lijiahong shore, and spent two hundred thousand taels from the treasury.

sentences.zh: 應逵以其半訖工。

translations.literal: Yingkui completed half of it.
translations.idiomatic: Yingkui finished half the work.

sentences.zh: 三十七、八年間，霪雨浸溢，水患日熾。

translations.literal: Between the thirty-seventh and thirty-eighth years, incessant rain flooded over and water disasters grew daily worse.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh and thirty-eighth years, unending rain spread floodwaters and water disasters grew worse by the day.

translations.literal: Several years later, Supervising Secretary Gui Ziguan reported: "In Song times the Wusong River was nine li wide.
translations.idiomatic: Several years later, Supervising Secretary Gui Ziguan memorialized: "In Song times the Wusong River was nine li across.

sentences.zh: 元末淤塞。

translations.literal: At the end of Yuan it was silted and blocked.
translations.idiomatic: By the end of the Yuan it had silted shut.

sentences.zh: 正統間，周忱立表江心，疏而浚之。

translations.literal: During Zhengtong, Zhou Chen set gauge marks mid-river and dredged and cleared it.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhengtong era Zhou Chen set gauge marks midstream and dredged it clear.

sentences.zh: 崔恭、徐貫、李充嗣、海瑞相繼浚者凡五，迄今四十餘年，廢而不講。

translations.literal: Cui Gong, Xu Guan, Li Chongsi, and Hai Rui, who dredged in succession, totaled five; from then until now more than forty years have passed without attention.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Gong, Xu Guan, Li Chongsi, and Hai Rui dredged it in turn—five efforts in all—and for more than forty years since, the work has been abandoned and neglected.

translations.idiomatic: The river should be widened and its current quickened, with embankment harbors and branch rivers dividing the flow in every direction.

sentences.zh: 疏入留中。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted and kept at court.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted and held at court.

sentences.zh: 巡按御史薛貞復請行之，下部議而未行。

translations.literal: Investigating Censor Xue Zhenfu again requested implementation; it was referred to the ministry for discussion but not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating Censor Xue Zhenfu again asked that it be carried out; the matter was referred to the ministry for discussion but never implemented.

sentences.zh: 至天啟中，巡撫都御史周起元復請浚吳淞、白茆。

translations.literal: In the Tianqi era, Grand Coordinator Zhou Qiyuan again requested dredging the Wusong and Baimao.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tianqi period Grand Coordinator Zhou Qiyuan again petitioned to dredge the Wusong and Baimao.

sentences.zh: 崇禎初，員外郎蔡懋德、巡撫都御史李待問皆以為請。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongzhen, Vice Director Cai Maode and Grand Coordinator Li Daiwen all petitioned for the same.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Chongzhen, Vice Director Cai Maode and Grand Coordinator Li Daiwen both submitted the same request.

sentences.zh: 久之，巡撫都御史張國維請疏吳江長橋七十二谼及九里、石塘諸洞。

translations.literal: After some time, Grand Coordinator Zhang Guowei requested dredging the seventy-two culverts of Chang Bridge in Wujiang and the openings of Jiuli and Shitang.
translations.idiomatic: After some time Grand Coordinator Zhang Guowei asked that the seventy-two culverts of Wujiang's Chang Bridge and the openings at Jiuli and Shitang be cleared.

sentences.zh: 御史李謨復請浚吳淞、白茆。

translations.literal: Censor Li Mo again requested dredging the Wusong and Baimao.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Li Mo again petitioned to dredge the Wusong and Baimao.

sentences.zh: 俱下部議，未能行也。

translations.literal: All were referred to the ministry for discussion but could not be implemented.
translations.idiomatic: All were referred to the ministry for deliberation, but none could be carried out.

sentences.zh: 十年，增築雄縣橫堤八里，禦滹沱暴漲。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, the transverse dike at Xiong County was extended by eight li to hold back Hoodu flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the transverse dike at Xiong County was extended eight li to hold back Hoodu flood surges.

sentences.zh: 十三年，以尚寶少卿徐貞明兼御史，領墾田使。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Studs Xu Zhenming was additionally appointed as Censor and put in charge of the Reclamation Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Xu Zhenming, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Studs, was additionally made Censor and placed in charge of the Reclamation Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 貞明為給事中，嘗請興西北水利如南人圩田之制，引水成田。

translations.literal: When Zhenming was a supervising secretary, he once requested that northwestern waterworks be developed on the model of southern polder-field practice, drawing water to form fields.
translations.idiomatic: While serving as a supervising secretary, Zhenming had once asked that northwestern waterworks be developed on the southern polder model, drawing water to create fields.

sentences.zh: 工部覆議：「畿輔諸郡邑，以上流十五河之水泄於貓兒一灣，海口又極束隘，故所在橫流。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Works responded: "In the prefectures and districts of the capital region, waters from fifteen upstream rivers discharge into Maor Bay alone, and the river mouth is extremely narrow and constricted, so water overflows everywhere horizontally.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Works replied: "In the capital region's prefectures and districts, the waters of fifteen upstream rivers all empty into Maor Bay alone, and the river mouth is extremely narrow—so water spreads sideways everywhere.

sentences.zh: 必多開支河，挑浚海口，而後水勢可平，疏浚可施。

translations.literal: Many branch rivers must be opened and the river mouth excavated before water forces can be leveled and dredging be feasible.
translations.idiomatic: Many branch rivers must be opened and the river mouth excavated before the water can be brought under control and dredging made practicable.

sentences.zh: 然役大費繁，而今以民勞財匱，方務省事，請罷其議。」

translations.literal: Yet the labor is great and the expense heavy, and now with the people overworked and coffers depleted, the court is striving to reduce burdens—please abandon this proposal.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the labor is vast and the cost heavy, and with the people exhausted and the treasury empty the court is now bent on reducing burdens—please drop the proposal.

sentences.zh: 乃已。

translations.literal: And so it was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: And so the matter was dropped.

sentences.zh: 後貞明謫官，著《潞水客譚》一書，論水利當興者十四條。

translations.literal: Later Zhenming was demoted and wrote a book called Clients' Talk on Lu River Water, setting forth fourteen provisions on waterworks that should be developed.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhenming was demoted and wrote Clients' Talk on Lu River Water, setting out fourteen points on waterworks that ought to be developed.

sentences.zh: 時巡撫張國彥、副使顧養謙方開水利於薊、永有效，於是給事中王敬民薦貞明，特召還，賜敕勘水利。

translations.literal: At the time Grand Coordinator Zhang Guoyan and Vice Commissioner Gu Yangqian were developing waterworks in Ji and Yong with good effect; thereupon Supervising Secretary Wang Jingmin recommended Zhenming, who was specially summoned back and granted an imperial commission to survey waterworks.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Grand Coordinator Zhang Guoyan and Vice Commissioner Gu Yangqian were opening waterworks in Ji and Yong with good results; Supervising Secretary Wang Jingmin then recommended Zhenming, who was specially recalled and granted an imperial commission to survey waterworks.

sentences.zh: 貞明乃先治京東州邑，如密雲燕樂莊，平谷水峪寺、龍家務莊，三河塘會莊、順慶屯地。

translations.literal: Zhenming then first worked on eastern capital districts such as Yanlezhuang in Miyun, Shuiyusi and Longjiawuzhuang in Pinggu, and Tanghuizhuang and Shunqingtun in Sanhe.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenming first worked the eastern capital districts—places such as Yanlezhuang in Miyun; Shuiyusi and Longjiawuzhuang in Pinggu; and Tanghuizhuang and Shunqingtun in Sanhe.

sentences.zh: 薊州城北黃厓營，城西白馬泉、鎮國莊，城東馬伸橋，夾林河而下別山鋪，夾陰流河而下至於陰流。

translations.literal: North of Jizhou city at Huangya Camp; west of the city at Baima Spring and Zhenguozhuang; east of the city at Mashen Bridge; following the Jialin River down to Bieshanpu; following the Yinliu River down to Yinliu.
translations.idiomatic: At Huangya Camp north of Jizhou city; Baima Spring and Zhenguozhuang west of the city; Mashen Bridge east of the city; along the Jialin River down to Bieshanpu; and along the Yinliu River down to Yinliu.

sentences.zh: 遵化平安城，夾運河而下沙河鋪西，城南鐵廠、湧珠湖以下韭菜溝、上素河、下素河百餘里。

translations.literal: At Ping'an City in Zunhua, following the Grand Canal down past Shahepu West; south of the city at the ironworks and below Yongzhu Lake—Yongcaigou, Shangsu River, and Xiasu River for more than one hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: At Ping'an City in Zunhua, along the Grand Canal down past Shahepu West; south of the city at the ironworks and below Yongzhu Lake—Yongcaigou, the upper and lower Su rivers—for more than one hundred li.

sentences.zh: 豐潤之南，則大寨、剌榆坨、史家河、大王莊，東則榛子鎮，西則鴉紅橋，夾河五十餘里。

translations.literal: South of Fengrun: Dazhai, Layuotuo, Shijia River, and Dawangzhuang; east: Zhenzizhen; west: Yahong Bridge; following the river for more than fifty li.
translations.idiomatic: South of Fengrun lay Dazhai, Layuotuo, Shijia River, and Dawangzhuang; to the east, Zhenzizhen; to the west, Yahong Bridge—more than fifty li along the river.

sentences.zh: 玉田青莊塢、後湖莊、三里屯及大泉、小泉，至於瀕海之地，自水道沽關、黑嚴子墩至開平衛南宋家營，東西百餘里，南北百八十里。

translations.literal: Qingzhuangwu, Houhuzhuang, and Sanlitun in Yutian, and Daquan and Xiaoquan, reaching the coastal lands—from Shuiguoguan and Heiyanzidun on the water route to Songjiaying south of Kaiping Guard—more than one hundred li east to west and one hundred eighty li north to south.
translations.idiomatic: At Qingzhuangwu, Houhuzhuang, Sanlitun, and the Da and Xiao springs in Yutian, reaching the coastal lands—from Shuiguoguan and Heiyanzidun along the water route to Songjiaying south of Kaiping Guard—more than one hundred li east to west and one hundred eighty li north to south.

sentences.zh: 墾田三萬九千餘畝。

translations.literal: Reclaimed more than thirty-nine thousand mu of fields.
translations.idiomatic: More than thirty-nine thousand mu of land were reclaimed.

sentences.zh: 至真定將治滹沱近堧地，御史王之棟言：「滹沱非人力可治，徒耗財擾民。」

translations.literal: When about to work on lands near the Hoodu levee in Zhending, Censor Wang Zhidong reported: "The Hoodu cannot be controlled by human effort; it would only waste funds and disturb the people.
translations.idiomatic: When he was about to work the lands near the Hoodu levee in Zhending, Censor Wang Zhidong said: "The Hoodu is beyond human control; the effort would only waste money and trouble the people.

sentences.zh: 帝入其言，欲罪諸建議者。

translations.literal: The Emperor accepted his words and wished to punish those who had proposed the projects.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor took his view and wanted to punish those who had proposed the projects.

sentences.zh: 申時行言：「墾田興利謂之害民，議甚舛。

translations.literal: Shen Shixing said: "Calling reclamation that benefits the state harmful to the people is a very wrong judgment.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Shixing said: "To call reclamation that serves the public good harmful to the people is a grievous error.

sentences.zh: 顧為此說者，其故有二。

translations.literal: Yet those who say this have two reasons.
translations.idiomatic: Those who say this, however, have two reasons.

sentences.zh: 北方民遊惰好閑，憚於力作，水田有耕耨之勞，胼胝之苦，不便一也。

translations.literal: Northern commoners are idle and fond of leisure, fearing hard labor; paddy fields require the toil of plowing and weeding and the hardship of calloused hands—this is the first inconvenience.
translations.idiomatic: Northern commoners are idle and love ease, and shrink from hard labor; paddy fields demand the toil of plowing and hoeing and the pain of blistered hands—this is the first inconvenience.

sentences.zh: 貴勢有力家侵佔甚多，不待耕作，坐收蘆葦薪芻之利；

translations.literal: Powerful and noble families have encroached on much land; without awaiting cultivation they sit collecting profits from reeds, rushes, and fodder;
translations.idiomatic: Powerful families have encroached on vast tracts and, without ever farming them, sit collecting profits from reeds, rushes, and fodder;

sentences.zh: 若開墾成田，歸於業戶，隸於有司，則已利盡失，不便二也。

translations.literal: if it is opened and reclaimed into fields, returning to owner-cultivators and subject to officials, their profits would be entirely lost—this is the second inconvenience.
translations.idiomatic: if the land were opened, reclaimed, and turned over to farming households under official oversight, those profits would vanish—this is the second inconvenience.

sentences.zh: 然以國家大計較之，不便者小，而便者大。

translations.literal: Yet measured against the state's grand design, the inconveniences are small and the benefits large.
translations.idiomatic: Yet weighed against the nation's larger interest, the inconveniences are small and the benefits great.

sentences.zh: 惟在斟酌地勢，體察人情，沙堿不必盡開，黍麥無煩改作，應用伕役，必官募之，不拂民情，不失地利，乃謀國長策耳。」

translations.literal: Only by weighing terrain, observing popular sentiment—not opening all sandy alkaline land needlessly, not forcing millet and wheat to be converted, and when employing corvée labor recruiting it through officials, neither going against public feeling nor squandering local advantage, is this a long-term policy for the realm.
translations.idiomatic: What matters is to weigh the terrain and read the people's mood—not opening every patch of sandy alkaline soil, not forcing millet and wheat fields to be converted, and when corvée is needed recruiting it through official channels, so that popular feeling is not offended nor local advantage wasted. That is the long-term policy for the state.

sentences.zh: 於是貞明得無罪，而水田事終罷。

translations.literal: Thereupon Zhenming escaped punishment, but the paddy-field project was ultimately abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenming was spared punishment, but the paddy-field project was abandoned in the end.

sentences.zh: 巡撫都御史樑問孟築橫城堡邊牆，慮寧夏有黃河患，請堤西岔河，障水東流。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Liang Wenmeng, while building the transverse forts and border wall, fearing Hoodu trouble for Ningxia, requested diking the West Cha River to block water flowing east.
translations.idiomatic: While building transverse forts and the border wall, Grand Coordinator Liang Wenmeng, fearing Yellow River flooding in Ningxia, asked that the West Cha River be diked to block water flowing eastward.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 十九年，尚寶丞周弘禴言：「寧夏河東有漢、秦二壩，請依河西漢、唐壩築以石，於渠外疏大渠一道，北達鴛鴦諸湖。」

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, Director Zhou Hongxi reported: "East of the river in Ningxia are the Han and Qin era dams; please build them in stone on the model of the Han and Tang dams on the west side of the river, and outside the canal open a great canal reaching the Yuanyang lakes to the north.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year Director Zhou Hongxi said: "East of the river in Ningxia stand the Han and Qin dams; please rebuild them in stone on the model of the Han and Tang dams west of the river, and outside the canal open a great channel running north to the Yuanyang lakes.

sentences.zh: 詔可。

translations.literal: The edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved the plan.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，黃、淮漲溢，淮、揚昏墊。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, the Yellow and Huai rose and overflowed; Huai and Yang were sunk in mud.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year the Yellow and Huai rivers surged and spilled over; the Huai and Yang regions were drowned in mud.

sentences.zh: 議者多請開高家堰以分淮。

translations.literal: Many in deliberation requested opening the Gaojia Embankment to divide the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Many in the deliberations asked to open the Gaojia Embankment to divert the Huai.

sentences.zh: 寶應知縣陳煃為御史，慮高堰既開，害民產鹽場，請自興、鹽迤東，疏白塗河、石鵜達口、廖家港為數河，分門出海；

translations.literal: Chen Chun, magistrate of Baoying, serving as censor, fearing that once the high embankment was opened it would harm the people's salt fields, requested that from Xing and Yan eastward, the Baitu River, Shipu Dakou, and Liaojia Harbor be dredged as several rivers, each with its own outlet to the sea;
translations.idiomatic: Chen Chun, magistrate of Baoying and now serving as censor, fearing that opening the high embankment would ruin the people's saltworks, asked that from Xing and Yan eastward the Baitu River, Shipu Dakou, and Liaojia Harbor be dredged into several rivers, each with its own outlet to the sea;

sentences.zh: 然後從下而上，浚清水、子嬰二溝，且多開瓜、儀閘口以泄水。

translations.literal: then from below upward, dredge the Qingshui and Ziying channels, and open many Guan and Yi sluice gates to discharge water.
translations.idiomatic: then, working from downstream upward, dredge the Qingshui and Ziying channels and open many sluice gates at Gua and Yi to release the water.

sentences.zh: 給事中祝世祿亦言：「議者欲放淮從廣陽、射陽二湖入海。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Zhu Shilu also said: "Those deliberating wish to release the Huai through Guangyang and Sheyang lakes into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Zhu Shilu also said: "Those deliberating wish to release the Huai through Guangyang and Sheyang lakes into the sea.

sentences.zh: 廣陽闊僅八里，射陽僅二十五丈，名為湖，實河也。

translations.literal: Guangyang is only eight li wide; Sheyang only twenty-five zhang—they are called lakes but are in fact rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Guangyang is only eight li across; Sheyang only twenty-five zhang—they are called lakes but are really rivers.

sentences.zh: 且離海三百里，迂迴淺窄，高、寶七州縣水惟此一線宣洩之，又使淮注焉，田廬鹽場，必無幸矣。

translations.literal: Moreover they are three hundred li from the sea, winding, shallow, and narrow; water from the seven prefectures and districts of Gaoyou and Baoying has only this single line by which to drain—and if the Huai is also poured in, fields, dwellings, and saltworks will certainly fare ill.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover they lie three hundred li from the sea, winding, shallow, and narrow; the seven prefectures and districts of Gaoyou and Baoying have only this single line by which to drain—and if the Huai is poured in as well, fields, homes, and saltworks will surely be ruined.

sentences.zh: 廣陽湖東有大湖，方廣六十里，湖北口有舊官河，自官蕩至鹽城石鵜達口，通海僅五十三里，此導淮入海一便也。」

translations.literal: East of Guangyang Lake is a great lake sixty li square; at the lake's north mouth is an old official canal from Guandang to Shipu Dakou at Yancheng—only fifty-three li to the sea; this is one convenient route for guiding the Huai to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: East of Guangyang Lake lies a great lake sixty li on a side; at its north mouth is an old official canal from Guandang to Shipu Dakou at Yancheng—only fifty-three li to the sea. That is one convenient route for guiding the Huai to the sea.

sentences.zh: 下部及河漕官議，俱格不行。

translations.literal: Referred to the ministry and river-transport officials for discussion—all were blocked and not implemented.
translations.idiomatic: The proposals were referred to the ministry and river-transport officials for discussion—all were blocked and never carried out.

sentences.zh: 既而總河尚書楊一魁言：「黃水倒灌，正以海口為阻。

translations.literal: Soon after, Minister of the Grand Canal Yang Yikui reported: "Yellow water backing up is precisely because the river mouth is obstructed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Minister of the Grand Canal Yang Yikui reported: "Yellow water is backing up precisely because the river mouth is blocked.

sentences.zh: 分黃工就，則石鵜達口、廖家港、白駒場海口，金灣、芒稻諸河，急宜開刷。」

translations.literal: Once the work of dividing the Yellow River is done, Shipu Dakou, Liaojia Harbor, the Baima field river mouth, Jinwan, Mangdao, and other rivers should urgently be opened and cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Once the work of diverting the Yellow River is finished, Shipu Dakou, Liaojia Harbor, the Baima field estuary, Jinwan, Mangdao, and the other rivers should urgently be opened and cleared.

sentences.zh: 乃命如議行之。

translations.literal: Thereupon he was ordered to proceed as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: He was then ordered to proceed as proposed.

sentences.zh: 三十年，保定巡撫都御史汪應蛟言：「易水可溉金臺，滹水可溉恆山，溏水可溉中山，滏水可溉襄國，漳水可溉鄴下，而瀛海當眾河下流，故號河中，視江南澤國不異。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, Grand Coordinator Wang Yingjiao reported: "The Yi River can irrigate Jintai, the Hu River Hengshan, the Tang River Zhongshan, the Fu River Xiangguo, the Zhang River the Ye region—and Yinghai lies where all rivers converge downstream, therefore called River Central; it differs little from the marsh country of Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year Grand Coordinator Wang Yingjiao said: "The Yi River can irrigate Jintai, the Hu River Hengshan, the Tang River Zhongshan, the Fu River Xiangguo, and the Zhang River the Ye region—and Yinghai sits where all these rivers converge downstream, hence its name River Central; it differs little from the water country of Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 至於山下之泉，地中之水，所在皆有，宜各設壩建閘，通渠築堤，高者自灌，下則車汲。

translations.literal: As for springs below hills and water in the ground, they exist everywhere; dams and sluices should be set at each place, channels opened and dikes built—where high, self-irrigation; where low, water raised by wheel.
translations.idiomatic: As for springs below the hills and water in the ground, they are found everywhere; dams and sluices should be built at each site, channels opened and dikes raised—where the land is high, let it irrigate itself; where it is low, lift water with wheels.

sentences.zh: 用南方水田法，六郡之內，得水田數萬頃，畿民從此饒，永無旱澇之患。

translations.literal: Using the southern paddy method, within the six prefectures several tens of thousands of qing of paddy fields can be obtained; capital-region people will from this become prosperous, forever free of drought and flood disasters.
translations.idiomatic: Using the southern paddy method, several tens of thousands of qing of paddy fields could be created within the six prefectures; the people of the capital region would grow prosperous and be forever free of drought and flood.

sentences.zh: 不幸濱河有梗，亦可改折於南，取糴於北。

translations.literal: Should the river transport route be blocked, grain tribute may also be diverted southward and purchased from the north.
translations.idiomatic: Should the river transport route be blocked, grain tribute could also be diverted southward and grain purchased from the north.

sentences.zh: 此國家無窮利也。」

translations.literal: This is boundless profit for the state.
translations.idiomatic: This would be boundless profit for the state.

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 應蛟乃於天津葛沽、何家圈、雙溝、白塘，令防海軍丁屯種，人授田四畝，共種五千餘畝，水稻二千畝，收多，因上言：「墾地七千頃，歲可得穀二百餘萬石，此行之而效者也。」

translations.literal: Yingjiao then at Gezhu, Hejiaquan, Shuanggou, and Baitang in Tianjin ordered coastal-defense garrison soldiers to farm colonies, each man granted four mu, altogether planting more than five thousand mu; two thousand mu of rice paddies yielded abundantly, whereupon he memorialized: "Reclaiming seven thousand qing of land, one may obtain more than two million shi of grain annually—this is what has been done with effect."
translations.idiomatic: Yingjiao then at Gezhu, Hejiaquan, Shuanggou, and Baitang in Tianjin ordered coastal-defense garrison soldiers to farm colony land, granting each man four mu—more than five thousand mu planted in all, including two thousand mu of rice paddies with abundant harvests—whereupon he memorialized: "Reclaim seven thousand qing and the yearly yield could exceed two million shi of grain. This is what has already been tried with success."

sentences.zh: 是年，真定知府郭勉浚大鳴、小鳴泉四十餘穴，溉田千頃。

translations.literal: That year, Prefect Guo Mian of Zhending dredged more than forty springs at Daming and Xiaoming, irrigating one thousand qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zhending Prefect Guo Mian cleared more than forty springs at Daming and Xiaoming, irrigating one thousand qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 邢臺達活、野狐二泉流為牛尾河，百泉流為澧河，建二十一閘二堤，灌田五百餘頃。

translations.literal: At Dahuoying and Yehu springs in Xingtai they flow into the Niwei River; the Hundred Springs flow into the Li River; twenty-one sluices and two dikes were built, irrigating more than five hundred qing.
translations.idiomatic: At Xingtai the Dahuoying and Yehu springs flow into the Niwei River and the Hundred Springs into the Li River; twenty-one sluices and two dikes were built, irrigating more than five hundred qing.

sentences.zh: 天啟元年，御史左光鬥用應蛟策，復天津屯田，令通判盧觀象管理屯田水利。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianqi, Censor Zuo Guangdou, adopting Yingjiao's plan, restored Tianjin colony fields and ordered Vice Prefect Lu Guanxiang to manage colony fields and waterworks.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianqi 1 (1621) Censor Zuo Guangdou, adopting Yingjiao's plan, restored Tianjin colony fields and put Vice Prefect Lu Guanxiang in charge of colony land and waterworks.

sentences.zh: 明年，巡按御史張慎言言：「自枝河而西，靜海、興濟之間，萬頃沃壤。

translations.literal: The next year, Investigating Censor Zhang Shenyan reported: "West of the branch river, between Jinghai and Xingji, lie tens of thousands of qing of fertile land.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Investigating Censor Zhang Shenyan said: "West of the branch river, between Jinghai and Xingji, lies tens of thousands of qing of rich land.

sentences.zh: 河之東，尚有鹽水沽等處為膏腴之田，惜皆蕪廢。

translations.literal: East of the river, places such as Yanshuigu still hold rich fields—alas all lie abandoned and overgrown.
translations.idiomatic: East of the river, places such as Yanshuigu still hold fertile fields—yet all lie abandoned and overgrown.

sentences.zh: 今觀象開寇家口以南田三千餘畝，溝洫蘆塘之法，種植疏浚之方，皆具而有法，人何憚而不為？

translations.literal: Now Guanxiang has opened more than three thousand mu of fields south of Koujiakou; methods of ditches, drains, and reed embankments, and plans for planting and dredging, are all complete and systematic—why should people shrink from acting?
translations.idiomatic: Guanxiang has already opened more than three thousand mu south of Koujiakou; his methods for ditches, drains, and reed embankments and his plans for planting and dredging are all complete and systematic—why should people hesitate to follow?

sentences.zh: 大抵開種之法有五：一官種。

translations.literal: Broadly speaking, there are five methods of opening cultivation: first, official cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: Broadly speaking, there are five methods of opening land for cultivation: first, official cultivation.

sentences.zh: 謂牛、種、器具、耕作、僱募皆出於官，而官亦盡收其田之入也。

translations.literal: This means oxen, seed, tools, farming, and hired labor all come from the government, and the government also collects the entire harvest of the fields.
translations.idiomatic: This means oxen, seed, tools, farming, and hired labor all come from the government, and the government takes the entire harvest.

sentences.zh: 一佃種。

translations.literal: Second, tenant cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: Second, tenant cultivation.

sentences.zh: 謂民願墾而無力，其牛、種、器具仰給於官，待納稼之時，官十而取其四也。

translations.literal: This means commoners willing to reclaim but without means—their oxen, seed, and tools are supplied by the government, and at harvest the government takes four parts in ten.
translations.idiomatic: This is for commoners willing to reclaim land but without means—their oxen, seed, and tools are supplied by the government, and at harvest the government takes four parts in ten.

sentences.zh: 一民種。

translations.literal: Third, private cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: Third, private cultivation.

sentences.zh: 佃之有力者，自認開墾若干，迨開荒既熟，較數歲之中以為常，十一而取是也。

translations.literal: Where tenants have means, they personally claim to open and reclaim a set amount; once wasteland is brought to maturity, the yield of several years is averaged as the norm, and one part in ten is taken.
translations.idiomatic: Tenants with means claim a set amount of land to open and reclaim; once the wasteland is brought under cultivation, the yield is averaged over several years as the standard, and one part in ten is taken.

sentences.zh: 一軍種。

translations.literal: Fourth, military cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, military cultivation.

sentences.zh: 即令海防營軍種葛沽之田，人耕四畝，收二石，緣有行、月糧，故收租重也。

translations.literal: This means ordering coastal-defense garrison soldiers to farm Gezhu fields—each man cultivates four mu and yields two shi; because they receive traveling and monthly rations, the rent collected is heavy.
translations.idiomatic: This means ordering coastal-defense garrison soldiers to farm Gezhu fields—each man cultivates four mu and yields two shi; because they already receive traveling and monthly rations, the rent collected is heavier.

sentences.zh: 一屯種。

translations.literal: Fifth, colony cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, colony cultivation.

sentences.zh: 祖宗衛軍有屯田，或五十畝，或百畝。

translations.literal: Under the ancestral system guard soldiers had colony fields, either fifty mu or one hundred mu.
translations.idiomatic: Under the founding system guard soldiers held colony fields of fifty or one hundred mu each.

sentences.zh: 軍為屯種者，歲入十七於官，即以所入為官軍歲支之用。

translations.literal: Soldiers doing colony cultivation paid seven parts in ten to the government yearly, and that income supplied the guard soldiers' yearly expenses.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers farming colony land paid seven parts in ten to the government, and that income supplied the guard soldiers' yearly expenses.

sentences.zh: 國初兵農之善制也。

translations.literal: A fine institution of the dynasty's early years combining soldiers and farmers.
translations.idiomatic: It was a fine early-dynasty institution joining soldiers and farmers.

sentences.zh: 四法已行，惟屯種則今日兵與軍分，而屯僅存其名。

translations.literal: Of the four methods already in use, only colony cultivation—today soldiers and troops are separated, and colonies survive in name only.
translations.idiomatic: Of the four methods already in use, only colony cultivation has decayed—today soldiers and garrison troops are separate, and colonies survive in name alone.

sentences.zh: 當選各衛之屯餘，墾津門之沃土，如官種法行之。」

translations.literal: The surplus colony land of each guard should be selected to reclaim the fertile soil of the Tianjin gate, implemented by the official-cultivation method.
translations.idiomatic: The surplus colony land of each guard should be chosen to reclaim the fertile soil around Tianjin, using the official-cultivation method.

sentences.zh: 章下所司，命太僕卿董應舉管天津至山海屯田，規畫數年，開田十八萬畝，積穀無算。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent to the responsible office; Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud Dong Yingju was ordered to oversee colony fields from Tianjin to Shanhai; after several years of planning, one hundred eighty thousand mu were opened and grain accumulated beyond reckoning.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was sent to the responsible offices; Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud Dong Yingju was ordered to oversee colony fields from Tianjin to Shanhaiguan; after several years of planning, one hundred eighty thousand mu were opened and grain accumulated beyond reckoning.

sentences.zh: 崇禎二年，兵部侍郎申用懋言：「永平濼河諸水，逶迤寬衍，可疏渠以防旱潦。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongzhen, Vice Minister of War Shen Yongmao reported: "The rivers of Yongping such as Lu River wind broadly and can have channels dredged to guard against drought and flood.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongzhen 2 (1629) Vice Minister of War Shen Yongmao said: "The rivers of Yongping, such as the Lu River, wind broadly and can have channels dredged to guard against drought and flood.

sentences.zh: 山坡隙地，便栽種。

translations.literal: Hillside gaps in the land are convenient for planting.
translations.idiomatic: Hillside pockets of land are well suited to planting.

sentences.zh: 宜令有司相地察源，為民興利。」

translations.literal: It is fitting to order the local officials to survey the terrain and investigate the sources, bringing benefit to the people."
translations.idiomatic: Local officials should be ordered to survey the terrain, trace the water sources, and bring benefit to the people."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.
